tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bka' babs bdun ldan gyi brgyud pa'i rnam thar ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba rin po che'i khungs lta bu'i gtam zhes bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā sta/ na mo gu ru we/ bka' babs bdun ldan gyi brgyud pa'i rnam thar ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba rin po che'i khungs lta bu'i gtam zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba kun la rdo rje 'chang gi lam/ /gsal mdzad rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /gus pa'i yid kyis yang yang phyag 'tshal nas/ /mdzad pa'i tshul rnams mdo tsam brjod par bya/ /grub pa'i skyes bu gcig nyid kho na ya/ /ngo mtshar spyod pa'ang rdzu 'phrul ljags ldan pas/ /bskal brgya'i bar du brjod par mi nus mod/ /'on kyang bla ma'i gsung las 'byung bzhin bra/ /de la kho bo cag gi bla ma dam pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po zhes bya ba'i zhal snga nas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa dang*/ gsung dbyangs yan lag rgya mtsho la skad cig re re bzhin yang 'jug par mdzad pa'i 'phrin las can yin pa'i phyir/ dam pa'i chos kyi bka' ji tsam mnga' ba'i tshad gzung bar ni ga la spyod/ 'on kyang rje nyid kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma grub chen zhi ba'i zhal snga nas/ byin rlabs kyi bka' babs bdun dang ldan par grags shing*/ de nyid kyi gdams pa ma lus pa yang rje nyid kyis legs par gsan pa yin no/ /de la bka' babs dang po na/ phyag rgya chen po'i gdams ngag yin te/ de yang slob dpon chen po bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin zhes bya ba yul o ḍi bi shar 'khrungs/ rigs ni bram ze/ gzhon nu nas rig byed yan lag dang bcas pa dang*/ rig pa'i gnas bco brgyad brtag pa brgyad la sogs pa thams cad la mkhas par gyur/ bram ze'i khye'u lnga brgya la gsang tshig klog par byed cing yod pa las/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma chang 'tshong ma'i gzugs kyis 'ongs nas/ slob dpon la don dam ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rnam pa myos byed du snang ba dag yang dang yang du stsal bas/ rnam par rtog pa med par gsol ba na/ nang du ting nge 'dzin mchog brnyes kyang*/

bram ze'i rigs nyams par byas zhes grags pa ngan pa byung*/ der bram ze rnams kyis dma' dbab par 'dod pa la/ slob dpon ni nang gi rnal 'byor gyi mthus nus pa rnyed pa yin pas/ bram ze rnams la chang skyug pa'i sbyor ba mdzad/ rdo chen po rgya mtsho'i steng du 'phangs te/ gal te ngas chang 'thungs na rdo 'di bying bar gyur cig ci ste khyed rnams kyis 'thungs la/ ngas ma 'thungs na 'phyo bar gyur cig ces gsungs pas/ chu'i steng du 'phyo bar gyur to/ /der bram ze rnams nus pas tshar bcad yul dbus su song ste/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung*/ rim gyis dge slong sde snod gsum pa ches mchog tu gyur to/ /slob dpon 'di'i mkhan po na/ gnas brtan nag po zhes bya ba yin/ de'i mkhan po btsun pa rta skad ces bya/ de'i yang mkhan po nyer sbas yin zhes bla ma gsung yang mkhan brgyud rnying pa 'di dag brtag par dka'o/ bod kyi sdom rgyun la ni sras sgra gcan 'dzin gyi dngos kyi slob ma yin par grags na'ang*/ dpyad pa med par bzhag na legs so/ /de nas nā lan+d+ra yi mkhan por gyur/ bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad cing*/ theg pa chen po'i mdo sde ches dar rgyas su gyur pa yang*/ slob dpon 'di'i dus yin par grags/ de nas rig pa brtul shugs kyi spyod pa bya bar dgongs te/ thugs mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin las ma g.yos bzhin du yul sna tshogs su rgyu ba na mthar gyis lho phyogs ma ra ha ṭa zhes bya bar bdag nyid kyi rgyud grol bar byed pa zhing gi rnal 'byor ma mda' mkhan gyi bu mo'i tshul can zhig gzigs te/ de'i mda' srong ba la sogs pas kyang*/ gnas lugs kyi don brda thabs kyis mtshon/ ngo sprad pa bzhin du gyur te/ chos nyid mngon sum du gzigs shing*/ mda' mkhan gyi bu mo de nyid phyag rgyar khrid nas/ yul sna tshogs su spyod cing mda' bzo ba'i bya ba mdzad/

ye shes gong nas gong du 'phel bas/ mtshan ya sa ra ha ste/ mda' bsnun zhes grags/ sngon dge 'dun thams cad kyi gnas brtan yin pas ha cang yang ma rigs te/ rgyal po la sogs pa skye bo mtha' yas pa zhig gis blta bar 'ongs shing*/ 'phyas pas/ slob dpon mda' srong bzhin du/ kyai lags nga ni bram ze ste/ /smin mkhan mo dang lhan cig spyod/ /rigs dang rigs min ngas ma mthong*/ /dge slong mgo breg brtul zhugs 'dzin/ /chung mar bcas te lhan cig rgyu/ /chags dang chags bral dbyer yod min/ /mi gtsang 'dir ni rnam rtog ste/ 'di lta gzhan gyis mi shes so/ /sbrul gdug lta bu'i skye bo na/ /zhes sogs do ha rdo rje'i glu mang du blangs pas/ rgyal po la sogs pa stong phrag lnga ni gnas lugs kyi don mngon sum du mthong*/ lus kyang rig pa 'dzin par gyur nas/ rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la 'gro zhing*/ mthar gyis mi snang bar gyur skad/ gzhan yang phyag rgya chen po sems rnal du mtshon pa ni brgya stong du ma zhig byung bas/ phyogs thams cad du grags pas khyab par gyur/ 'gro ba mang po'i don mdzad nas sku lus de nyid kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan du bzhud pa yin gsung*/ 'di ni bod rnams dang mthun par byas pa yin/ phyis sangs rgyas thod pa'i zin bris rgya dpe 'thor ba gcig na/ bar du rab tu byung ba'i skor de med cing*/ bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin dang*/ gnas brtan sgra gcan 'dzin tha dad par 'dod pa'ang snang*/ mi nyag lo tsā ba'ang de bzhin 'dod par mngon te de ngos mi 'thad rgyu'ang med do/ /de'i slob ma ni slob dpon klu sgrub yin te/ de yang lho phyogs bai dar+bhar sku 'khrungs/ rigs ni bram ze'o/ /btsas pa na ltas mkhan rnams kyis dge slong brgya/ bram ze brgya/ skye bo phal pa brgya rnams la ston mo drangs na/ rim pas lo bdun/ zla ba bdun/ zhag bdun 'tsho/ de las lhag pa'i thabs med zer pha mas kyang de bzhin byas/

dus de rnams rdzogs su nye ba na/ g.yog dang bcas yul gzhan du 'khyam du btang bas/ mthar nā lan+d+rar sleb/ mkhan po sgra gcan 'dzin gyis tshe dpag med kyi rig sngags bzlar bcug pas/ legs par 'tsho thub/ der rab tu byung nas/ theg pa che chung gi sde snod mtha' dag dang*/ rig pa'i gnas su gyur pa gang yang mi mkhyen pa med par byas so/ /de nas rma bya chen mo dang*/ ku ru kul+le dang*/ gnod sbyin mo dgu dang*/ nag po chen po rnams bsgrubs pas/ ri lu mig sman ral gri rkang mgyogs bcud len gter la sogs pa dngos grub mang po dang*/ tshar gcod pa dang*/ slar gso ba la sogs pa'i nus pa thams cad grub bo/ /gnod sbyin dang klu la sogs pa mi ma yin thams cad mngag gzhug tu song*/ khyad par bcud len grub pas rdo rje'i skur gyur/ rdzu 'phrul dang mngon shes chen por gyur skad/ nag po chen po'i rig sngags grub nas/ dha n+ya ka ṭa ka'i gling na/ nag po chen po'i rgyud bzhugs pa spyan 'dren par dgongs/ gling der mi g.yo ba la brten te sgyu ma bsgrubs nas/ sgyu mas mkha' 'gro ma rnams mgo 'khor ba'i bar la/ lha mo nag mo dang*/ nag po chen po'i rgyud brgyad de phyag gnyis gnyis pa nas phyag bco brgyad kyi bar gyi rgyud dang*/ ku ru kul+le'i rtog pa la sogs pa spyan drangs/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams la zhal gyi gdams pa thob/ sgrub thabs mi gcig pa brgya drug cu spyan drangs zer/ ral gri dngul chu sogs thun mong gi dngos grub brgyad char la rigs mi gcig pa mtha' yas pa bsgrubs so/ /dge 'dun la 'tsho ba sbyar ba'i lo rgyus na/ mkhan po sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma bsgrub cing bzhugs/ klu sgrub mkhan por byon nas dge 'dun lnga brgya la lung 'bogs pa'i bya ba sogs mdzad cing yod pa na/ mu ge lo bcu gnyis su byung bas/ ma ga dha'i yul rnams stongs pa tsam byung ba na/

sems can gyi las su gzigs nas/ slob dpon gyis gser 'gyur gyi rtsi mdzad de/ gser rnams yul thag ring po mu ge med pa rnams su 'bru dang bsgyur nas/ dge 'dun rnams 'tsho bas mi brel bar byas/ slob dpon sgra gcan 'dzin sgrub pa thon pa na/ yul rnams stongs par gzigs nas/ rgyu mtshan dris pas/ slob dpon gyi sgrub pa'i bar chad du gyur dogs zhu bar ma nus/ mu ge byung nas lo bcu gnyis lon zhus pas/ slob dpon na re/ ma legs zas kyi char 'bebs pa'i nus pa'ang nga la yod pa la/ khyod sems can la snying rje chung*/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang 'gal/ da ni de'i sdig sbyong la gtsug lag khang brgya rtsa brgyad/ lha khang stong*/ mchod rten khri phrag bzhengs dgos gsung*/ de dge slong gcig kho nas 'grub dka' bar gzigs nas/ yo byad gnod sbyin dzam+bha la las nor bslangs/ las grogs klu rnams la 'tshol dgos pas/ re zhig klu rnams dad par byed dgos dgongs te/ ku ru kul+le'i rig sngags kyis klu'i rgyal po 'jog po'i bu mo 'khor dang bcas pa bkug pas/ chos gsung ba'i tshogs su mi'i bu mo'i rnam pa gnyis 'khor mang po dang bcas byung bas/ dpag tshad tsam tsan+dan sa mchog gi dris khyab bo/ /yang de song ba na dri de sangs 'gro/ de 'dra lan mang du byung*/ der ci yin zhes dri ba ltar mdzad pas/ nged klu 'jaug po'i bu mo yin/ mi'i grib ma srung ba la tsan+dan sa mchog gis lus la byugs pa yin zer/ 'o na tsan+dan de la sgrol ma'i sku bzheng bar 'dod pas tsan+dan yang sbyin dgos/ kho bos gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i las grogs kyang byed dgos gsungs pas/ pha la bzlas nas 'ong zer ba/ de'i nang par de gnyis na re/ klu'i rgyal po'i mchid nas slob dpon nyid klu yul du phebs na bka' bzhin byed/ gzhan sgrub mi nus zer/ de nas sher phyin 'bum pa spyan 'dren pa sogs klu dang mi'i don rgya chen po gzigs nas/

re shig klu'i yul du byon no/ /lo rgyus kha cig las/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung dang gser thub la sogs pa'i zhal mthong ba'i dge slong yin zer ba/ lus gzhan pas che ba mang pos gzigs zer te che ba tsam yin no/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i bstan pa 'di'i dgra bcom pa mang po klu rnams kyi mchod gnas su 'dug pa rnams na re/ nged rnams ni dgra bcom pa yin la/ khyod dug gsum dang bcas pa'i mi zhig 'dir 'ongs pa la klu'i dug gis gnod pa mi 'ong ba'i rgyu ci yin 'dri ba la/ ngas ni rma bya chen mo'i rig sngags grub pa yin gsungs/ yang lo rgyus 'ga' las/ de rnams la rgyal ba'i bka' las ni chos thams cad ngo bos grub pa med par gsungs la/ sa'i steng gi dge slong shas che ba rnams na/ de las bzlog ste smra na/ khyed rnams kyis ji ltar rtogs zhes dris pas/ chos rnams kyi rang bzhin ni khyed kyi ltar yin/ phyis dmigs pa'i lta ba can gyi nyan thos 'ba' zhig 'byung bar sangs rgyas kyis lung bstan gsung skad de/ dbu ma pa rnams kyis bcos pa min na rung ngo*/ /de nas klu rnams la chos gsungs shing yun ring por bzhugs/ sher phyin rgyas pa dang*/ gzungs dang rtog pa'i rigs du ma spyan drangs/ 'bum gyi zhabs nas bag tsam klus ma bskur ba yin yang zer/ dam pa'i chos la dgra lan gsum byung ba'i tshe ma tshang ba yin yang zer te phyi ma dag gsung*/ 'bum rgya nag pa'i zhabs kyi le'u gsum ni nyi khri nas drangs pa'o/ /de nas sa steng du byon/ rig tshogs la sogs pa'i bstan bcos kyang mang du brtsams/ dge slong bde byed la sogs pa theg pa chen po la sdang ba thams cad rtsod pas sun phyung*/ lar nyan thos sen dha pas brtsams pa'i rtog ge theg chen la rtsod pa'i gzhung mang po byung ba de dag gi dpe thams cad bsdus nas sa 'og tu sbas so/ /yang phyi zhig na lho phyogs dza ṭa saṃ gha ra/

ral pa 'jaums pa zer ba'i gnas der/ mu stegs kyi rgol ba 'dus pa lnga brgya tsam dang brtsad nas tshar bcad de thams cad bstan pa la bcug go /de dag gi skabs su lha khang dang mchod rten yang grub/ slob dpon 'dis bzhengs pa'i mchod rten gyis phyogs thams cad khyab yod gsung*/ de ltar theg chen gyi bstan pa nyi ma ltar mdzad/ dril bu brag dang byang phyogs dhing ko ṭa sogs ri mang po gser du bsgyur bar bzhed pa la/ rje btsun ma sgrol mas ma 'ongs pa na rtsod par 'gyur gsungs pas bzlog 'on kyang gser gyi 'byung khungs mang po byung*/ rdo rnams gser mdog tu gyur pa tsam yod gsung*/ de nas lam gcig na byis pa mang po rtse ba la gcig rgyal por 'gyur bar lung bstan nas/ byang sgra mi snyan du bzhud/ gling gzhan dang mi ma yin gyi gnas su lo bcu gnyis tsam song*/ slar 'dzam bu gling du phebs tsam na sngar gyi byis pa de/ rgyal por gyur pa bde spyod ces bya bar song*/ slob dpon la gus pas mchod/ rgyal po'ang slob dpon gyi gdams pa la brten nas bcud len dang gnod sbyin gyi mngag gzhug grub/ dge 'dun bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang lnga brgya bzhengs so/ /phyis dpal gyi rir lo nyis brgya tsam gnod sbyin mo rnams kyi 'khor dang bcas te/ sngags kyi spyod pas bzhugs/ mtshan bzang po so gnyis kyang sku la 'grub/ phyis dbu sbyin par btang ba'i rkyen gyis lo phyed lo'i lo drug brgyar bdun cu don gcig gis ma tshang skad de/ de yang rgyal po bde spyod kyi bu chung ngu su shak+ta/ rgyal bu rab nus sam/ rgyal bu nus ldan yang zer te de rgyal srid la dga' bas la ma na re/ yab slob dpon dang sku tshe mnyam par byin gyis rlabs 'dug slob dpon rdo rje'i sku yin pas 'grong pa med/ rgyal po'i sras po snga ma rnams kyang rgyal srid ma thob pa 'das shing*/ /bu dang tsha bo'i bar yang 'das zer bas/

shin tu yid mi dga' ba la/ ma na re/ 'o na thabs yod/ slob dpon byang chub sems dpa' yin pas dbu bslangs na ster bas/ slob dpon 'das pa'i tshe yab kyang 'da' bas khyod la rgyal srid 'byung zer/ rgyal bus dpal gyi rir phyin dbu bslangs pas/ mtshon chas ma chod par sngon rtswa sngon pos srog chags kyi ske bcad pa'i las gzigs nas/ ku shas bcad nas gnang*/ nga ni 'di nas bde ba can du 'gro/ phyin nas lus 'di la yang 'jug par 'gyur/ zhes sgra byung*/ der sa g.yos/ mu ge lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du byung skad/ rgyal bus slob dpon bcud len grub pas/ slar 'grig gi dogs nas dbu dpag tshad mang pos chod pa'i sar khyer/ der gnod sbyin mos phrogs/ dbu pha bong gi khar bzhag pas pha bong gas pa'i sa der 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs lha lnga'i rdo sku rang byon du byon/ dbu dang sku lus gnyis la yon bdag gnod sbyin mos so sor lha khang brtsigs/ de gnyis kyi bar du sngon dpag tshad bzhi tsam yod snang ba/ da ltar rgyang grags gcig kyang bar mi snang gsung*/ de ni bdag gi bla mas kyang mjal te/ rdo'i rtsig pa rnams 'brel te brag lta bur song pa'i lha khang cho 'phrul dang*/ gnyan cha che ba/ sgo ni med/ dkar khung nas bltas pa la/ gnyis ka'ang khri'i steng na rdo sku'i dum bu 'dra ba re 'dug gsung*/ de'i slob ma grub chen shā bā ri yin te/ shar phyogs na gar mkhan ming sring gsum gyis/ klu sgrub bha ga lar bzhugs pa la rol mo phul bas/ nang du bos skal ba dang ldan par mkhyen nas/ byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin chen kyi sku gcig bstan pas ngas kyang 'di mthong ba cig zhu zer/ me long zhig bstan pas kho rang dmyal ba na me la 'tshed pa mthong*/ shin tu bred nas 'di las thar ba'i thabs gcig kyang zhu byas pas/ bde mchog tu dbang bskur/ bsgoms pas snying po'i don mngon du gyur/ byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin chen gyi zhal mthong*/

zung 'jug grub nas khyod lho phyogs kyi ri la ri dwags bshor ba ltar gyis la sems can gyi don gyis gsung*/ lcam gnyis la/ lo gi dang*/ gu ni zer ba/ phyis mkha' 'gro ma pad+ma warti dang*/ dzñā na warti yin ces phyag chen brda skor ba dang*/ do ha 'chad mkhan bod rnams zer te/ lcam gnyis dang lhan cig lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la bzhugs/ rngon pa'i bya ba byed pa ltar mdzad do/ /rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang brnyes pas/ grub chen shā bā ri pa zhes grags/ ri dwags bshor ba la sogs pa 'di dag ni 'phags pa'i spyod pa dang*/ zung 'jug gi spyod pa yin gya/ gzhan rtogs pa mtho yang mi rung ba yin no/ slob dpon 'di la sa ra ha chung ba zer/ de'i slob ma ni lū yi pa ste/ de'i slob ma ḍeṃ gi pa/ de'i slob ma til lo pa/ de'i slob ma nā ro pa/ de'i slob ma ḍoṃ bhi pa chung ba/ de'i slob ma ku sa la bha da/ 'di yang brgyud pa'i lugs gcig yin/ lū yi pa/ dā ri ka pa/ an+tar pa/ til lo pa nas brgyud pa'ang yod/ de la lū yi pa na/ nub phyogs o rgyan gyi rgyal po'i yig mkhan kun tu dge ba zhes bya ba zhigalan cig grub thob sa ra ha chung ba shā bā ri pa de do ha glur len pa dang mjal/ dbang bskur dang gdams ngag gnang*/ de bsgom zhing yig mkhan yang byed cing yod pa la/ res cig dur khrod du phyin pas/ mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs gral du sleb/ skye ba bdun pa zhig gi sha 'gyed pa'i lag bde ba yang byas/ rdo rje phag mos sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur zhing*/ rkang pa brkyang pa spangs nas su/ /'khor ba'i mngag gzhug dor nas kyang*/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /yang dang yang du bskul bar bya/ /zhes gdams pas/ g.yeng ba med par bsgom dgos par shes te/ sngar gyi las byas na g.yeng bas 'khyer/ shing tog sogs la'ang 'bad rtsol dgos/ bsod snyoms kyang chags sdang skye/ 'tsho ba gang las bsgrub dgos dgongs rigs gsangs nas/

shar phyogs bhang ga lar song*/ gang gā'i 'gram na nya'i rgyu lto ri ltar spungs pa gzigs pas/ der nya lto gsol zhing lo bcu gnyis bsgoms pas/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob/ o ḍi bi sha'i rgyal po dang*/ blon po sogs 'dul ba'i dus yin par mkhyen nas/ rgyal po de la lho phyogs kyi rgyal po zhig mjal du byung ba la/ skyed mos tshal du khri sogs bshams/ lam srang thams cad mchod rdzas sna tshogs kyis bkang*/ rgyal po rang gi sngon du shis brjod kyi bram ze rnams 'ongs pas/ khri'i steng na mi sngon po nyi lhag kyis khyer ba skra 'dzings pa zhig nyal nas 'dug pa la/ khyod longs byas pas lan med/ bram ze sum cus 'then pas g.yo 'gul ma byung*/ der bram ze rnams rang stobs med pa la gad mo shor bas/ slob dpon na re/ ma lus sa 'di ji tsam yin te 'jig rten gsum 'di ji tsam yin/ de cha nyid kyis gcig ni mi bdag gzhan ni de yi g.yog yin na/ blo bzang de yang gzhan gyi dam pa'i spyod la bzhad gad byed pa na/ e ma 'khor ba ngo mtshar re che 'di la smra mang ci zhig dgos gsung*/ de rgyal po la brjod pas/ de choms shig zer/ dmag rnams 'ongs pas slob dpon gyis ha ha hi hi zhes bzhad pas/ dmag mi thams cad rengs/ der gcig gis grub thob tu shes nas gus pa byas pas rengs pa las grol/ des bstan te gzhan kun kyang grol/ rgyal po ngo mtshar skyes nas 'ongs te/ khyod su yin byas pas/ khyod kyang su yin gsung*/ nga rgyal po yin byas pas/ nga yang rgyal po yin gsung*/ khyod la rgyal po'i yo byad mi 'dug byas pas/ sa gzhi mal stan chen po yin te byin pa'i stan bting lag ngar glo stan 'bol ba 'khril/ zla ba'i 'od zer sgron me rab gsal bsil yab rjes su mthun pa'i rlung*/ rgya chen nam mkha'i bla re chags bral steng pa'i bud med la spyod de/ a re rgyal ltar srid na 'jigs med bder nyal rnal 'byor rgyal po yin/

byas pas rgyal po dang*/ rgyal blon gnyis la bde mchog tu dbang bskur/ gdams pa gnang*/ dpal mngon rtogs kyang mdzad/ rgyal po la khyod lho phyogs ku ma ra k+ṣe tra na/ smad 'tshong ma 'di lta bu yod pas de'i g.yog gyis gsung*/ blon po bram ze la khyod shar phyogs pa [na ]bkan na ga ra na chang 'tshong ma 'di lta bu zhig yod pas de'i g.yog gyis khyed gnyis kyis de ltar na lo bcu gnyis nas mchog gi dngos grub thob gsung*/ de gnyis kyis kyang srid spangs nas de bzhin byas/ rgyal pos smad 'tshong ma'i g.yog byas te/ der 'ongs pa'i skyes pa rnams kyi rkang pa bkru ba sogs byed cing ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pas/ lan gcig nam phyed na skyes pa gcig gis ldog phyin pas/ khol po'i spyil po na me 'bar bar mthong*/ bltas pas/ de'i lus kyi 'od du 'dugagrub pa thob par shes/ de dang smad 'tshong mas kyang bzod par gsol/ der slob dpon gyis yul der rdo rje theg pa rgya cher bshad/ lan gcig dril bsgrags te tshogs kyi 'khor lo mdzad/ 'khor bud med stong phrag bcu drug dang bcas pa thams cad mkha' la gshegs shing*/ mchog gi dngos grub thob bo/ /sngar gyi skyes pa des gsol ba btab pas/ grong khyer gyi shar phyogs na rdo ring zhig yod/ de'i steng na glang po che'i gzugs kha shar bstan cig yod/ lo re la yungs kar gyi tshad re chugs kyin yod nam kha nub tu bstan pa na grub pa thob par lung bstan/ grub thob dā ri ka pa'am dā ri pa ste smad 'tshong ma'i g.yog ces bya ba yin no/ /blaun pos kyang chang 'tshong ma'i g.yog byas pa la 'bras sbru ba'i rkyen gyis rang sems kyi gnas lugs mngon sum du mthong*/ der ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang du bag tsam zhig 'byams pa'i skabs/ 'bras rnams phug ron gyis zos pas/ chang 'tshong mas 'thabs/ yang dus gzhan zhig na/ rdo rje'i glu blangs pas/ skye bo thams cad kyis grub pa thob par shes/

rdo rje theg pa mang du bshad pas/ skye bo dpag tu med pa yang grol lo/ /'bras brdung ba'i ḍeṅgi la sems zin pas ḍeṅgi bar grags so/ /yang shā bā ri'i slob ma dus phyis byung ba na/ mnga' bdag chen po mai tri pa ste/ mtshan ni mai tri gup+ta'o/ /de yang bram ze mu stegs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta/ phyis nā ro pa dang mjal nas nang par gyur te/ dbang dang gdams ngag zhus/ nā lan+d+rar rab tu byung ste rat+na ā ka ra shan+ti pa sogs mkhas grub kyi bla ma mang por bsten pas paṇa chen du song nas/ bi kra ma la shī la rnam gnon tshul gyi gtsug lag khang du bzhugs/ paṇ+ḍi ta'i bya ba dang sgrub pa spel mar mdzad cing yod pa las/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhal gzigs shing*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi grogs su 'gro ba'i dus yin par mkhyen nas/ nang gi kun tu spyod pa gsang zhing spyod pa yin pa las/ dge tshul zhig gis slob dpon bud med dang lhan cig chang gsol ba mthong nas/ tshogs su rgol du byung ba la/ slob dpon gyis 'o ma skyugs dge tshul de rang la chang skyug pa'i sbyor ba byas pas/ chang skyugs re zhig gleng ba med/ yang lan cig dge bskos la sogs pas rig nas brdzir 'ongs pa na/ chang 'o mar bsgyur bud med mi snang bar byas sam dril bur bsgyur zer ba'ang yod/ yang phyis lan cig 'jabs nas brdzis pas/ sngags kyis bsgyur long ma byung bas/ dge 'dun gyis gnas dbyung byas/ chu bo gaṅgā la lpags gdan bting nas bzhud/ de dus dge bskos jo bo rje yin skad/ de'i sgrib sbyong la mnga' bdag rang la chos gsan pa dang*/ bod du byon yang zer/ sā tsha 'chag med mdzad kyang zer/ der nus pa ni dpag tu med pa brnyes kyang*/ de kho na nyid cung zad ma rtogs pa la/ yi dam gyi lung bstan byung nas/ dpal gyi ri la shā bā ri pa 'tshol du bzhud pa/ lho phyogs kyi lam du rgyal bu sa ka ra dang 'phrad/ de dang lhan cig dpal gyi rir phyin pas/

de dang nye ba'i mi rnams na re/ shā bā ri pa sngon gyi grub thob yin/ da lta ga la rnyed zer yang*/ rtse gcig tu gsol ba btab pas/ zla ba drug na mjal te/ shā bā ri'i dbu'i ral pa bshig pas/ sro shig nyil gyi byung ba/ yum gnyis kyis gsol bar 'dug pas mai tri ba cung zad thugs ma dad/ rgyal bu des zhabs la phyag byas pas/ a ya dza ra wa la hu gsungs pas de nyid du grol zhing 'ja' lus su gyur pas thugs dad pa 'khrungs/ yang btsun mo gnyis kyis phag dang ri dwags dang rma bya gsod pa gzigs pas cung zad ma dad pa se gol togs pas/ der mi snang bar gyur/ 'on kyang dbang bskur zhing gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pas gnas lugs gzigs pa'i ye shes skyes/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mtha' yas pa'i gtso bor gyur/ da ni ral gri la sogs pa grub pa brgyad bsgrubs nas/ tshe bskal par gnas pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa bya snyam rdzas bsgrubs pas grub pa'i ltas byung ba na/ shā bā ris sdigs 'dzub mdzad pas thal bar song*/ da khyod sgyu ma des ci bya gnas lugs kyi don rgya cher shod ces gsung ba bzhin/ slar yul dbus su byon no/ /bod rnams de rjes shān+ti pa dang rtsod pa byas pa sogs kyi lo rgyus 'chad pa ni don la yang mi rigs par snang zhing*/ 'phags pa'i yul na kha skad tsam yang med gsung*/ bod na de ltar grags zhus pas/ bhoṭ+ṭa swa na bāk+t+yasā ma ya tsho ḍe ka sid+dhi sā dha ka kyā/ zhes gsungs te bod pa khyi'i lab dam tshig spangs pa'i grub thob dang sgrub pa po gang zhes pa'o/ /des na de ni bod blun po rnams kyi brdzun phal ka sgrigs su shes par bya'o/ /slob dpon 'dis yul dbus su yid la mi byed pa gsungs pas/ 'ga' zhig yid ma ches pa la/ gzhung gi khungs grub rnying gi skor rgya cher gsungs/ rgyud kyi dgongs pa min zer ba dgyes rdor dang 'dus pa gtso bor gyur pa'i lung gis bsgrubs su las thob dris pa la/

dbang nges bstan brtsams te ri khrod pa'i man ngag nyams su myong bar bstan zhes bod rnams zer/ dur khrod bsil ba tshal du grong 'jug gi tshul mang po bstan/ ji ltar bzhed pa thams cad nag po chen po bsgrubs pas/ dpag tshad brgya phrag mang po'i pha rol nas brtan g.yo'i dngos po nam mkha' las khyer 'ongs te/ ma la ba'i rgyal po'i bu mo nam mkha' las khyer 'ongs pa/ phyis mkha' 'gro gaṃ ga dha ra zhes par grags/ phal cher ni shar phyogs ku sa la'i nags su gtso bor bzhugs/ mkha' 'gro lce spyang du sprul nas gtor ma len pa dang*/ lta stangs grub pa dang*/ sku lus gzugs sna tshogs su sprul pa sogs ngo mtshar dpag tu med pa mnga'/ sngon shā bā ri pa la ma dad pa gnyis po des sku lus gnas ma gyur/ dgung lo bdun cu tsam na sku 'das te/ bar dor phyag rgya chen po mchog 'grub bo/ /jo bo nā ro pa sku 'das pa tsam na/ slob dpon 'di'i 'gro don 'go tshugs pa yin/ nā ro pa tsam rang gi snyan grags dang slob ma 'du 'tshogs ni bag tsam ma byung mod/ thog mnyam la gzhan phan che shos yin/ 'phags yul rang du de dus rjes 'brang mang yang phyis mang rgyu med/ bal po dang bod sogs byang phyogs na ches dar bar gyur to/ /mai tri pa'i slob ma la/ sngar gyi bod rnying pa rnams/ che bzha/ 'bring bdun/ chung ba bcu zer/ 'bring dang chung gi ngos 'dzin grangs nges rgya gar ba la ma grags/ spyir rnal 'byor pa'i slob ma mkhas pa dang nus pa thob pa mang ngo*/ /che ba bzhi po de kun nas grags pa yin/ lhan skyes rdo rje/ stong nyid ting 'dzin/ rā ma pā la/ badz+ra pā ṇi'o/ /dang po la na ṭe ga na zer/ de kho na nyid bcu pa'i 'grel pa dang gnas pa bsdus pa mdzad/ gnyis pa de ba ā ka ra tsan+d+ra zer/ shes rab ye shes gsal ba'i gzhung brtsams/ bzhi pa rgya gar phyag na ru grags pa de yin rdo rje'i tshig bsdus mdzad/ de gsum sku lus kyi rig 'dzin ma thob/

'dir rā ma pā la ste dga' ba skyong ngam/ dga' byed skyong la brgyud pa ste dbang nges bstan gyi 'grel pa mdzad mkhan de yin no/ /rig ma nus pa thob pa rnal 'byor ma rin chen lha mo mnga' bdag nyid dang mkhyen rtogs mnyam par grags/ gad+ga dha ri phyed kyi go 'phang can yin par grags so/ /de ni rigs rgyal rigs lho phyogs kar+ṇa ṭa kar 'khrungs/ chung ngu nas rig pa'i gnas mang po mkhyen/ mnga' bdag mai tri pa lo bcu gnyis su bsten/ mai tri pa sku gshegs nas/ mchod rten dpal yon can du lo gsum bla ma'i mya ngan byed cing gtam yang mi gsung*/ rtse gcig tu sgrub pa mdzad cing bzhugs/ de nas snying po'i don thams cad mngon du gyur nas/ lho phyogs su sems can gyi don mdzad cing bzhugs/ nag po chen pos ral gri'i dngos grub byin te/ sku lus de nyid ma spangs par sa 'og tu dpal gyi sgor bzhud nas/ lha ma yin gyi gnas na da lta yang bzhugs zer/ de la ni slob dpon ku sa la bha dra chung ba dang*/ a si ta gha nas kyang phyag rgya chen po'i gdams ngag rnams zhus so/ khyad par ye shes bshes gnyen gyis gsan no/ /slob dpon chen po zhi ba'i brgyud 'dzin rnams mai tri nyid la bsngags pa che/ a ma na si la mchog dman gyi dbye ba bag tsam mdzad do/ /rin po che 'byung khungs lta bu'i gtam las/ phyag rgya chen po'i brgyud pa'i skabs te dang po'o/ / bka' babs gnyis pa ni gtum mo yin te/ de yang snga rol nas kyang gtum mo'i gdams pa med pa ni ga la yin/ bi rū bas kyang bla ma gzhan la ma gsan par ma nges mod/ 'di pa'i lugs kyis re zhig slob dpon bi rū bas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la mngon sum du zhus pa yin no/ /slob dpon de ni nā lan+d+ra'i paṇ+ḍi ta dge slong zhig yin pa las/ der chang yang gsol ba dang*/ bud med dang lhan cig spyod pas dge 'dun gyis gnas nas phyung*/ de nas gaṅgā'i 'gram du gru pa la gru gtong dgos byas pas/

gla dgos zer ba la gla ster rgyu med de gaṅgā la sdig 'dzub bstan pas/ gaṅgā gyen du bzlog nas pha rol tu song*/ de nas o ḍi shar chang 'tshong ma gcig la chang nyo byas pas rin dgos zer/ nyi grib mtshams la ri mo byas te 'di las ma 'das gong du sbyin byas nas/ nyi ma la mdzub mo bstan nas btod la mnan te chang gsol/ de nas gtong ma 'dod de dbyug tshod dang mel tsho thams cad 'chugs/ rnal 'byor pas nus pa bstan par shes te/ rgyal pos chang rin byin nas btang bar zhus pas/ zhag gsum gyi tho rangs su song yang zer/ de nas tri liṅga'i rgyal po'i mchod gnas byas/ mu stegs kyi mchod pa kun gyi phud zos/ phyag mi 'tshal bas/ rgyal po sogs kyis rgol ba la/ slob dpon gyis phyag byas pas mu stegs kyi lha thams cad gas/ lha'i gtso bo ni bi shwa nā tha bya ba 'j-ig sdes bzhengs pa ling ga gdong bzhis mtshan pa gcig yod pa de bzhi tshal du gas yod gsung*/ de nas ḍā ki nī pa ṭar mu stegs pa'i tshogs khang du byon/ der mi phal pa su byung ba la tri shu la rang zug ste shi ba'i sha la phra men ma rnams tshogs byed pa yin pa la/ slob dpon gyis thal mo brdabs pas tri shu la chagatsan+ḍi ka'i rdo sku rang byung gul gul byed pa la/ mgo lcag bsnun pas mgo brang na mar sleb/ rna ba ya gar lus pas krong ngai ba da lta'ang 'dug gsung*/ phyin chad sems can la gnod pa mi byed par bka' bsgos/ ḍā ki nī pa ṭa zhes pa 'di bod rnams lho phyogs yin zer na'ang*/ yod ni shar phyogs na yod par gda'o/ /yang lha mo 'di 'dul ba po go rak+ṣa yin zer ba'ang yod/ de nas sau raṣ+tar byon nas so ba nā tha zhes bya ba/ lha dbang phyug chen po'i rdo sku rang byung gcig yod/ cho 'phrul shin tu che/ de la sdigs 'dzub bstan kyang 'gas su ma 'dod nas/ ci yin brtags pas/ steng na spyan ras gzigs kyi sku zhig snang skad/

kha cig 'od zer can ma'i sku yin nam yang zer/ de bsal bas dngos su gzugs bstan nas bka' bzhin byed par zhus pa la/ slob dpon gyis khyod kyi mchod gnas su dge 'dun brgya rtsa zhig mchod cigasrog bcad pa'i mchod pa ma len/ phud kyis nga'i sku la mchod pa gyis gsung*/ kho na re/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa myur du 'j-ig la/ nga la mchod pa rtag tu 'ong mod/ 'on kyang bstan pa nam gnas kyi bar dge 'dun mchod zer/ slob dpon rang rdo sku gser 'gyur rtsi phyag tu bsnam pa cig tu song zer/ re shig dngos su mi snang bar thal/ nyin re bzhin rdo sku'i phyag gi gser 'gyur rtsi de blangs te/ lcags zangs mang po la reg pa tsam gyis gser du 'gro bas/ de la brten te dge 'dun gyi 'tsho ba sbyor/ phyi zhig na dzo na gha ṭa'i rgyal po zhig gis/ gser srang khri phrag gnyis zhus nas/ da dung zhu snyam pa la rdo sku'i spar ba bsdams/ yang bram ze dbul po zhig gis sa the btsugs nas gsol ba btab pas/ gser 'gyur rtsi gnang*/ zhag bdun nas khyer shog gsung*/ des zhag gsum gyi bar du yo byad gser du ci 'gyur byas pas/ rgyal po'i mi gnyis byung nas len par brtsams pa la/ bram zes rdo sku'i phyag tu phul bas/ yang spar ba bsdams/ rgyal po'i mi gcig gis phyag la dbyug pa bsnun pas rang lag pa chad nas sha/ gcig gis lag pa chog byas pas kha lkugs/ rgyal po yang sems smyo byung nas 'das pas/ shin tu gnyan par grags/ da lta de na dge 'dun ni med/ nags tshal dgrod dka' ba cig gi dkyil na rdo sku smug nag zhal gdangs pa zil che ba cig yod gsung*/ yang bar skabs rgyal po rā ma pā la'i dus su rnal 'byor pa si ro pa zhes par mtshan btags nas kyang*/ yul dbus su 'gro ba'i don ci rigs mdzad/ zhabs bkrus pa'i khu ba rgyal po rā ma pā la'i glang po che bha nā da la blud nas g.yul 'thab pas kla klo'i rgyal po brgyad tsam thul/

dus phyis shar phyogs gau ra'i yul du stag gzig gi rgyal po zhig gnyid sad pa'i rngas mgo na/ rnal 'byor pa zhig 'dug chu bo la bskur bas yang yang ldog me la bsregs pas kyang ma tshig mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnun kyang ma bsnad cing mtshon cha rnams chag dug khal drug gsol du bcug nyin zhag phrugs cig mi mang pos bsrungs pas/ slob dpon stobs dang mdangs rgyas par mthong nas/ grub pa thob par shes te/ su yin zhus pas/ bi rū pa yin zhes gsung*/ der yang skal ldan 'ga' la gdams ngag gnang ba dang*/ gus par bsten pa la bden tshig tsam brjod pas/ thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa mang du byung*/ bha ga lar zla ba bzhi tsam dngos su kun gyis mjal du rung bar bzhugs/ phyis gar gshegs cha med/ rgya nag tu dngos su byon pa'ang 'di skabs ka yin/ bi rū pa mi yul du lan gsum 'byon par grags pa/ gsum char sngar song ngo*/ /slob dpon 'di la shrī dharma pā la zer yang*/ gnas brtan dharma pā la zhes bya ba nā lan+d+ra'i mkhan po mdzad pa de dang mi gcig go /de'i slob ma ni o ḍi ya ṇar byung ba'i nag po bi rū pa yin te/ de ni bram ze'i rigs btsas tsam na bram ze ltas mkhan rnams kyis sdig pa bzhi byed par lung bstan skad/ ming ni nag po zhes bya'o/ /der lo bdun tsam na/ sdig pa bzhi po mi 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir/ yul gzhan du 'khyams su btang ba las/ dus yun ring mo 'das te ma bram ze mo lak+ṣ+mi zhes pa de yang khyim thab dang*/ gyos rgyug rnams shi bas/ yul gzhan du 'khyams shing song ba rigs nyams te/ shar phyogs o ḍi bi sha'i yul du chang 'tshong zhing yod pa las/ phyi zhig na bu yang o ḍi bi shar sleb/ ma'i khyim du phyin pa na/ phan tshun ma dang bu ngo ma shes pa'i skyon gyis ma dang 'dus/ rdzi'u nas chu 'dod pas skom 'thungs pa myos byed du 'dug khros te rdzi'u shod du 'phangs pas ba zhig la phog ste sha/

de gsang bar bsams te/ mtshan mo yang thog nas ce spyang gi bzar 'phangs pas/ srang ka na bram ze zhig rgyu ba'i mgo la phog bram ze shi /der the tshom zos nas gtam dris pas chang 'tshong ma de rang gi ma yin par shes/ de yang sngon lung bstan pa'i sdig pa bzhi na/ bram ze gsod pa/ ba glang gsod pa/ ma dang 'dus pa/ chang 'thung ba ste rig phyed nas bshad pa'i bram ze nyams byed kyi sdig par grags pa bcu drug gi nang nas bzhi po de yin la/ de rnams nub gcig la byung bas sdig pa de sbyang ba'i don du/ phyi nang gi gnas thams cad du song nas dris kyang gzhan yid ches pa ma byung*/ slob dpon dza lan+dha ra pa dang mjal/ rdo rje phag mo'i gdams ngag cig gnang ste/ des sdig pa 'byang gsung*/ de nas koṅku na'i yul du chu nang du mgrin pa man chad nub par byas nas/ zla ba drug tu bsgrubs pas/ rtags ci yang ma byung ste/ 'phreng ba bcad de chu la dor/ slob dpon la drir song bas/ da dung sgrubs shigadangos grub myur du 'ong gsung*/ der snga ma bzhin du bsgrubs pas/ zhag bdun song ba'i tho rangs/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mi'i bu mo'i rnam par byung ste/ aṣ+ta sai kha ṭa/ na ba sai dza la na/ kaṃ ā yi bu tra/ tuṃ hi koṅku na mā ra ṇa/ de yang rgya mtsho'i lag brgyad brgya dang*/ chu bo dgu brgya 'das te bu ga nas 'ongs/ koṅku'i yul du khyod 'chi bar byed dam zhes pa yin pa la/ tshig dang po gnyis 'dra ba la/ a yi mā ta badz+ra yo gi nā/ te ri sa ra ṇa/ yum rnal 'byor ma khyod la skyabs su mchir 'ongs zhes pa'o/ /de nyid du phyag spyi bor bzhag pas/ ting nge 'dzin mchog tu gyur pa thob cing*/ khyod kyi skye ba mang por las kyi 'brel ba yod pa ni bi rū pa yin pas/ de ma ra ha ṭa na yod kyi der song gsung*/ der yang bi rū pas rdo rje thod bcings phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob nas/ dur khrod rnams su brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas rgyu zhing gshegs so/

/rdo rje thod byas kyang zhwa chung sngon po gcig yod do/ /da lta yang sku lus ma spangs par o rgyan gyi gnas na bzhugs par grags/ bi rū pa che chung 'di gnyis gshin rje gshed dang*/ phag mo'i lam la brten nas grub pa brnyes par byed gsung*/ bi rū pa chung ba la bya dā li pas zhus te/ de ni sngon bya gsod pa'i rigs yin pa la/ lan cig ne tso zhig shing tog khar thogs nas nam mkha' la 'phur ba mthong ste/ der khyod ci zhig byed dris pa na/ phyogs 'di na grub thob bi rū pa bzhugs pas/ de la mchod pa byed du 'gro zhes zer bas des bsam pa/ dud 'gro 'di lta bu yang dge ba'i sems dang ldan na/ kho bo cag mir gyur pa dge ba byed pa lta smos kyang ci dgos snyam ste/ shing tog 'ga' zung de la bskur te/ khyod kyis 'di yang grub thob de la phul zhig ces byas so/ /ne tsos kyang rngon pa'i shing tog phul ba na/ bi rū pas de ma blangs te/ kwa ye ne tso/ phyin chad kyang sdig pa can de lta bu'i yo byad khur ma 'ong zhes gsung ngo*/ /de nas ne tso des shing tog slar kho rang la gtad/ de la khyod kyis ci'i phyir ma phul zhes dris pas/ grub thob de 'di ltar gsung zhes snga ma ltar bsnyad do/ /de nas shin tu 'gyod par gyur nas sdig pa bshags/ nags tshal de nyid du yang dang yang du 'khor zhing 'tshol du song ba na/ phyi zhig na mjal/ dbang bskur gdams pa yang gnang bas/ de nyid bsgom bzhin du rtse gcig tu 'dug pa na/ bya rngon pa'i bya ba la sems yengs te/ bla ma la zhus pas/ shin tu dgag dka' ba'i rnam rtog 'di bkag kyang ting nge 'dzin skye mi thub kya/ de bas na 'jim pa dang*/ zan dag la bya'i gzugs chos la/ de dag gi ske chod cing ting nge 'dzim sgoms shig ces gsungs/ des kyang de bzhin du byed cing bsgoms pas/ mthar gyi lo bcu gnyis na phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kyang thob cing*/

grong khyer rnams su bya sna tshogs gsod pa'i sprul pa ston/ sha yang gsol/ der mi rnams kyis rnal 'byor pa'i gzugs bzung nas/ sems can la gnod pa 'di lta bu byas so zhes 'phya bar byas pa na/ sngar bsad pa thams cad slar gsos/ de ltar lo bcu gnyis su bya rngon pa'i bya ba byed par sprul nas/ rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyad pa na/ mtshan yang grub thob bya dā li pa zhes grags te/ bya dā li pa ni bya rngon pa zhes bya ba yin no/ /des ku sa li bha dra la bshad de/ gtum mo'i brgyud pa lugs gcig go /yang bi rū pas ḍom+bi he ru ka la gdams te slob dpon de ni ko mkhan yin par bod na grags kyang*/ shar phyogs ti pu ri'i yul gyi rgyal po zhig yin gsung*/ der slob dpon bi rū pa byon te/ rgyal po de yang lhag par dad nas rjes su 'dzin par zhus pas dbang bskur zhing gdams pa yang gnang ngo*/ /rgyal pos kyang de nyid bsgom bzhin du 'dug pa na/ rim pa gnyis kyi rtogs pa yang rgya cher skyes pas/ spyod pa bya ba'i dus yin par mkhyen nas gsangs te spyod pa cung zad spyad pa na/ phyag rgya mo lung bstan pa byung ste/ g.yung mo'i rigs kyi bu mo pad+ma can du gyur pa zhiga'ajig rten pa'i mngon du bsten pas/ rgyal po'i rigs nyams zhes blaun po la sogs pa'i 'bangs rnams kyis rgyal srid las bton te phyir bskrad do/ /de nas rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyod cing*/ yul dang nags tshal rnams su rgyu ba na/ rgyal po ḍom+bi pa zhes grags so/ /de yang ḍom+bi zhes pa ni g.yung po ste/ grong khyer gyi phyi rol tu gnas pa/ nya dang bya dang ri dwags gsod cing za/ sha 'tshong du med/ glu gar byed/ rtsa ba 'bras bu 'tshong ba la sogs pa/ ngan pa'i las gcig tu ma nges pa spyod pa'i rigs ngan gyi khyad par zur ba zhig yin no/ slob dpon rang ḍom+bi min yang*/ btsun mo ḍim+bi nī yin pas ḍom+bi par thogs/

ḍom+bi zhes pa ni g.yung mo can zhes pa yin no/ /slob dpon 'di ni shin tu dbangapo rno bas/ sngon bi rū pas dbang bskur nas/ de bar du lo drug las ma lon skad/ de nas yul sna tshogs su spyod cing*/ ring zhig lon pa na sngar gyi yul der nad yams dang mu ge la sogs pa sna tshogs pas sdug bsngal bar gyur/ ltas mkhan rnams kyis brtsis pas/ rgyal po bsod nams can yul gzhan du bskrad pas yin par shes nas/ slar yang spyan drangs pa na/ slob dpon rig ma dang bcas pa stag mo grus ma la chibs/ dug sbrul phyag tu bsnams te byon pa na/ thams cad kyis rgyal po grub pa thob pa yin par shes/ zhabs la phyag btsal/ yul gyi gnod pa thams cad kyang zha/ yul mi skal ba dang ldan pa rnams kyis rjes su bzung bar zhus te/ gdams pa mtha' dag gis nye bar gdams pas/ der yang dngos grub thob pa dang*/ sgrub pa po mchog tu gyur pa mang du byung*/ de nas yul ra dha zhes pa'am phal skad du rar zhes bya ba'i rgyal po de na/ sangs rgyas pa'i bstan pa la gnod pa byed pa zhig ste/ 'on kyang stag dang sbrul la ni shin tu skrag pa zhig yod/ de 'dul ba'i don du slob dpon gyis de'i pho brang dang nye ba'i nags tshal zhig tu bzhugs pa na/ rgyal pos rnal 'byor pa ngan pa de ma 'dug zer/ de nas slob dpon gyis cho 'phrul gzhan snga ma dang 'dra ba la/ sbrul reg pa'i dug can gyis rgyan mdzad/ mthong dug can ni lcag gi tshul du bsnams/ kha rlang gi dug can bdun gyis dbu la gdengs ka byas/ rgyal po'i mdun na phar gshegs pa na/ rgyal po grong khyer gyi mi dang bcas pa 'jigs shing skrag nas/ gser dang dngul gyi me tog gtor te/ slob dpon gzhan du gshegs par zhu zhus pas/ slob dpon nyid he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par gyur/ stag mo yang mi gang tsam gyi sa la ma reg par nam mkha' la 'gro zhing*/ khyed rnams sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la mi 'jug na/

sbrul gdug pa can 'di rnams gtong ngo zhes bsdigs pas/ thams cad sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs/ ra ra'i yul du re zhig mu stegs rgyun chad skad/ de nas lho phyogs kar+ṇa ṭa ka'i yul du byon nas/ nags tshal zhig tu 'khor mang po dang bcas shing ting nge 'dzin du bzhugs/ re zhig na/ aṭ+ṭa ṭ+ṭa hā sa zhes bya ba'i dur khrod cig tu rgyal po sa muts+tsha ya zhes bya bas sbyin bdag byas te/ rnal 'byor pho mo lnga brgya'i 'khor gyis bskor nas/ zla ba drug tu tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na/ bram ze'i dge slong su sid+dha ka ra zhes bya ba tshogs kyi spyod pa la ma dad nas/ slob dpon la gnang ba ma zhus par phyir song ngo*/ /de nyid ni bka'i chad pas sha/ gzhan lnga brgya po thams cad kyi dngos grub sna re ma thob pa ma byung skad/ de dang nye ba na mu stegs kyi rgyal po zhig gis/ mu stegs pa'i lugs kyi mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs/ ral pa can khri tsam 'tshogs nas rab gnas byed pa na/ srog chags sna tshogs bsad pa'i snying gi phung po 'ba' zhig rang la yang mi 'greng gsum tsam gyi dpangs yod pa'i gtor ma byas so/ /der slob dpon gyi g.yog mo zhig song ba de rnams kyis brdungs pas/ slob dpon gyis dgongs pa btang bas nub mo mchod rten thams cad mgo gzhug log gtor ma sogs mchod pa thams cad phyogs bcur 'thor/ nang par mu stegs rgyal po dang bcas pa 'j-igs shing skrag nas slob dpon gyi drung du byung ste bzod par gsol/ mchod rten rnams rnal du gnas par zhus/ der slob dpon gyis khyed rnams phyin chad lha mchod pa'i don du srog chags gcig kyang ma gsod cig gal te gsod na mchod rten thams cad 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas pa'i nus pa bstan pa'i phyir/ mchod rten gcig min pa thams cad rnal du gnas par 'gro gsung*/ de rnams kyis slar ldog ste bltas pa na de bzhin du song*/

dus phyis yul de'i rgyal po zhig gis srog gi mchod pa byas pas/ mchod rten brgya dang bdun po thams cad nyis tshal gsum tshal du gas/ da lta lcags kyis bsdams nas 'dug mu stegs kyi mchod rten zer yang ling ga'i rigs can zhig yin gsung*/ der yun ring du 'gro ba'i don mdzad nas/ sku lus de nyid kyis mkha' spyod du gshegs so/ /de'i slob ma grub pa brnyes pa'i gtso bo na/ ḍom+bi rigs kyi rnal 'byor ma/ slob dpon a la la badz+ra/ he ma la badz+ra ste gser 'chang rdo rje/ yul dbus kyi ra ta badz+ra ste bzhi'o/ /gzhan yang nags khrod pa dang*/ slob dpon garba ri pa dang*/ dza ya shrī dang*/ mi thub zla ba dang*/ sgra gcan 'dzin rdo rje la sogs pa yang*/ slob dpon 'di'i zhabs la reg pas dngos grub phra mo thob pa yin no/ /de la grub thob chen po ḍom+bi pas g.yung mo rnal 'byor ma la gdams/ des ra ta badz+ra la/ des nag po spyod pa la gdams te brgyud pa'i lugs gcig go /yang g.yung mo rnal 'byor mas/ spyod pa pa la gdams pa'ang lugs gcig yin mod kya/ gtum mo'i bka' babs ni bar pa gtso che ba yin no/ /de'i g.yung mo rnal 'byor ma ni lta stangs bzhis 'gro ba'i mdzad pa/ las bzhi'i sngags dang sbyor ba mang po khong nyid kyis mdzad pa shin tu nus pa che ba mang po da lta yang yod gsung*/ des rdo rje'i glu mang du blangs shing sems can gyi don byas te/ mkha' spyod du bzhud de/ ḍom+bi pa nyid la he ru kas lung bstan pa'i phyag rgya de yin no/ /de la mi thub zla bas zhal gzigs kyi sgo nas zhus so/ /de ni paṇ+ḍi ta shin tu mkhas pa yin/ ḍom+bi'i slob brgyud mang po la thos pa mdzad/ phyis ḍom+bi rnal 'byor ma'i slob brgyud gcig la gdams ngag zhus/ o rgyan du rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas ḍom+bi pa yum dang bcas pa mjal/ gdams pa stsal/ der dur khrod du thod skam gyi spyil bu chung ngu brtsigs/

rnal 'byor ma gcig gis sgrub g.yog byas/ slob ma gcig gis 'tsho ba bskyal gyin bsgrub pas/ mthar rtogs pa khyad par can skyes/ he ru ka'i zhal mthong*/ thun mong gi dngos grub thob/ de nas lan cig tshogs 'khor chen po byas/ mkha' 'gro ma dang phra men ma kun tshogs la bkug /la hor gyi yul na gzugs can ma gcig khyim gyi shing 'bras bu can thams cad rtsa ba bton nas khyer tshogs 'khor la yang phyin pa na/ de'i khyos nub mo mi sdod par shes/ skyed tshal gyi a mra'i yal ga'i phag tu gab nas bsdad pas/ shing de rang yang rtsa ba nas bton nas khyer/ de ltar tshogs gral du sha chen sogs bza' ba dang*/ rnal 'byor can rnams dang lhan cig spyod par shes nas/ mi de khyim thab dang*/ tshogs pa la ma mgu/ slob dpon na re/ rang re'i tshogs 'di na gsang ba la 'khu ba yong pas sgrol dgos gsung*/ tho rangs mos shing khyer nas rang gnas su btsugs/ nang par bdag po la khyod la slob dpon su durdza ya tsan+d+ra'i bka' gcig yod de khyod bsgral zin byas pas der sha/ de sogs nus pa dpag tu med/ de la de'i rig ma su bho gas zhus/ de la dā na shrīs zhus/ de la rdo rje gdan pa bar pas zhus/ de la ku sa lis zhus pa'ang yod mod/ tshig brgyud gtso che/ yang spyod pa bas sing ga la'i rnal 'byor ma la bshad/ de la mi thub zla bas zhus/ de la rā hu la badz+ra gyis zhus pa'ang yin/ de ni chung ngu nas yi dam zhal gzigs rigs rgyal rigs/ bi kra ma'i dge slong paṇ+ḍi ta yin/ der gsang sngags sgom zhing*/ bla mas kun spangs gyis shig gsung*/ 'on kyang nga rgyal gyi dbang las bka' bcag ste re zhig kun spangs ma mdzad/ phyis de'i sdig pa spyod pa la rtse gcig tu bsgrubs kyang cang ma 'grub/ bla ma gu ṇa a ka ra na re/ lce dang yan lag chod gsung*/ ljags dang yan lag bzhi bcad pas/ spyan ras gzigs dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ nag po chen po/

sgrol ma ste bzhis dngos su zhal bstan/ byin gyis brlabs/ de nas bla ma dzña nas ga ra na re/ khyod chu 'dir zhag bdun lus spyings la sdod gsung*/ de ltar byas pas/ lus kyi khrag srin bu pad pa mang pos 'j-ibs nas/ 'chi la khad par song*/ de gnyis kyis bla ma'i bka' bcag pa'i sgrib pa dag skad/ de nas lho phyogs su bsgoms pas phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob/ shing gi ri zer ba/ ri nag po'i khong seng na bzhugs skad/ shing gi ri zhes pa mon mtshams kyi 'di min lho phyogs na yod do/ /de la dā na shrīs zhus pas na gong bzhin yin mod/ 'di dgyes rdor gyi gtum mo kho na yin yang gsung*/ da ta badz+ra ni nā lan+da'i paṇ+ḍi ta cig yin snang yang*/ rnam thar rgyas par mi gsung*/ yang tsar+ya pa kha gcig bi rū pa chung pa/ nag po spyod pa/ ḍom+bi he ru ka mi thub zla ba/ ku sa li bha dra zhes brgyud pa 'ded pa'ang yod mod kya/ de ni ma dag gsung*/ rin po che'i 'byung khungs lta bu'i gtam las/ gtum mo brgyad pa'i gtam gyi skabs te gnyis pa'o// //gsum pa ni las kyi phyag rgya'i bka' babs yin no/ /de yang sangs rgyas dngos kyi zhal mthong ba'i rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti chen po de na/ ngo bo gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje yin gsar brnyes dang gdod ma gang yin bsam par mi nus/ bstan pa 'di la gsang sngags pa thams cad kyi gtso bo yin/ de yang o rgyan gyi rgyal po ste rgyal srid 'byor zhing bde bar yod pa'i skabs/ ston pa'i 'khor dgra bcom pa rnams gling gzhan la 'phur te 'gro 'ong byed pa rgyal po in+d+ra bhu tis gzigs pa na thag ring pas cha ma phyed de/ blon po rnams la bya dmar po'i khyu 'di rnams ci yin dris pas/ blon po rnams na re/ lha ciga'adi ni bya ma lags/ drang srong chen po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos lags so byas pas/ rgyal po sangs rgyas lta 'dod pa la/

blon po rnams kyis thag ring bas mi 'byon zer ba na/ rgyal pos gsol ba btab pas/ nang par gdugs tshod la sangs rgyas 'khor dgra bcom pa lnga brgya dang bcas pa byon pa la rgya cher mchod nas/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs zhus pas/ rgyal po 'dod yon spangs la bslab pa gsum dang pha rol tu phyin pa drug la brten cig gsungs pas/ rgyal pos bdag bud med kyi tshogs dang lhan cig 'dod pa lnga la longs spyad pas sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs cig 'tshal lo/ /dzam+bu'i tshal ni nyams dga' bar/ /wa skyes nyid du gyur kyang bla'/ /'dod yon spangs pa'i thar pa na/ /nam yang mi 'dod gau ta ma/ /zhes zhus pas/ der nyan thos kyi tshogs rnams mi snang bar thal te/ 'di na gang zag brgyad med cing*/ /nyan thos rang rgyal 'ga' yang med/ /byang chub sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul che/ /de dag de yi gzugs su sprul/ /zhes nam mkha' nas sgra yang byung*/ der dkyil 'khor chen po mtha' yas par gyur/ rgyal po la dbang bskur bas/ de nyid du zung 'jug gi sku 'grub ste/ de la bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang rgyud thams cad gtad do/ / des kyang o rgyan gyi skye bo thams cad la rgya cher bstan/ rgyud rnams glegs bam du byas/ mthar btsun mo'i tshogs dang lhan cig mi snang bar gyur te/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur gyur mod/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas zhing du spyod cing gsang sngags thams cad kyi sdud pa po'i tshul mdzad do/ /de'i dus rgyal po 'khor bcas su ma zad o rgyan gyi yul mi dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ srog chags dud 'gror gyur pa 'bu srin yan chod thams cad bde ba chen po'i lam gyis dngos grub thob cing 'ja' lus su song ngo*/ /de dngos kyi zhal mthong ba'i mkha' 'gro ma phyis bzhugs pa ni dpal ldan bde ba'i rol pa mo yin/ de yang sa hā dza sid+dhi lhan cig skyes grub kyi rol pa mo gcig gsung*/ 'on kyang brgyud pa'i khyad par mi 'dra ba na/

byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa tha dad pa dang*/ gdams ngag mi gcig pas yin gsung*/ de la rnal 'byor ma de'i lo rgyus na/ lhan cig skyes grub kyi 'grel ba ltar na/ de ni o rgyan gyi yul phyogs zhig gi rgyal po'i bu mo ste/ de yang cher skyes pa na/ 'khor bu mo lnga brgya dang lhan cig nags tshal rnams su rgyu ba na/ o rgyan gyi phyogs zhig na/ byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje de drang srong 'gro ba dbugs 'byin pa zhes bya bar sprul te bzhugs pa las/ bu mo rnams kyis de mthong ba na/ drang srong skra 'dzings pa 'j-igs 'j-igs ltar 'dug nas/ 'dre yin no snyam phyir bros pa na/ rol pa mos khyed rnams ma 'jigs shig 'di ni mthong ba tsam gyis nga'i yid la dga' ba de'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skyes pas na 'di ni bdag nyid chen po zhig go /de nas 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas te de'i zhabs la phyag byas te/ drang srong des kyang bu mo bde ba'i rol ba mo'i mgo bor phyag bzhag pas/ sngon skye ba gzhan du dbang bskur ba'i ye shes kyang dran/ rang gi sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa mngon sum du rtogs te/ rang gi 'khor rnams la yang bstan pas/ de thams cad kyang rnal 'byor ma chen mor gyur ces 'byung ste/ de thams cad mthong pa'i chos de nyid la sa bcu gang rung re thob pa yin te/ des pad+ma badz+ra chen po la bshad/ des yan lag med pa'i rdo rje phag tshangs pa la bshad do/ /des pad+ma badz+ra bar ba mtsho skyes la bshad/ des in+d+ra bhu ti 'bring po la bshad/ des dza lan+dha ri pa la bshad/ des nag po spyod pa ba la bshad/ des dge ba'i mgon po la bshad/ des dpag med rdo rje la bshad/ des ku sa la bha dra la bshad do/ /de la pad+ma badz+ra chen po na/ nub phyogs ma ru'i yul du rigs bram zer 'khrungs/ sde snod gsum dang bstan bcos thams cad la shin tu mkhas par sbyangs pa zhig yin la/ o rgyan gyi yul du song nas/

gsang sngags phyi'i rgyud mang du bslabs shing mkhas par mkhyen pa la/ de rnams bsgoms pas/ gnod sbyin mo dang bcud len la sogs pa thun mong gi dngos grub thob kyang*/ de kho na nyid ma shes par/ o rgyan gyi phyogs shig tu song nas/ de 'ba' zhig sems par byed pa la/ rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal mngon sum du mthong ba'i slob dpon zhig gis dbang bskur pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas tshul mthong nas/ phyag rgya'i dbang gi ye shes ni de kho na nyid mtshon par byed par mkhyen mod kya/ 'on kyang 'di nyid gtso bor ston par byed pa'i sde snod cig mthong na ci ma rung snyam du de nyid sems par byed pa na/ bu mo bde ba'i rol pa mo 'khor rnal 'byor ma brgya stong du ma dang lhan cig tu slob dpon gyi drung du byon te/ phyag rgya bzhi'i man ngag dang*/ gsang ba 'dus pa gtso bor gyur pa'i bla med kyi rgyud sde du ma bshad pas/ de rnams kyi don mngon sum du rtogs te/ de nyid du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par gyur cing*/ mthar gyi zla ba bcu gnyis na/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang brnyes pa yin gsung*/ des kyang gdams ngag bstan pas o rgyan gyi yul du skye bo dpag tu med pa mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub la bkod/ gsang ba grub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos kyang mdzad do/ /yan lag med pa'i rdo rje na/ rigs ngan skal ba dang ldan pa zhig yin pa la/ slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra gyis legs par gdams pa bzhin lo bcu gnyis su go taṃ pa'i ri la bsgoms pas/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub nyams su chud kyang bdag nyid kyi bya ba slob dpon la zhu dgos par shes te/ zhus pas/ khyod phag rdzi mo bsten cing*/ phag rdzi'i spyod pas rim gyis rdo rje sems dpar 'gyur gsung*/ de nas o rgyan gyi byang phyogs grong khyer zhig tu phag rdzi'i spyod pas sems can gyi don mdzad cing*/

skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la dbang bskur nas/ phyag rgya bzhi'i gdams ngag bstan pas smin cing grol bar mdzad pa yin no/ /dpal phag tshang pa zhes grags so/ de'i slob ma ni slob dpon sa ro ru ha zhes pa bod skad mtsho skyes zhes pa yin te/ de yang rigs rgyal rigs/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la mkhas pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po gsang sngags kyi rgyud mang po mkhyen pa zhig yin/ de rgyal po'i mchod gnas mdzad/ 'khor mtha' yas pa la chos ston cing yod pa la/ shing thun rgan mo zhig phyogs der shing 'thu ba'i zhar la 'ong bas/ res dgod/ res ngu ba zhig mthong*/ phyi zhig na slob dpon gyis de'i khyim du song ste dris pas/ rgod pa ni khyod chos ston pa rdo rje 'chang chos gsung ba 'dra bas rgod pa yin/ ngu ba ni rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs pa ltar mi 'chad pas ngu ba yin zhes zer ba la/ 'o na bdag gi the tshom gcod par zhu zhus pas/ ngas gcod par mi nus kya/ dpal phag tshang pa la zhus gsung*/ de ga na bzhugs dris pas/ byang phyogs kyi grong khyer ngan pa zhig na yod gsung*/ der slob dpon gyis 'tshol du bzhud pas/ byang phyogs kyi grong khyer re rul zhig nas/ dpal phag tshong pa de phag gi khyu chen po gcig gdong du ded/ rigs ngan mo dang lhan cig tu shing khur chen po gcig khur nas byung ba dang mjal nas/ de dag kyang brda ru shes te/ shing khur thogs pa ni zhe sdang ma spangs rang gnas su dag pa'i brda/ rig ngan mo dang bcas pa ni 'dod chags dag pa dang*/ phag khyu bdas pa ni gti mug dag pa'i brdar go ste/ rjes su bzung bar zhu zhus pas/ nga rigs ngan klog kyang mi shes pa la/ gdams ngag dgos zhes smra ba snyad 'tshol ba yin zhes gsung*/ khro zhing brdeg go /grong khyer ba'i phag kun 'jug pa'i ra ba'i phug btsog btsog ltar snang ba zhig tu bzhud do/ /der mtshan mo them pa la mgo brtad nas/ sgo drung du sa the btsugs te 'dug pa na/

nub kyi ring la phag rnams 'thab pa dang*/ slob dpon gyi chu la gnod pa bskyal bas/ phag rnams brdungs/ jo mo rigs ngan rgan mos bzlog par byed cing*/ shin tu dman pa'i spyod pa ltar bcos pas so ma sod do/ der nyin zhag mang po'i bar du 'dug pa na/ lan cig tho rangs kyi tshe slob dpon na re/ sgo drung na yod pa'i mi 'di ci zhig don du gnyer/ jo mo na re/ de kho na nyid kyis rjes su bzung bar zhu zer gyin 'dug zer pa la/ slob dpon gyis/ 'di kun paṇ+ḍi ta bya ba nga rgyal che bas de kho na nyid kyi snod du mi rung gsung*/ der bdag gi don rnams nges par grub po snyam ste/ yang dang yang du gsol ba btab pas dbang bskur zhing*/ gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pa mtha' dag rtsal/ slob dpon nyid kyi sras mo ngan ngon ltar snang ba zhig stsal nas 'di rig mar gyis la sgoms shig gsung*/ de nas slob dpon yang sngar gyi rgyal po'i mchod gnas kyi bya ba yang mdzad cing*/ yid gzhan du ma gyur par rtse gcig tu bsgom pas/ lo bcu gnyis na phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub nyams 'og tu chud do/ /de yan chad du gsang ste spyod pas gnas pa la/ de phyin chad 'j-ig rten pa'i mngon du yang spyod pas/ skye bo kun gyis rigs ngan mo bsten pas slob dpon ma dag slob dpon ma dag na rgyal po ma dag par 'gyur/ des yul phyogs thams cad ma dag cing nyams par 'gyur bas/ gang ma dag pa 'byung ba'i gzhi slob dpon rang dang rigs ngan mo me la bsregs na dag par 'gyur zhes/ rgyal po la yang dang yang du zhus/ dus lan gcig khang bzang gi rtse mo nas bltas pas/ slob dpon khang pa nas rigs ngan gyi bu mo dang bcas pa phyir byung ba mthong*/ der rgyal pos chad pa byed par brtsams te/ shing gi phung po chen po yang byas/ de la slob dpon yab yum bzhag slar yang shing spungs te me bus pas/ zhag bdun du me lce 'bar ba rgyun ma chad cing*/

brgyad pa'i nyin par thal ba'i phung po gyur pa mi rnams kyis thal ba bsal bas dbus na mtsho chung ngu zhig gi gung du pad+ma shin tu rgyas pa la/ slob dpon yab yum he ru ka yab yum gyi sku gzi brjid dang ldan par mthong*/ der thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur cing*/ o ḍi ya ṇa'i yul gyi mi de dag thams cad kyang rdo rje theg pa la bkod de/ rgyal po 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pas kyang dngos grub thob ces grags so/ /dus gzhan cig na ma ru'i yul gyi phyogs shig tu byon te/ der mi zhig gis nyin gung bye tshan gyi thang la ri dwags shin tu grang bas nyen pa mthong bas/ der tsan+dan sa mchog yod par shes nas grus pas/ tsan+dan gyi sdong dum chen po byung ba slob dpon la phul bas/ de la he ru ka'i sku zhig byas na legs par mkhyen nas/ de brdar ba dang*/ brdung ba'i las byed pa yang*/ bud med pad+ma can gyi rigs yon tan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan pa zhig dgos pa las/ de yang gzhan na med de/ yul de'i rgyal po mu stegs kyi lugs 'dzin pa zhig gi klas kyi btsun mo zhig kho na la yod par mkhyen nas/ de mtshan re bzhin ting nge 'dzin gyis bkug nas/ tsan+dan brdar du bcug pa na/ lan cig rgyal pos de'i lag pa gas par mthong nas/ khyod skyid de bar 'dug pa la/ lus kyang rid lag pa ser kar song ba ci yin dris pas rgyal pos mi shes sam/ nub re bzhin re'i phug cig tu btsun pa zhig gis tsan+dan gyi sde gu'i las kho na la bkol/ nam langs su nye ba na/ slar 'di nyid du skyel zer/ de phyogs gang na yod dris pas/ mgo 'khor te phyogs ni mi shes zer/ der rgyal pos kyang brtags pas/ mun sros tsam na rgyal po nyid kyang sems myos shing mgo 'khor ba ltar 'dug pa la/ btsun mo de ni mkha' la yer gyis song nas/ nang par gang nas byung med par khyim du sleb po/ /phyi nub sin+dhu ra'i rkyal pa zhig lag tu gtad nas/

ci lcogs lcogs lam du gtor cig byas gtor pas/ nang par rgyal pos sin+dhu ra'i rjes bcad pas/ slob dpon gyi drung du sleb/ rgyal po khraus te 'khor dang bcas pa chad pa gcod du 'ongs/ der slob dpon gyis rdo rje gri gug gi sbyor ba byas pas/ rdza'i spyi blugs kyi mgrin pa bskor ba na/ rgyal po 'khor bcas kyi gdong ltag par blta bar song*/ der 'j-igs nas zhabs la phyag btsal bas/ slob dpon gyis khyod sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs shig ci ste mi 'jug na/ khyed rnams kyi mgo bo bcad par bya'o zhes gsungs pas/ rgyal po yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs/ he ru ka'i lha khang bzhengs pa gnyan cing byin rlabs che bar grags pa/ dam tshig nyams pas sku de'i zhal ras mthong na khrag skyugs te 'chi ba dang*/ dus phyis rang stag gzig gi dmag gis bshig par brtsams pas/ stag gzig gi rta ba bcu gnyis dus gcig tu shi bas/ da lta yang shin tu gnyan gsung*/ slob dpon des sems can dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad de/ he badz+ra dngos kyi go 'phang thob pa yin gsung*/ de'i slob ma rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti bar pa na/ gong du bshad ma thag pa'i slob dpon nyid me la sreg mkhan de yin te/ 'on kyang 'di'i lo rgyus rgyas par mi gsung*/ zur tsam zhig gsungs pa lwa ba pa'i skabs su 'chad/ yang brgyud pa lugs gcig la/ in+d+ra bhu ti des zhal bstan te pad+ma ka ra la gdams/ de la slob dpon ku sa las zhus/ 'di la ni ku sa la bha dra chung bas zhus pa yin no/ /'on kyang brgyud pa de'i lo rgyus na/ 'og tu shes par bya'o/ /rin po che'i 'byung khungs lta bu'i gtam las/ las rgya brgyud pa'i gtam gyi skabs te gsum pa'o// //bka' babs bzhi pa na/ 'od gsal gyi gdams ngag yin te/ de yang slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pas/ o rgyan du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams la dngos su zhus pa dang*/ yang ring brgyud kyi dbang du byas na/

slob dpon chen po rta mchog ces bya ba phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa/ 'od gsal bsam mi khyab kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom zhing o rgyan gyi grong khyer zhig gi sgo drung dang nye bar spyil po byas nas bzhugs pa la/ rgyal po'i mi rnams kyis tho co'i spyod pas yang yang brnyas pas/ dus lan cig o rgyan gyi yul de tsam du che ba yang ri klung med pa rtas khyab nas/ zhing dang skyed mos tshal thams cad zos pas/ rgyal po'i mi rnams kyis rta rnams ded pas/ zin du nye ba nye ba la mi zin pa 'ba' zhig byung*/ mthar rta 'ga' zhig yod pa yang*/ slob dpon gyi spyil por zhugs pa mthong nas spyil po la bltar song ba na rta gcig kyang med de/ der sprul pa yin par shes/ slob dpon grub pa thob par yang shes mod kya/ 'on kyang slob dpon de rdzu 'phrul gyis mi ma yin gyi gnas su 'phur nas bzhud do/ /'on kyang rgyal po la sogs pas de'i slob ma bi nā ba ste pi waṃ zhabs la gdams ngag zhus/ slob dpon de na/ dang po rgyal rigs yin pa/ slob dpon rta mchog gis dbang bskur zhing gdams pa gnangab na/ bdag gis rgyal rigs kyi bya ba ni spangs par nus na/ 'on kyang pi waṃ gi sgra spang bar mi nus pas/ j-i ltar bgyi zhus pas/ paṃ waṃ gi sgra nyid la sems 'dzin pa'i gdams ngag gnang ste/ des kyang bsam mi khyab kyi dngos grub thob pa yin skad/ de'i slob ma ni chang 'tshong ma bi la s+ya badz+ra yin te/ bod skad du/ sgeg mo rdo rje zhes bya'o/ /de ni o rgyan yul gyi rgyal po zhig gi chang sbyor mkhan yin pas/ des lo bcu drug lon pa'i tshe/ slob dpon ḍom+bi he ru ka phyogs der byon nas chos gsung ba na/ rgyal po de mu stegs la dga' bas thul bar ma gyur pa la/ slob dpon gyis chang 'tshong ma de'i sar byon de la dris pas/ sbrul gyis bsdigs na thul zer/ der slob dpon gyis dgongs pa btang bas/

sbrul gdug reg pa dug can gyis rgyal po'i khyim bskor ba na/ rgyal po 'jigs te skyabs gzhan med pa la/ chang 'tshong ma na re/ mu stegs kyi slob dpon 'di rnams kyis skyob par mi nus kya/ ḍom+bi pa la gsol ba thob ces smras/ rgyal pos kyang snying nas gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon der byon pa na/ sbrul gdug pa thams cad sa 'og tu song*/ rgyal po 'khor dang bcas la yang sangs rgyas pa la dad par gyur/ slob dpon la yang yun ring du mchod pa byas skad/ der chang 'tshong ma de snod dang ldan par gzigs nas/ ḍom+bi pa dang*/ bī na pa gnyis kyis dbang bskur zhing gdams pa yang gnang*/ nus pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor mar gyur pa na/ lcam lak+ṣ+mi ka ras bde ba chen po'i gdams ngag bstan/ slob dpon bī na pas bsam mi khyab kyi gdams ngag bstan pas/ 'od gsal rdo rje'i sems dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi gtso mor gyur/ 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med pa mdzad de/ rnal 'byor ma tsin+to zhes kyang grags so/ /des ni rdo rje dril bu pa la gdams pa yin te/ slob dpon de ni o ḍi sha dang nye ba'i rgyal rigs shig nā lan+dar rab tu byung*/ blo gros snying po'i dpal zhes mtshan btags/ phyis mkhas pa chen por gyur nas/ mu stegs kyi rgol ba tshar bcad pas/ dgra las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha zhes grags/ nā lan+da'i mkhan por yang lan cig mnga' gsol skad/ de nas grub thob dā ri ka pa dang mjal/ dbang bskur dang de kho na nyid zhus nas bsgom zhing yod pa la/ o rgyan du song dngos grub 'byung zhes lung bstan pa byung nas/ o rgyan du song bas/ der rnal 'byor ma bi la s+ya badz+ra phag rdzi ma'i tshul bzung ba dang mjal nas/ des kyang phyag chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'dod chags chen po'i tshul bstan pas/ de kho na nyid thams cad khong du chud nas/ shar phyogs o ḍi shi'i nags khrod du bsgoms pas/ rim pa gnyis kyi rtogs pa khyad par can skyes pa na/

yul gyi rgyal po de nags la ri dwags bshor du 'ongs pas mthong ste/ dge slong 'tsho ba med pa snying re rje snyam nas grong khyer du 'byon par zhus pas/ dngos rnams rab tu shes pa'i mkhas pa dag la brnyas par mi bya ste/ /de ni rtswa rtse chung ngu bas kyang chung ba'i 'byor bas 'ching bar nus ma yin/ /rgyun mi 'chad par chang 'dzag pa yi 'gram lang nag por gyur pa ya/ /glang chen rnams ni pad+ma'i skud pa phra mos 'khyig par mi nus bzhin/ /zhes slob dpon gyis brjod pa las/ der rgyal pos dge slong 'dis nga la brnyas so/ /'di la lan dma' dbab po snyam nas grong khyer du dril bsgrags te/ nags seb kyi dge slong 'di lta bu su zhig gis 'bebs par nus pa de la bya dga' chen po ster byas pas/ der chang 'tshong ma zhig gis khas blangs so/ /de nas des slob dpon la rtag tu 'tsho ba skyel bar byed/ dus gzhan zhig na/ chang 'tshong ma'i bu mo pad+ma can zhing skyes kyi mtshan nyid thams cad tshang ba zhig yod pa phyag rgya mor bzung ste bsgoms pas/ lo bcu gnyis na slob dpon de ni phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kyi go 'phang thob bo/ /der grong khyer pa rnams ma mos pa bzlog pa'i phyir dang*/ ma 'ongs pa'i sems can gyi bsod nams kyi zhing du spyan ras gzigs kyi rdo sku rang byung bzhag pa dang*/ gsang sngags kyi bstan pa rgya cher spel ba'i phyir/ lan gcig khye'u gcig dang bu mo zhig kyang sprul lo/ / rgyal pos gtam de thos nas chang 'tshong ma la slob dpon grong khyer du bos shig ces bsgos/ grong khyer gyi shar sgor skye bo mang po bsags/ slob dpon nags tshal nas grong khyer du byon pa na/ lam du chang bum mang po bstar du bcugayum gyis de nas rwa bshor du 'dren gyin/ sprul pa'i khye'u ni g.yas nas rgyugabu mo ni g.yon nas rgyug go /de nas grong khyer gyi shar sgor sleb pa na/

yul mi rnams kyis sngon rgyal po la brnyas pa'i tshig de glur blangs shing*/ rgyal pos spyan drangs na mi 'ong*/ chang 'tshong mas bos pa na 'ong ba 'di ci zer gyi thal mo brdabs pas/ der slob dpon gyis rwa'i bshor zhal sa la 'phangs pas/ sa 'og bdun phug ste chu chen po byung ngo*/ /slob dpon yab yum ni he ru ka yab yum du gyur/ khye'u dang bu mo ni rdo rje dang dril bur gyur pa phyag tu bsnams te nam mkha' la bzhud/ skye bo rnams kyang chus nub pa tsam du song ba na/ slob dpon la gsol ba btab pas/ spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba thob gsung*/ skye bo thams cad kyis na mo lo ke shwa rā ya/ zhes brjod pa na/ chu'i dbus su spyan ras gzigs kyi rdo sku rang byung du byung*/ chu yang de la lan bdun du bskor ba byas nas sa 'og tu song ngo*/ /der slob dpon gyis/ yul de na gnas pa rnams la rdo rje theg pa rgya cher bshad de/ dngos grub thob pa'i slob ma yang dpag tu med pa byung ngo*/ /des ni lwa ba pa la gdams pa yin te/ slob dpon de ni rgyal po'i sras shig yin pa/ 'di'i yul yang o rgyan gyi nang tshan zhig yin gsung*/ 'ga' zhig o ḍi bi sha yin yang zer/ cher skyes pa na/ gtsug lag khang zhig tu rab tu byung zhing*/ sde snod gsum la yang mkhas par gyur/ phyi zhig na shar phyogs su 'ongs pas/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa dang mjal te/ 'khor lo sdom pa la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ ji ltar gdams pa bzhin du bsgoms pas/ ye shes mchog thob par gyur nas/ nub phyogs o rgyan gyi mkha' 'gro ma'i gnas su song ba na/ mu stegs kyi mkha' 'gro rnams kyis/ me tog gi 'phreng ba zhig lag tu gtad de/ de blangs pa na/ sangs rgyas pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams byung ste/ bu me tog blangs pa ma legs/ de mu stegs kyi rnal 'byor ma yin/ gang me tog blangs pa de'i rjes su 'jug dgos zer/

'o na khyed rnams kyi srung ba byed dgos byas pas/ gnas 'di na phyi rol pa dang*/ nang pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams me tog phog pa su snga ba de'i rjes su 'jug dgos pa'i chad mdo byas pa yin zer/ der slob dpon gyis ting nge 'dzin bsgom zhing bzhugs pas/ nam phyed kyi dus na/ thug chaum gyi sgra chen po byung nas bltas pa na/ mu stegs kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis pha bong gi char chen po phab/ bskyed rim bsgoms pas bsrung 'khor ji tsam bsgom pa'i bar gnod pa ma byung pas/ bskyed rim gyi mthu yang 'di 'dra na/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i mthu bstan par bya'o snyam ste/ mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pas/ rdo thams cad nam mkha' la chags so/ /nam mkha' la rten med par pha bong zhig dang*/ brag me long ltar 'jam pa'i ngos la rdo dam dum mang po rten med par chags pa da lta'ang yod/ der mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi bar chad kyis ma tshugs so/ /de nas bsod snyoms spyod cing bzhugs pa na/ grong khyer gyi sgo drung du yang yang rgyal po dang 'phrad pa na/ 'phrad res bzhin rgyal pos dri ba re byas pa la/ slob dpon gyis lan ci yang ma btab bo/ /lan cig rgyal pos dge slong blun po mi shes pa khyod/ yang yang 'gro zhing 'dug pas ci byed/ de bas ring du gnyid log na rung byas pa na/ slob dpon gyis rgyal po'i sgo drung du lo bcu gnyis su gnyid thun gcig gis 'khyongs pa log bzhin 'dug pa na/ der 'gro ba'i mi kun yang slob dpon la phyag ma byas na byin pa rengs 'gro bas/ rgyal po la sogs pa thams cad phyag 'tshal zhing 'gro 'ong byed do/ /lo bcu gnyis na sad de/ rgyal pos slob dpon de tsam ci'i phyir gnyid log slob dpon na re/ lha nyid gsung ngo zhes gsung*/ de nas rgyal po yang shin tu dad par gyur cing*/ yul gyi skye bo mang po rdo rje theg pa la bkod/ rgyal po de ni in+d+ra bhu ti bar pa yin gsung*/

de nas slob dpon dur khrod na kun tu spyod pa'i tshe/ o rgyan gyi yul gyi sngags 'chang ma'i gtso mo lnga brgya dur khrod nyul du song ngo*/ /de la sngags 'chang ma zhes pa ni man+d+ra bā di te/ lhan cig skyes pa dang*/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags kyi mthu can/ dmod pa grub pa'i phra men ma yin no/ /des na de rnams kyis slob dpon la bar chad byed par 'dod nas slob dpon btsal ba na/ slob dpon gyi shul na na bza' lwa ba gcig ma gtogs gzhan ma mthong nas/ kye ma dge slong 'di'i sgyu ma la ltos/ rang gi lus lwa bar sgyur ro/ /de bas na 'di gtubs nas so sor bza' bar bya'o zhes zer te/ lwa ba dum bu lnga brgyar bgos nas so sor mid do/ /der slob dpon gyis lus snang bar byas te de rnams la dmod pa bor bas/ sngags 'chang mo lnga brgya po lug ma mo lnga brgyar song ngo*/ /der lug ma mo rnams rgyal po'i drung du song ste/ dge slong dur khrod pas bdag cag 'di ltar du byas pas/ rgyal pos sgrol ba'i thabs mdzod ces zer ro/ /der rgyal pos slob dpon la zhus pas slob dpon gcer bur byung zhing*/ rgyal po khyod kyi yul gyi sngags 'chang ma rnams kyis/ dge slong gi nor lwa ba cig yod pa'ang zos so/ de bas na sngags 'chang ma rnams khug cig gsung*/ der gsum ma gtogs thams cad bkug nas/ re re bzhin thams cad la sdigs 'dzub re byas pas/ mgo brnyan sna tshogs su song nas/ lwa ba'i dum bu so sor skyugs/ de dag tshem bu byas pas/ cung zad ma 'grig ste/ da dung gsum yod pas khug cig gsung*/ der btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang na gsum yod pa yang der 'ongs pa la/ snga ma ltar lwa ba skyug tu bcug de nyid sku la gsol bas rje btsun lwa ba pa zhes yongs su grags so/ /der rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti la dbang bskur te/ de'i gdams pa bsgoms pas rgyal po'ang dngos grub thob/

de nas slob dpon brag phug gcig tu lo bcu gnyis su mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom bzhin du 'od gsal gyi lam gyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa na/ skye bo rnams smod par byed de/ gti mug chos su smra ba zhes zer/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti de zhag re bzhin bud med lnga brgya dang lhan cig spyod pas/ mi rnams smod par byed pa la/ dus gzhan zhig gi tshe/ rgyal pos btsun mo zhig gi lag tu tshod ma ku ba gang gtad/ 'di ma grang pa la slob dpon lwa ba pa la phul zhig byas pa na/ des nyi ma mang po chod pa'i lam du tshod ma ma grang pa ga la 'ong byas pas/ rgyal po na re de la ni sngags yod de/ khyod mig tshum la 'di skad smos shig slob dpon lwa ba pa gnyid spangs pa'i dka' thub la gnas pa 'di bden na/ da lta nyid du ko taṃ bha ri'i brag phug tu phyin par gyur cig /ces brjod cig gsung*/ des kyang de bzhin byas pas/ mig gdangs tsam na/ slob dpon gyi mdun du sleb 'dug skad/ der slob dpon ni slob ma 'ga' la lung 'bogs pa'i bya bas g.yengs nas yun ring rab cig 'dren rgyu ma byung*/ slar drangs pa phal cher gsol nas/ lhag ma cung zad drod yod pa nyung shas shig gtad nas/ 'di drod ma yal ba rgyal po la thengs pa gyis gsung*/ dpag tshad bcu gnyis kyi lam yod pas ma grang ba ga la 'ong byas pas/ slob dpon na re/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti tshangs par spyod pa'i mchog yin pa bden na/ da lta nyid du rgyal po'i drung du phyin par gyur cig /ces brjod cig dang myur du sleb 'ong gsung*/ des bsams pa/ slob dpon 'di yang rdzun du smra ba zhig ste/ 'di ltar skye bo thams cad kyi mngon sum dang 'gal ba'i tshig 'di la su zhig yid ches snyam mo/ /'on kyang de bzhin du byas pas/ yud tsam gyis lam rnams chod 'gro yin 'dug nas/ ngan rtags rnams khyer zhing 'ongs nas/ rgyal po mdun khang du skye bo brgya stong gi dbus na yod pa'i drung du sleb ste/

tshod ma'i lhag ma gtad/ der sngar gyi lo rgyus byas/ ko taṃ bhaṃ ri'i brag phug gi btsag dang*/ grub pa'i chu bo zhes bya ba chu dmar ser 'bab pa cig yod pa las rkang gdub gang dang*/ i lo'i ri la yod pa'i grub pa'i sman sna tshogs pa dang*/ gā dza kha dzu ra'i nags nas 'bras bu gsum/ skyu ru ra'i nags nas kyang 'bru gsum/ grub pa'i mtsho'i nang nas me tog pad+ma gcig rnams bden pa'i rtags can du khyer ba'ang skye bo rnams la bstan pas/ thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur cing*/ sdod rgyal po yang dngos grub thob par shes so/ /slad kyis rgyal po dang slob dpon gnyis kyis o rgyan gyi mi rnams la gdams pa bstan pas/ dngos grub thob pa dang rnal 'byor can sha stag tu gyur te/ o rgyan gyi yul de tsam du che ba yang stongs su nye bar gyur skad/ gtam 'di sa ha dza sid+dhi 'grel pa bod na yod pa 'di'i gtam rgyud dang cung zad mi mthun mod/ dper na mdo las thams cad sgrol gyi lo rgyus 'dra min mang po 'byung ba bzhin/ in+d+ra bhū ti lwa ba par gyur pa mdzad spyod phyogs mthun pa gzhan cig byung na ni mi 'gal lo/ /yang bod rang na yod pa lhan cig skyes grub kyi 'grel pa'i dpe 'ga' na/ gtam rgyud de med pa'ang snang bas/ rgya dpe la la na yang med par snang zhing*/ lar rgya gar na yang bstan bcos kha 'phangs dang*/ tshig sna ring thung 'dra min mang bas deb ther sngon po sogs na dgag sgrub yod de snying po med do/ /rin po che'i 'byung khungs lta bu'i gtam las/ 'od gsal brgyud pa'i gtam gyi skabs te bzhi pa'o// //slob dpon in+d+ra bhū ti dang*/ lwa ba pa ste slob dpon de gnyis car la/ grub thob dza lan+dha ri pas 'od gsal dang bde ba chen po'i gdams ngag zhus te/ slob dpon de gang du 'khrungs pa'i yul na/ nub phyogs sin+dhu'i grong khyer na ga ra tha ṭha zhes bya ba zhig tu rigs dmangs rigs su skyes te/

'on kyang bsod nams kyi mthus longs spyod chen po dang ldan no/ /phyi zhig na gtsug lag khang zhig tu dge slong byas/ slob dpon lwa ba pa la gdams ngag zhus nas bsgom zhing yod pa'i tshe/ nam mkha' las sgra byung ste/ khyod o rgyan du song la sgoms shig der 'dod pa'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur zhes 'byung pas/ o rgyan du song ste rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti dang*/ lcam lak+ṣ+mi ka ra dang*/ slob dpon kats+tsha pā da rnams la rgyud thams cad kyi gdams ngag thos shing*/ der bsgoms pa'i tshe/ tshes bcu'i dus shig na dur khrod du song bas/ der dpal he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du mjal zhing*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma mang pos dbang bskur bas/ de nyid du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kyi go 'phang thob bo/ /de nas ring zhig tu yul de nyid du 'dug nas sems can gyi don ci rigs par mdzad do/ /lan cig ko taṃ bha ra zhes pa'i grong khyer zhig na yod pa na/ grong khyer gyi mi rnams kyis slob dpon la yang co dris pas/ yun ring po'i bar du slob dpon khro bar mi byed/ dus gzhan zhig na/ grong khyer gyi rigs kyi gtso bo gsum zhig bzhi mdor song*/ slob dpon ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa mthong ba na/ gcig na re/ rnal 'byor ba 'di long ba zhig zer/ gzhan gcig na re/ 'di ni rnal 'byor pa ma yin lkugs pa zhig go /yang gcig na re/ 'di ni shi ba'i ro zhig go zer ba la/ slob dpon gyis khyed rnams de bzhin du gyur cig ces dmod pa bor bas/ gcig ni mig long*/ gcig ni ngag lkugs/ gcig de nyid du shi'o/ /der skye bo thams cad 'j-igs shing*/ grub pa thob par grags so/ /de rnams kyi gnyen rnams 'ongs shing gsol ba btab pas/ slar yang gsol/ de nas slob dpon yul dza lan+dha ra rdo dang chu la me 'bar ba'i gnas su bzhugs te/ yun ring po lon pa na mtshan yar yul gyi ming thogs te/

grub thob dza lan+dha ri pa zhes zer ro/ /dus gcig na rang byung gi mchod rten dang nye ba'i bal yul gyis phyogs shig na/ dbang phyug gi ling ga cho 'phrul shin tu che ba/ zhag bdun du sa the btsugs nas gsol ba btab na/ mig mthong gi mngon shes dang*/ dbang dang rgyas pa'i las phra mo mang po dang*/ khyad par drag shul spyod pa'i las 'phral du 'grub pa zhig yod pas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bar du gcod pa zhig byung ba/ de 'dul ba'i don du sa phyogs der byon/ res gcig tsa na ling ga de mchod pa la rgyal po yang gsum tsam 'dus shing*/ skye bo brgya stong du ma tshogs pa'i dbus su/ slob dpon yang byon te/ ling ga la sdigs 'dzub bstan pas mgo zhabs log phus btab pas cha du mar zhig go /der yang skye bo thams cad kyis grub pa thob par shes te zhabs la phyag byas/ de nas lan cig yul tsam pār+ṇar bzhud de/ de na sdig spyod kyi rgyal po zhig gis/ gtsug lag khang mang po bshig par brtsams pa na/ rgyal po'i sgo drung na pi waṃ mkhan mkhas pa zhig byung*/ pi waṃ mkhan zhig rgyal po la sems shing 'dug ces bsgo bas rgyal po la sbran pas/ nang du bos pa na/ glu dang pi waṃ gi sbyor pa mang po byas pas/ rgyal po 'khor bcas dga' bar gyur pa la/ pi waṃ mkhan de ni rnal 'byor par 'gyur nas song ngo*/ /der rgyal pos sangs rgyas pa 'di kun sgyu mas slu bar byed cing*/ zhes smras pa la/ slob dpon gyis sangs rgyas pa'i bsngags pa brjod/ mu stegs pa rnams dang*/ khyad par rgyal po de rang la smad pas/ rgyal pos 'khor rnams la 'di mgo chod ces byas so/ /der mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnun pas/ slob dpon gyi sku la gcig kyang ma gnod/ mi lnga brgyas 'ching bar brtsams pas kyang*/ sku 'gul pa yang ma byung*/ slob dpon gyis thal mo brdabs pas/ rgyal po'i pho brang phyed mar gas/ rgyal po'i 'khor rnams kyang lta stangs kyis rengs par byas pas shin tu 'jigs shing*/

rgyal po nyid kyis slob dpon gyi zhabs la phyag btsal te/ bdag gis ci zhig bgyi zhes zhus pas/ sngar gyi sdig pa bshags pa'i don du gtsug lag khang sngar bas nyis 'gyur du gyis/ der gnas pa'i dge 'dun yang nyis 'gyur gyi lhag pa tshugs/ ma shi bar du dge 'dun la mchod pa gyis/ bu la sogs pa bdun brgyud kyi bar du dge 'dun la mchod pa gyis shig /ces zangs kyi glegs bu gyis gsung*/ des kyang de bzhin du byas so/ /yang lan cig yul ma la ba na/ rgyal po legs sbyar la bhartā ha ri zhes bya/ da lta 'phral skad bhar thā ri zhes bya ba/ rta 'bum phrag bco brgyad dang*/ bud med stong dang bcas pa 'byor zhing rgyas par gnas pa la/ de 'dul ba'i dus yin par mkhyen nas/ grong khyer dang mi ring ba'i phyogs shig tu bzhugs pa na/ mtshan mo'i dus shig chom rkun pa mang po byung*/ de rnams kyis slob dpon la bskor ba byas/ grong khyer 'joms pa la song bas/ nor mang po thob/ de rnams phan tshun du deng gnod pa med par nor mang po thob pa na/ rnal 'byor pa de'i mthu las yin gyi de bas na thams cad kyis mchod pa bya'o zhes mu tig gi do shal srang brgya stong ri ba la sogs pa mchod pa du mas mngon par mchod nas song ngo*/ /der mi rnams kyis rgyal po la zhus pas/ rgyal pos kyang rtog pa'i mi btang bas/ slob dpon nor mang po dang bcas pa mthong bas/ slob dpon rkun po yin no snyam nas rgyal po la phul/ des kyang ma brtags par shing gi gsal shing la bskyon no/ /der nyin bar ni sku lus gsal shing gis phug pa'i tshul du 'dug mtshan mo ni de las babs te ting nge 'dzin bsgom zhing bzhugs/ de ltar zhag bdun thal ba na/ rgyal po yang de'i drung du song ngo*/ /der gsal shing gis phug bzhin pa la gsal shing bcag nas chu klung gi 'gram du khrus mdzad du byon pas/ rgyal po'ang ngo mtshar skyes te/

bzod par gsol nas rjes su bzung bar zhus pas/ rgyal srid spongs la a wa dhū tī gyis shig de'i tshe gdams ngag byin par bya'o gsung ba bzhin du rgyal srid kyang yongs su spangs te/ slob dpon gyi phyi bzhin du 'brang song ba na/ dus gzhan zhig na slob dpon gyis gdams ngag kyang gnang ste bsgoms pas ring po mi thogs par rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tu gyur te/ phyis 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas nas mkha' spyod du gshegs so/ /sngar gyi 'phros la/ slob dpon dza lan+dha ri pa ni phal cher byis pa lta bu'i spyod pa mdzad pas/ bā li bā ta te/ byis pa'i zhabs zhes grags so/ /de nas dus phyis shar phyogs pa rnams 'dul bar bzhed nas/ bhang ga la'i tsā ṭi gra ma zhes pa'i grong khyer gyi srang kha 'chag pa'i ha ḍi ba'i tshul bzung zhing yod pa las/ yul de'i rgyal po gzhon nu go bi tsan+d+ra zhes bya ba rgyal srid la 'khod nas ring po ma lon pa zhig yod pa/ rang gi gzugs mdzes pa la yongs su chags te/ me long la blta zhing byi byad 'chos pa la/ lan cig gi tshe/ rgyal po de'i mas tho rangs bltas pa na/ slob dpon rgyal po'i bza' shing gi ra bar song nas/ shing rnams kyi rtsa bar 'dug nas/ na ri ke la bhik+ṣa a wo zhes brjod pas/ shing 'bras rnams slob dpon gyi drung du byung*/ khu bcud gsol zin pa na/ na ri ke la u pa ra dza ha/ zhes gsungs pas/ shing 'bras rnams snga ma bzhin du 'byar nas 'gro ba yang yang mthong bas/ rgyal po'i mas/ grub pa thob par shes nas/ 'dis rgyal po 'dul bar 'gyur ro snyam ste/ lan cig bu'i drung du mchi ma phyung ba na/ rgyal pos smras pas yum ci zhig nyes/ des smras pa/ khyod kyi pha gzugs dang stobs dang blo gros thams cad khyod pas bcu 'gyur gyis lhag kyang*/ mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin bstan/ khyod kyang 'chi ba'i chos las ma 'das zer/ rgyal pos smras pa/ 'o na mi 'chi ba'i thabs ma mchis sam/

mas smras pa/ rang re'i ha ḍi ba 'di la yod ces smras so/ /rgyal po ha ḍi ba'i drung du song ste khyod kyis nga la mi 'chi ba'i gdams pa ster dgos byas pa na/ des gdams pa yod de/ rgyal srid ma spangs na mi 'grub ces gsung*/ der rgyal pos smras pa/ 'o na thog mar gdams ngag zhus la phyis rgyal srid spong ngo zhes byas nas/ nags tshal dben pa zhig tu/ rgyal po dang slob dpon gnyis kho na song ste/ slob dpon gyis rgyal po la rdza'i bum pa stong pa zhig gtad de/ der lag pa chug gsung bcug pa na/ ci 'dug myur ba myur ba smros gsung*/ der rgyal pos cang mi 'dug brjod pa na/ de kho na 'chi ba med pa'i lam yin gsung*/ lan gsum du rgyal pos dris pas kyang*/ de bzhin du gsungs nas/ rgyal po yid ma ches par 'di ni g.yo can zhig go /zhes sa'i dong gting ring po bcug tsher ma'i shing gis bskor/ glang po che'i lci ba dang*/ rta'i sbangs kyis bkangs te sbas nas bzhag go /de yang slob dpon gyi sku'i bkod pa gnyis bstan pa yin te/ yul dza lan+dha ra na yang kun spangs kyi spyod pas sems can gyi don mdzad/ bhang ga lar yang de ltar bstan pa yin no/ /de nas phyi zhig gi tshe/ slob dpon nag po spyod pa lho phyogs ka ta li k+ṣe tra chu shing gi zhing zhes bya/ phal skad du ka tsa li zhes zer bar byon pa na/ slob dpon nag po spyod pa'i slob ma rnams kyis/ lam du rnal 'byor pa mang po 'dug pa rnams la/ longs longs grub thob nag po spyod pa pa phebs kyi yod byas pas/ gzhan rnams kyis langs/ grub thob gau rak+ṣa ni ldang ba mi mdzad do/ /der slob dpon yang byon te/ gau rak+ṣa dang gtam mdzad pa na/ ji zhig na gau rak+ṣas/ khyed kyi bla ma gang yin dris pas/ dza lan+dha ri pa yin gsung*/ gau rak+ṣas/ 'o na dza lan+dha ri pa ni rgyal po go bi tsan+d+ras sa dong du bskyur nas lo bcu gnyis lon zhes gsungs pas/
