spyod pa pa 'khor stong bzhi brgya dang bcas pa shar phyogs su song nas/ go bi tsan+d+ra'i sgo drung du khros nas bzhugs so/ /der rol mo rnams la yang sgra ma byung*/ rta dang glang po che yang rtswa shing mi za/ bu chung rnams kyang 'o ma mi 'thung ngo*/ /de slob dpon gyi mthu yin par shes nas/ rgyal po bcom chung dus phyir phyung nas/ slob dpon 'khor dang bcas pa nang bar zas la 'byon par zhu zhus pas/ slob dpon na re/ nga la 'khor stong dang bzhi brgya yod pas tshims par bya mi nus gsung*/ rgyal po na re/ ngas dmag mi 'bum phrag du ma la rtag tu 'tsho ba sbyor nus na/ slob dpon 'khor bcas la ci'i phyir mi nus/ slob dpon na re/ 'o na nga'i slob ma ma hi la dang*/ bha da la gnyis sngon la gtong gi tshims par gyis shigade tshims na phyis kho bo cag kyang 'ong ngo zhes gsungs pas/ rgyal pos kyang*/ 'bras khal lnga brgya tsam byan dang bcas par sbyar ro/ /der ma hi la dang*/ bha da la gnyis byon/ zas de dag thams cad khong gnyis kyi ku bar blug kyang ma khengs pas/ rgyal po ngo mtshar skyes te/ slob dpon gyi drung du song nas/ 'chi ba med pa'i lam 'tshal lo zhus pas/ der slob dpon gyis glang po che bcu gnyis kyi rgyab khal non pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi yo byad blangs te/ rgyal po la dbang bskur ba'i tha mar/ sngar ha ḍi pas bstan pa'i gdams ngag de nyid bstan pas/ rgyal pos 'di ni bdag gis sngar yang thos zhes sngar gyi lo rgyus bshad do/ /der slob dpon na re/ 'o na khyod la 'chi ba med pa'i grub thob ga la 'ong*/ de ni nga'i bla ma dza lan+dha ri ba yin no gsung*/ der rgyal po grub thob kyis dmod pa 'ong zer shin tu 'jigs pas/ slob dpon gyis thabs bya'o gsung*/ rin po che sna brgyad bsres pa'i 'jon dmar la/ rgyal po'i gzugs brnyan gsum byas so/ /der nag po spyod pa'i slob ma rnams kyis/

sa sogs nyal nyil thams cad bsal/ rgyal po'i gzugs dong gi khar khyer nas/ grub thob ha ḍi pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal du bcug pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas 'di su yin gsung*/ rgyal po go bi tsan+d+ra yin zhus pas/ phi ṭu ma ro thal bar gyur cig gsungs pas/ gzugs de thal bar song*/ yang gzugs gnyis pa phyag 'tshal du bcug pas kyang*/ snga ma ltar song ngo*/ /de bzhin du gsum pa yang song ngo*/ /der rgyal po 'jigs te 'khor dang bcas pa snying 'gas pa tsam du gyur skad/ slar slob dpon gyis rgyal po khrid de/ bzod pa gsol du bcug go der grub thob dza lan+dha ri pa'i gsung gis/ bu ka h+ni pa khyod la slob ma du yod gsung*/ stong dang bzhi brgya yod zhus pas/ 'o na nga la tsha bo mang du yod pa 'dugang lo bcu gnyis su ma zos ma 'thungs bkres shing skom pas na nang par gnyis khrus kyi la shog za ba yin gsung*/ nang par slob ma gsar pa bdun cu tsam khrus byed du bcug pa las/ gzhan rnams khrus thon pa na bros/ dha ma pa dang dhu ma pa gnyis 'dug pa las/ de gnyis dza lan+dha ri pa'i drung du khrid de mdun du sdod du bcug nas/ chu gris yan lag gi sha rnams gcod par bzas te/ bla ma gang nas gsol zhus pas/ grub thob dza lan+dha ri pa rgya cher bzhad de/ ha ha nga sdom brtson mi sha ci la za/ mig 'phrul mkhan 'dra ba kun bzhud cig gsung*/ der phyag gnyis dha ma dhu ma'i mgo bor bzhag pas/ de gnyis kyis kyang mchog gi dngos grub thob bo/ /de nas rgyal pos slob dpon dpon slob gnyis yun ring du bsten cing*/ rang gi sems rgyud kyi dri ma yang rim gyis byang*/ zla ba drug tu tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i mthar/ grub thob dza lan+dha ri pas/ rgyal po la do ha rdo rje'i glus gdams pas/ rgyal po 'khor stong dang bcas pa sems rnal du gnas pa mtshon nas/ thams cad kyang srid bor te kun spangs kyi spyod pas rgyu zhing rnal 'byor pa chen por gyur to/

/de la rgyal po bha rta ha ri ni rgyal po go bi tsan+d+ra'i zhang po yin no/ /de nas re zhig na dza lan+dha ri'i phug pa zhig tu slob ma rnams la zhal mi ston par bzhugs/ lan cig gi tshe/ slob ma blun po mang po phug der 'tshangs nas 'ongs pa la/ slob dpon hūṃ zhes gsung bzhin phug gi steng phug ste mi snang bar bzhud/ nam mkha' nas slar yang mi'i yul du lan drug 'byung ngo zhes pa'i sgra byung ngo*/ /phug de da lta yang byin rlabs che gsung*/ yang dus phyis shig lho phyogs rasmi shwa ra dang nye ba'i nags tshal zhig tu/ ma mo'i rten rang byung zhig byung ba/ der mkha' 'gro ma dang sha za mang po 'dus te/ phyogs de'i lam la 'gro ba'i skye bo thams cad kyi bla tshe rku bar byed pa la/ lan cig gi tshe/ tshong pa lnga brgya rnal 'byor pa gcig dang bcas pa phyogs der song ba na/ bud med dang bram ze 'ga' zhig byung nas khyed rnams do nub gzhan du mi sleb kya/ nags tshal 'dir 'dug na rtswa dang shing 'dzom la/ gcan gzan dang sbrul gyi gnod pa yang med/ de bas na 'di dang 'dir 'dug ces mi re shing re'i rtsar bzhag go /de rnams de na yod pa'i tshe/ yang bud med gzhan gnyis byung nas/ khyed rnams 'dir sdod ces ston pa de mi shes sam/ mi shes byas pas/ de dag ni mkha' 'gro ma dang srin po yin te/ des khyed rnams bcings so/ /de bas na do nub za bar 'gyur bas/ de'i thabs soms shig ces de nyid du mi snang bar song ngo*/ /der rnal 'byor pa gcig po de dza lan+dha ri pa'i slob brgyud yin pas/ des slob dpon dza lan+dha ri pa la skad phyung zhing gsol ba btab pas/ nam zhig na phyogs der 'gron btsun shig byung ngo*/ /de yang der 'dug pa la/ khong rnams kyis sngar gyi lo rgyus bshad pas/ re zhig 'gron btsun de cang mi smra'o/ /nam srod pa na sha za'i mkha' 'gro ma dang srin po rnams mngon du byung bas/

re res mi re bcings nas khrid nas ma mo'i gnas su bzhag ste za bar brtsams pa na/ 'gron btsun des phā ṭa zhes zer zhing gar byas pas/ mkha' 'gro ma dang srin po rnams brgyal zhing 'gyel/ ma mo'i rten yang dum bu gsum du gyes te/ der slob dpon gyis phyin chad sems can la gnod pa mi byed par bka' bsgos/ 'gron btsun de ni grub thob dza lan+dha ri par snang ste/ tshong pa lnga brgya po de thams cad kyang rnal 'byor pa byas te bsgoms pas/ mthar lnga brgya po thams cad dngos grub thob pa yin zer skad/ der slob dpon gyis lo gsum tsam du lho phyogs kyi yul du 'gro ba'i don mdzad par grags/ dus der gsungs pa'i gdams ngag kyang mang du yod par snang ngo*/ /yang dus phyis shig nub phyogs ma ru'i yul du slob dpon dzñā na gu pa ta zhes bya ba/ 'khor mang po la chos gsung zhing yod pa'i skabs shig der rnal 'byor pa ngo mtshar can zhig byung nas/ su yin dris pas/ dza lan+dha ri pa yin gsung*/ yid kyis dri ba mang po byas pas/ de thams cad kyi lan shar shar btab byung bas/ yid ches nas rjes su gzung bar zhus pas/ thod pa rnam snang gis gang ba zhig gnang ba/ slob dpon dzñā na gu pa tas rnam rtog med par gsol bas/ de nyid du mi snang bar yal/ der dge 'dun rnams kyis yang dang yang du gsol ba btab pas/ zla ba gsum tsam du de nyid du bzhugs te/ de rnams la rjes su gdams pa bstan/ de nas rab tu byung ba dang dge bsnyen pho mo yan chad yo bsdoms pas stong tsam yod pa las/ thams cad rdo rje theg pa'i snod du gyur pa yin pas/ de rnams la khyod rnams lo gsum du gsang ste nyams su long*/ lo gsum nas thams cad kyang sngags kyi spyod pa spyod bzhin 'tsho ba ci bde bar song zhig thams cad kyang dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs te mi snang bar gyur to/ /der shar phyogs nas rnal 'byor pa drug gis slob dpon dza lan+dha ri pa dngos su bzhugs nas chos ston zhes thos pas/

gtsug lag khang der 'ongs pa'i tshe/ slob dpon gshegs nas mi 'dug yang der sa the btsugs te gsol ba btab pas/ zla ba drug nas dngos su zhal bstan nas gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pa stsal te/ zhag bdun song ba na nyan thos sen+dha pa zhig der 'ongs/ gang zhig rtog ge la dga' ba/ /gang dag dge slong dngos gnas dang*/ /mi gang rgan por gyur pa ste/ /de la de nyid bstan mi bya/ /zhes gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur skad/ gtsug lag khang der nyan thos sen+dha pa mang du 'ongs shing gnas pa la/ sngar gyi dge 'dun rnams lo gsum 'das pa'i rjes su/ sngags kyi spyod pas phyogs gzhan du rgyu zhing song ba na/ nyan thos rnams kyis yongs su smod par byed do/ /'on kyang ring po mi thogs par thams cad kyis dngos grub sna re thob pas/ grags pa ma yin pa sangs skad/ rnal 'byor pa drug po des 'chi ba med pa'i dngos grub thob/ rgan shos ni bi bhū ti dā sa yin gsung*/ 'dis bod la yang byon te/ bu ston rin po ches kyang chos zhus so/ /da dung slob dpon mi'i 'jig rten du lan bzhi 'byon par grags/ slob dpon 'di'i slob ma grub pa brnyes pa na/ nyi zla ltar yongs su grags pa dang por byung ba nag po spyod pa dang*/ phyis byon pa sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs gnyis yin/ gzhan yang grub chen tan+ti pa/ bi rū pa chung ba/ rgyal po bhar thā ra/ go bi tsan+d+ra sogs yongs su grags pa mtha' yas pa zhig yod do/ /skabs 'dir slob dpon de nyid kyi slob ma'i mchog dus 'khor rgyud phyi mar/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang rus pa'i rgyan cha chang snod cang te thogs pa nag po'i ming can no/ /zhes pa lung bstan pa/ nag po spyod pa pa'i lo rgyus na/ sngon gyi bod rnams yul kar+ṇar 'khrungs pa yin zhes gsung pa dang*/ da lta yang rgya gar ba'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi kha skad la/ bī d+ya na ga rar 'khrungs zhes zer te/ de yang bī d+ya na ga ra dang*/

kar+ṇa ni 'khris nas 'khris kyi yul yin pas/ snga rabs kyi gtam de de yang rgya gar ba'i kha skad tsam yin no/ /gsung las rigs bram ze yin gsung zhing*/ rgya gar la kha skad kyang de bzhin du grags/ bod snga ma rnams rje rigs yin zer yang*/ slob dpon nyid kyi do ha las/ reg gin reg gin 'gro ste bram ze'i bu/ /zhes bram ze'i rigs su gsal de nang don la sbyor yang phyi dang mthun pa'i brda mdzad pa yin pas so/ sangs rgyas nyid kyis lung bstan pa yang yul u ru bi sha yin la/ kho bo'i bla ma gsung pa yang yul u ru bi sha de ni bhang ga la dang nye bar yod gsung*/ lung bstan ni nag po chen po'i rgyud/ mgon po mngon 'byung rtsol bral rwa chos rab kyis bsgyur ba las/ de ltar yul u ru bi sar yang mtshungs par nges pa'o/ /der skyes bu brtson 'grus chen po'i sbyor ba dang ldan pa/ rā ma ṇa'i bka' dang mtshungs pa/ sde tshan dang po'i dang po la dbyangs yig dang pos brgyan pa/ sde tshan bdun pa'i bzhi pa/ cung zad na la zhon pa'i ming can rnal 'byor dbang po gcig pu 'dis dngos grub brgyad thob par 'gyur ro/ /dzam bu'i gling du ma byung zhing 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de'i slob ma drug gis lus dngos po spangs pa'i phyag rgya chen po thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes yul dang mtshan dang dngos grub dang slob ma rnams zhib por gsungs pa'o/ /slob dpon chen po 'di'i lo rgyus ni rnam thar logs su 'byung ba las blta bar bya'o/ /slob dpon de la sangs rgyas kyis lung bstan pa'i slob ma drug na/ bzang po'i zhabs/ ma hi la/ bha da la/ dge tshul tshim bu pa/ dha ma pa/ dhu ma pa rnams so/ kha cig bha da la/ bha dra pa bzang po pa dang gcig zer nas logs su mi bgrong*/ 'dir bgrong rgyu e ya la par 'dod/ rnal 'byor ma yang me kha la dang*/ ka na kha la dang*/ ban dhe pa la sogs pa de rnams na/ slob dpon nyid bzhugs pa'i dus su mchog gi dngos grub thob pa yin gsung*/

blon po ku sha la nā tha/ rgyal po li la tsan+d+ra dang*/ dpag med rdo rje/ rgyal bu la ba yi la sogs pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung*/ bram ze dpal 'dzin la sogs pa dus phyis mjal ba'i dngos grub brnyes pa yang byung ngo*/ /slob dpon bha dra pas an+tar pa la gdams/ des nag po spyod pa chung ba zhes kyang grags pa la gdams/ des bhu ba ri pa la gdams/ des bod du 'khrungs pa bhu ba blo ldan la gdams/ des ku sa li bha dra chung ba la gdams pa'i lugs kyang yod/ yang nag po spyod pas gu h+ya pa zhes grags pa bzang po'i zhabs la gdams/ slob dpon 'dis bla ma la bar chad byed pa'i mkha' 'gro ma bā hu rī zhes pa de zhing thams cad du mngon shes kyis btsal yang re zhig ma rnyed/ phyi shig na de wī ko ṭa nyid na shing shim pi la'i sdong po zhig gi khog nang na/ rdul gcig tu brdzus nas 'dug pa mkhyen nas/ de'i co to nas bzung*/ shing sdong gi nang nas phyir phyung ste grub pa'i ral gris bsnun nas tshar bcad do/ /des slob dpon til+li pa la bshad gsung*/ bod na sngar grags pa la gu h+ya pas an+ta rba la gdams/ des til+li pa la gdams par 'dod/ skabs 'dir mi gsung yang*/ spyir gyi dus bsgrigs pa dang brgyud pa'i babs la de ngos 'thad par snang ngo*/ /yang spyod pa pas dge ba'i mgon po la bshad de/ de ni re zhig blon po'i bya ba byed cing bsgoms pas/ mngon shes cung zad thob ste/ rgyal po'i drung du 'dug pa'i tshe/ rang gi lha khang du zho'i rdzi'u zhig bzhag pa/ byi las ldags pa mngon shes kyis mthong nas de skrod pa'i brda' byas pa/ rgyal pos ci yin dris pa na/ drang por smras pas/ dngos grub thob par shes te/ mchod gnas su bkur/ ringapor mi thogs pa rgyal pos kyang mngon shes lnga grub/ blon po ni rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen por gyur to/ /des kyang til+li pa la bshad do/

/slob dpon til+li pa na/ shar phyogs tsa ṭi gha po zhes bya ba'i grong khyer du bram ze'i rigs su skyes te/ cher skyes pa na bram ze'i lugs kyi bstan bcos thams cad shes shing*/ yul 'ga' zhig tu slong mo la phyin pa'i tshe/ mthar gtsug lag khang zhig na/ dge 'dun rnams spong bas gnas pa mthong nas/ der dad de rab tu byung*/ sde snod gsum gyi tshul yang shes/ sngar smos pa'i slob dpon gnyis la dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dang*/ gdams pa mtha' dag mnos nas bsgoms pas ring po mi thogs par ye shes khyad par can skyes te/ grub pa'i skyes bu mtha' yas pa'i zhal yang mthong*/ de rnams dang gtam 'dre zhing rjes su gdams pa yang thob/ dpal he ru ka dang mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rtag tu zhal mthong bas/ de rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rkyen gyis kyang*/ ye shes gong nas gong du 'phel bar gyur te/ zhing gi rnal 'byor ma til brdung mkhan gyi bu mo zhig dang lhan cig tu spyod pas/ dge 'dun rnams kyis gnas gzhi nas bskrad/ grong khyer du til brdung gi bya ba mdzad pas/ sngar bram ze'i paṇ+ḍi ta dge slong du gyur pa yin pas/ rnyed bkur chen po yod pa yang nyams te/ til brdung ma'i bdag por gyur pas til+li pa ste/ til brdung mkhan zhes ming yang 'gyur ro/ /de nas zhing sna tshogs su spyod cing gnas pas/ o rgyan la sogs pa'i yul rnams su mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi gdams pa thams cad thob/ des na til brdung ba'i bya ba mdzad pas/ til la mar khu 'byung ba bzhin/ bla ma'i man ngag gis lus la gnad du bsnun pas/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'byung bar mkhyen pa sogs bya ba thams cad kyis kyang rang la ngo sprad par song ste mchog gi dngos grub thob/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhal yang gcig car mthong ngo*/ /der rang gi rtogs pa de gzhan la ston par bzhed nas/ dus gzhan cig na/

grong khyer gyi tshong 'dus rnams su rtogs pa glur blangs pas/ skye bo thams cad the tshom du gyur/ lan cig bhang ga la'i grong khyer cig tu skye bo brgya stong du ma/ slob dpon la bltar 'ongs pa la/ slob dpon rig ma dang lhan cig mi gang tsam gyi nam mkha' la til brdung bzhin 'dug go /mi res dri ba re byas pa la/ lan du rtogs pa'i glu re blangs pas/ der 'tshogs pa'i skye bo phal cher gyis kyang don rtogs nas dngos grub thob pa yin skad/ der grub thob til+li pa zhes grags shing*/ yun ring par 'gro ba'i don mdzad nas/ sku lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du bzhud pa yin no/ /'di'i slob ma ni rol pa'i rdo rje dang*/ nā ro pa gnyis yin/ snga ma'i gtam rgyud 'dir mi gsung ste/ mi tra dzo gi'i chos skor na 'dug pa de yin par mngon/ mar do dang*/ pu rangs lo chung gi lugs kyi bde mchog gi lo rgyus dang*/ dpyal pa'i dges rdor lo rgyus na/ gau ta ma shi ṣ+ya yang slob ma mchog tu bshad do/ /nā ro pa ni kha che'i yul du bram ze'i rigs su 'khrungs/ chung ngu nas mu stegs kyi paṇ+ḍi tar gyur pa la/ der mu stegs pa'i gsang sngags pa byas nas/ bram rigs kyi spyod pa bor/ a ba dhu ti byas so/ lan cig chang 'tshong ma zhig gi nang du phyin pas/ de na sangs rgyas pa'i baṇa chung zhig yod pa/ nā ro pa'i zil ma bzod par bros song ba/ de'i shul du mdo'i dpe zhig lus 'dug pa gzigs pas/ chos la shin tu mos te/ yul dbus su song nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung ste/ paṇ+ḍi ta ches chen por gyur pa na/ nā len+d+ra dang*/ bi kra ma shī la'i byang sgo bsrung ba mdzad/ der mu stegs rnams tshar bcad kyin nyan bshad rgya cher mdzad pa las/ rang sems ba 'jo ba'i yun tsam yang mi gnas par 'dug nas/ mtshan re bzhin 'khor lo bde mchog rtag tu bsgoms pas/ mkha' 'gro ma mang pos zhal bstan te/

shar phyogs na slob dpon til+li pa zhes bya ba yod pas de'i drung du songs shigadangos grub thob par 'gyur ro zhes bskul/ shar phyogs su song nas phyogs thams cad du til+li pa btsal bas ma rnyed/ lan cig gtsug lag khang zhig na dge 'dun rnams zas la 'dus te sgo nang nas bsdams/ nā ro pa rung khang na yod tsa na/ mi sngon po btsog btsog 'dra ba zhig byung nas/ nya gson po mang po me mdag la bsreg gin 'dug nas/ der nā ro pas bzlog ma thub/ de rjes dge 'dun rnams byung nas gshe ba la/ de na re/ khyed rnams mi dga' na slar yang chu la btang bas chog gsung ste/ nya mes tshos pa rnams chu la pho bas 'phyong zhing song skad/ nā ro pas de grub thob yin par shes nas/ phyi bzhin song ste zhabs la phyag byas gsol ba btab pas/ khro zhing brdeg pa las/ tshig rnal ma tsam yang mi gsung*/ til+li pa yin nam snyam pa'i tshe yin yin gsung*/ min nam snyam pa'i tshe min min gsung*/ der gzhan sems mkhyen pa dang*/ til+li pa yin par shes/ yang res 'ga' rnal 'byor pa'i spyod pa ltar ston/ res 'ga' smyon par brdzu yin snang*/ der yang nā ro pa la rnam rtog ma skyes/ lan cig grong khyer na bag ma len pa'i sa shig nas tshod ma mang po blangs te/ slob dpon la drangs pa na/ slob dpon de la zhen zhen ltar mdzad cing 'dug pas/ bla ma 'di la mnyes so snyam ste/ slar yang sngar gyi sar song*/ de yang rgya gar na nyi ma gcig la mgron du lan gnyis skru ba'i srol med pas/ tshod ma'i snod brkus te khyer 'ongs pa/ mi rnams kyis ded pas/ dbyugs pa dang rdo mang po lus la phog kyang*/ snod ma shor bar tshod ma rnams bla ma la drangs/ yang lan cigasrin bu dza lu ka ste pad pa mang po yod pa'i chu kha zheng chung ngu zhig gi 'gram na/ bla ma phar tsam tshur tsam mdzad/ der nā ro pas/ bdag chu'i dbus su zhugs nas zam pa bgyi'am zhus pas/ rung gsung*/

de ltar byas pas/ nā ro pa'i mgo bor zhabs bzhag nas mchongs te phar byon/ nga myur du ldog 'ong bas de khar sdod cig gsung*/ bla ma yun ring rab ma byung*/ tshur lam yang bla mas snga ma bzhin byon/ der srin bu pad pas lus kyi khrag thams cad 'jibs te 'chi ba la thug par song*/ yang rim gyis gsos nas/ bla ma'i phyi bzhin song ba na/ lam du rgyal po'i bu mo mdo li la btegs nas byung ba dang 'dzom pas/ til+li pa na re/ rgyal po'i bu mo 'di phrogs shig gsung*/ na ro pas bram zer brdzus te/ shis pa brjod pa ltar byas nas/ bu mo'i mgo bor me tog bzhag ste/ stobs kyis khrid nas bros pas/ g.yog rnams kyis nā ro pa brdungs te ldang mi thub par sa la ro bzhin song*/ de slob dpon gyi thabs kyis gsos nas/ yang lam du song ba las/ blon po'i chung ma 'gro ba dang*/ bag ma zhig 'gro yin 'dug pa la yang snga ma ltar gsung nas/ gsos pa'i bar gong bzhin/ der bla ma bud med bzhed par 'dug snyam ste/ rigs mtho ba'i bu mo zhig pha ma la rin sbyin te nā ro pa rang gis blangs nas/ nang par bla ma la 'bul snyam ste/ de nub rang gis bsten pas/ nang par bla mas nā ro pa'i rtags rdo'i bar du bcer/ der nyin zhag mang por shin tu na par gyur pa na/ bla mas sngags btab pas gsos/ der bud med de slob dpon la phul pa las/ lan cig bu mo de nā ro pa la blta rgod byed pa la/ bla mas khyod nga la mi dga' bar 'di la dga' ba zhes de dang nā ro pa gnyis car brdungs so/ /de dag kyang nā ro pa'i dad pa brtan mi brtan brtags pa yin pa las nā ro pa ma dad pa ma skyes par ma zad dad pa phyir zhing 'phel lo/ /yang lan cig dpon slob gnyis khang bzang gi rtse mo zhig na yod pa la/ 'di na mar mchongs nus pa gcig byung na nga dga' ste gsung pa la/ bla ma'i thabs kyis myur du gsos 'ong snyam ste/ nā ro pas mchongs pas yan lag rnams chagader bla ma nyin zhag mang por byon ma byung*/

da yongs 'chi ba las 'os med snyam pa la/ bla ma byon te sngags btab pas gsos/ de ltar lo bcu gnyis su dka' ba dpag tu med pas bla ma bsten kyang*/ tha na tshig legs pa gcig kyang ma gsungs skad/ de nas lan cig thang stong pa cig tu/ da ngas gdams ngag bstan gyi maṇ+ḍal phul gsung*/ 'di na chu dang me tog mi 'dug zhus pas/ khyod kyi lus la khrag dang sor mo yang med dam gsung*/ khrag gtar te khrag gis chag chag btab/ sor mo rnams bcad de tshom bur bkod/ der til+li pas/ nā ro pa'i sor mo rnams bsdus nas/ 'jim pa dang mchil lham na ro pa'i gdong la rgyab pas/ yug cig dran med du song*/ /sangs tsa na chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid mngon sum du mthong*/ sor mo'ang gsos so/ /slar yang gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pa mtha' dag stsal/ der nā ro pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tu gyur pa la/ til+li pa na re/ da khyod rtsod pa ma byed/ slob ma ma bsten/ bshad pa ma byed/ de ltar na myur du mchog thob par 'gyur gsung*/ de nas phu lā ha rir spros med kyi ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa'i tshe/ lan cig mu stegs dang rtsod pa byed dgos byung ste/ de yang dge 'dun gyi sde cig tu mu stegs kyi rgol ba mkhas po zhig rtsod par byung*/ de dang rtsod nus pa ma byung pa'i skabs rgan mo zhig na re/ dpal snyan grags bzang po gaṃ yo na 'dug pa la zer ba/ dge 'dun rnams kyis btsal pas rnyed/ rtsod par zhus pas sangs rgyas pa'i bstan pa la phan par dgongs nas/ de'i nang par rtsod pa mdzad tsa na/ rtsod pa cung zad pham pas/ nga lta bu'i smra ba'i dbang phyug ci phyir pham snyam bsams pas/ bla ma'i bka' dran te/ bla ma la gsol ba btab pas/ de ma thag rtsod pa yang rgyal/ til+li pa mi thod khrag 'dzag pa thogs nas 'jigs 'jigs 'dra ba sprang po'i rnam par mngon sum du byon/ nā ro pas zhabs la phyag byas/ mu stegs na re/ khyod sangs rgyas pa snying rje can yin zer yang*/

snying rje med pa'i srin po 'di la phyag 'tshal ba rang gis khyod pham pa yin byas pas/ til+li pas mu stegs pa'i lha khang la sdigs 'dzub mdzad de/ pham mo pham mo zhes bro brdungs pas/ lha khang zhig ste/ der rtsod pa dang nus pa gnyis ka sangs rgyas pa rgyal lo/ /bla ma'i bka' cung zad bcag pa des/ sku tshe de la mchog gi dngos grub ma thob/ sku lus bor ma thag tu sangs rgyas pa yin gsung*/ slob dpon 'di ni phal cher phul+la ha ri nyid du bzhugs/ skabs skabs su yul sna tshogs su rgyu zhing dbang bskur ba dang*/ rgyud dang gdams ngag gsung pa dang*/ mu stegs can rtsod pas tshar gcod pa la sogs pa mkhas pa'i bya ba mang po'ang mdzad/ gtso bor las chen bcu gnyis thogs med du grub pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don mdzad/ yi dam gyi lha thams cad kyi zhal rtag tu gzigs pa/ thun mong gi dngos grub nyams 'og tu chud pa'i sgrub pa po chen po yin no/ /slob dpon 'di'i slob ma na/ rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa shān+ti pa la sogs pa sgo bsrungs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta dang*/ jo bo rje a ti sha la sogs pa bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mang po yod/ thun mong ma yin pa'i slob ma'ang*/ bshad rgyud 'dzin pa la pha rgyud la mkhas pa bzha/ ma rgyud la mkhas pa bzhi ste brgyad do/ /dang po bzhi na/ nag po 'jigs med rdo rje/ pi ṭo ha du/ dza yā ka ra/ kha che a ka ra sid+dhi'o/ /phyi ma bzhi na/ ma na ka shrā/ dharma ma ta/ phaṃ ting pa chen po/ pradzñā rak+ṣi ta'o/ /de rnams kyang nus pa la mnga' brnyes pa sha stag go yang kha cig pi ṭ+wa ha du/ dharma ma ti dang gcig snga ma bzhi la/ dzñā na gar+bha bgrong zer/ grub pa brnyes pa'i slob ma bzhi ste/ dpal mchog ḍoṃ bi pa/ ri ri pa/ kan+dha pa/ ka so ri pa ste thams cad kyang dngos grub thob pa'o/ /slob ma bzhi gsum bcu gnyis 'di bod na sngar grags pa ltar bkod pa yin no/ /dpal mchog ḍoṃ bi pa na/ dang po rgyal po'i ba glang mang po'i rdzi bo yin te/

klog kyang mi shes pa yin pa la/ nā ro pa dgon pa zhig na bzhugs pa la mos pa skyes nas/ yang nas yang du 'o ma dang mar drangs so/ /de nas slob dpon nā ro pas/ sems bskyed pa zhig kyang bslabs/ dges pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur nas sgom thabs shig kyang bslabs/ des kyang bsgom bzhin yod pa'i tshe/ lan cig chus khyer pas/ nya zhig gis mid/ nya'i khog nang du he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor zhal mthong ste gnod pa med par phyir phyung*/ de nas slob dpon gyi drung du kun spangs kyi spyod pa byas te/ rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas/ mchog gi dngos grub nyams 'og tu chud de/ chos thams cad dang*/ khyad par rdo rje'i theg pa thams cad la blo gros kyi snang ba rgyas/ slob ma mang po la yang bshad pas/ dngos grub thob pa byung*/ der bstan bcos mang po rtsom dgos pa byung nas/ yi ge slar bslabs pas mu stegs dang*/ nang pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta thams cad co 'dri ba chos kyi gtam gyis tshar bcad/ phyogs thams cad du snyan pa'i grags pas khyab/ a ti sha'i yang bla ma yin/ bod rnams jo bos dngos su ma mjal zer yang*/ mi g.yo ba don dam pa sgrub pa zhes pa jo bos mdzad par yang*/ ḍom+bi pa la dngos su gsan par bshad cing*/ des mdzad pa'i bstan bcos de nyid bzhi pa la/ jo bos mdzad pa'i 'grel pa yang snang ba der yang chos de dag dngos su thob pa'i tshig snang ba dang*/ rgya gar mkhas pa rnams mjal bar mdzad kyin 'duga'agrel pa de'i glegs bam gyi rgya dpe yang*/ slob dpon nirbā ṇa shrī'i phyag na 'dug pa kho bos kyang mthong ngo*/ /slob dpon ḍom+bi chung ba de la ku sa la bha dra chung bas zhus pa yin no/ /slob dpon de ni rgya gar nub phyogs me bar zhes bya bar 'khrungs/ chung ngu nas rig pa'i gnas mang po mkhyen/ mu stegs kyi bla ma chen po cig la rab tu byung bar zhus pas/ des ma khrid/ 'o na mu stegs 'di rnams thams cad sun phyung dgos snyam nas/

dpal rdo rje'i gdan pa'i drung du rab tu byung*/ sde snod thams cad la shin tu mkhas par sbyangs/ slar ka ma ru'i yul du bram zer brdzus te phyin nas/ mu stegs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta dang bram ze drug tsam la/ mu stegs kyi grub mtha' thams cad mkhas par bslabs/ ka ma ru'i yul gyi sgyu ma dang*/ bi dze gi ri pa'i lugs kyi sngags mang po dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma'i ngan sngags mang po dang*/ sh+yang nga ra'i sngags kyi rigs mang po bslabs shing grub par byas/ sngar gyi nub phyogs na yod pa'i mu stegs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyi rtsa ru song*/ rgyal po kar+ṇa zhes bya ba gcig yod pas/ dpang por bzhagasangs rgyas pa'i rnal 'byor pa dang paṇ+ḍi ta ni nyis stong tsam 'dus/ mu stegs ni brgyad stong tsam 'dus nas rtsod pa byas pas/ slob dpon rig pa bzang zhing mu stegs kyi rgyus yod pas/ re re bzhin du thams cad sun phyung*/ der cho 'phrul 'gran par byas pas/ mu stegs pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig gis nam mkha'i skar ma gnyis sa la phab pa ltar snang ba na/ mi mgo'i gzugs can khang pa tsam nag po gnyis 'dug skad/ de ni slob dpon gyis mig 'phrul yin par shes nas/ de bshig pa'i sngags bzlas pas/ de gnyis sol ba rdog po gnyis su song*/ mi thams cad kyis mig 'phrul du go /mu stegs 'ga' res lus la me 'bar ba sogs ston pa la/ der chu phab pas me rnal ba sogs re re nas sun phyung ste thams cad sgyu mas sgyu ma bcom pa yin gsung*/ mthar mu stegs kyi gtso bo bzhi slob dpon gyis sngags btab pas byi lar song*/ sh+yang nga ri'i sngags kyis der tshogs pa'i mu stegs thams cad kyi khyim gyi yo byad thams cad sa rdor btang*/ der mu stegs rnams phams te/ re zhig yul der sangs rgyas pa shin du dar bar byung*/ da ltar yang mang bar yod gsung*/ der slob dpon gyis bsams pa/ nga'i 'di kun rdzu 'phrul ni ma yin/ rig sngags sna tshogs kyis mi rnams kyi mgo bskor ba yin pas nyes pa che zhing*/

sngon chad thos bsam thams cad chags sdang gi dbang du gyur pas/ da ni kun spangs bya'o snyam nas tsar ya pa'i rnal 'byor pa byas thugs dam mdzad kyin yod pa las/ slob dpon dpal mchog ḍom+bi pa dang mjal/ bde dges kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba zhus nas/ gdams ngag thams cad kyang thob par byas/ de bzhin du gong du brgyud pa so so'i skabs su smos pa'i bla ma thams cad kyi drung du song ste/ snga ma bzhin du bla ma thams cad mnyes shing*/ gdams ngag kyang thob yun ring du bsgoms pas/ grub chen nag po spyod pa dang*/ bi rū pa dang*/ byā da pa la sogs pa/ sngon byon gyi grub chen mang po dang yang mjal te/ de rnams kyis kyang gdams pa re yang gnang*/ khong nyid kyis lo bcu gnyis su shar phyogs sa ra bhang ga'i nags tshal du 'dug ste kha zas kyi 'khri ba bcad nas chu kho na gsol zhing bsgrubs pas/ rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa skyes/ g.yang sa la bya bzhin du bzhud pa dang*/ zla ba tsam gyi lam chu tshod gcig gis bgrod pa dang*/ gcan gzan gtum po rnams kyis rnyed bkur byed pa dang*/ 'byung po bran du 'khol pa dang*/ yi dam gyi lha du ma'i zhal gzigs pa dang*/ sems can rnams kyi bsam pa shes pas/ de dang mthun par chos ston pa yin no/ /dus de tsam na rgya gar tsam na yang gdams ngag che/ grub pa thob par grags/ lan cig slob dpon nag po spyod pa dang dngos su mjal nas/ khyod spros bcas kyi spyod pa gyis/ nga'i rjes su 'brang ba tsar+ya pa thams cad kyi gtso bor 'gyur/ ngas byin gyis rlob po zhes lung bstan/ 'khor rig ma nyi shu tsam dang bcas te yul sna tshogs su spros bcas kyi spyod pa lo bcu gsum mdzad/ tsar+ya pa'i rnal 'byor pa thams cad kyis zhabs la gtugs/ mthar de wī ko ṭa'i dgon par lo bdun cu don gnyis bzhugs/ slar slob dpon 'dis lo brgya lnga bcu rtsa bdun bzhugs pa yin gsung*/

phyis kyi tsar+ya pa rnams kyi sde sgrigs bkod can 'di 'dzugs mkhan slob dpon 'di yin no/ /de'i slob ma ni mang yang*/ 'dir slob dpon a si ta gha na yin te/ de yang thog ma mu stegs kyi rnal 'byor pa zhig yin/ yul ni pra ya ga ra 'khrungs/ sgra dang rtog ge la mkhas/ lha dbang phyug chen po bsgrubs pas grub pa'i dngul chu byin/ des mi ma yin gyi gnas mang por 'gro ba dang*/ lus mi rgas pa la sogs pa byung*/ ma mo dang 'byung po'i sngags mang pos drag shul spyod pa grub/ der nga rgyal che bar yod pa la/ tsar+ya pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig dang nus pa 'gran pas/ dngul chu'i dngos grub kyang nus pas phrogs/ khong gi drag shul spyod pa'i mthu gcig kyang ma song bas der sangs rgyas pa la mos nas/ paṇ+ḍi ta pra bha bar ma dang/ slob dpon chen po rat+na rak+ṣi ta dang*/ bi bhu ti tsan+d+ra dang*/ de wa ā ka ra la sogs pa mang po la gdams ngag zhus/ rgyud kyang bde dges 'jigs byed gdan bzhi 'dus pa sde lnga zhus shing mkhyen/ slar slob dpon ku sa li bha dra chung ba dang mjal/ bka' babs kyi gdams ngag thams cad kyang gnang*/ rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas/ 'dod yon gyis sems la gnod par byung nas/ nags su lo bdun dka' ba spyod cing bsgoms/ der lū yi pa dang*/ byā da li pa la sogs pa sngon gyi grub thob mang po dang dngos su mjal te gdams pa yang thob/ khyod grong khyer du songs shig 'dod pa'i don 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs te/ nang par grong khyer du song bas/ de na glu gar mkhan mang po glu gar rtse ba mthong bas rkyen byas te/ sems rgyud yongs su grol nas dngos grub thob/ der rdzu 'phrul gyis bzhud nas skye bo rnams la chos mang du bstan/ de nas yul sna tshogs su skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la ngo mtshar ba'i ltas cung zad ston cing snying po'i don bshad pas/ skye bo rgyud grol ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ngo*/

/lo nyis brgya tsam sku lus de kas bzhugs/ slob dpon 'dis rtogs pa don gyi glu blangs pa dang*/ rgyud sde'i bstan bcos chung ngu mdzad pa yang mang du snang ngo*/ /des ye shes bshes gnyen la gdams te/ paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas brgyud byas na rnam grangs mang mod kyang zhib par mi gsung*/ byin rlabs bka' babs kyi brgyud pa 'di'i dbang du byas na/ slob dpon ku sa li chung ba dang*/ a si ta gha na dang*/ ye shes bshes gnyen gsum gyi ring la paṇ+ḍi ta'i brgyud pa ded na/ bla brgyud bco lnga nyi shu yong bar snang ngo*/ /slob dpon de ni rigs dmangs rigs/ yul ti pu ra/ shar phyogs dza gad da la'i gtsug lag khang du rab tu byung*/ sde ba ni mang pos bkur ba yin/ de'i lugs kyi 'dul ba dang*/ mngon pa'i sde snod kyang mkhyen/ theg pa chen po'i gzhung lugs kyang mang du mkhyen/ khyad par gsang sngags la mkhas pa'i slob dpon mang po la thugs nas/ 'dus pa gshin rje gshed/ bde dgyes/ zla gsang thig le/ phyag chen thig le/ dus kyi 'khor lo rnams mkhas par mkhyen/ yang dharma pa'i slob brgyud kyang yin/ tsar+ya pa yang yin pa zhig la mahā mā ya dang gdan bzhi zhus/ de rnams ci rigs rigs bsgom zhing yod pa'i tshe/ grub thob a si ta gha na dang mjal/ bka' babs gsum gyi gdams ngag ma lus pa gnang*/ der rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa khyad par can skyes shing bla ma la zhus pas/ da ste lo bcu gnyis na ye shes grub pa'i slob dpon zhig zla ba'i gling du 'byung*/ nga'i gdams ngag gis rgyu byas/ de'i gdams ngag gis rkyen byas te/ khyod kyis phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur gsungs nas/ slob dpon ni o rgyan du 'gro gsung ste nam mkha' la gya gyur bzhud do/ /bar der lo bcu gnyis bsgoms pas rtogs pa bzang po skyes te/ da ni spyod pa cig bya snyam pa la da lta mu stegs mang bas mi kun gyis tho cor mthong na bstan pa la gnod snyam ste re zhig bshol/

der lan cig zla ba'i gling du byon pa zhig la/ slob dpon dga' byed skyong de sa 'og dpal gyi sgo nas thon te gling der byon pa dang mjal/ der phyag rgya bzhi'i gdams ngag zhus pas/ phyag rgya gzhan gsum gyi skabs/ gdams ngag nga rang che snyam/ de nas phyag rgya chen po bshad pas/ bla ma de ye shes kyi skur gzigs/ sems rang bzhin gyi lhan skyes bde chen gyi don mngon sum du mthong*/ the tshom thams cad chod cing chos thams cad kyi gting sleb/ slob dpon dga' skyong dpal gyi sgor bzhud nas/ lo phyed dang nyis brgya na shar phyogs su 'thon/ a si ta gha na dang mjal/ de nas lo nyis brgyar nye ba'i mtshams su slob dpon 'di dang mjal ba yin/ de nas slob dpon 'di spyod pa spyod par bzhed de/ sngar gyi dge 'dun gyi gnas der ma bzhugs/ tsar+ya pa'i gnas rnams su spyod cing rab tu byung ba'i rtags ni ma bsgyur/ spyod pa ni spros bcas kyi spyod pa gtso bor lo gsum mdzad cing*/ spros med kyi spyod pa yul sna tshogs su rgyu ba shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa dang bsres kyin lo drug tsam mdzad de/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kyi go 'phangs grub/ lan cig o ḍi sha na/ mu stegs kyi lha khang dza gad nā tha zhes bya ba/ lha khyab 'jug gi rdo sku rang byon cho 'phrul shin tu che ba yin pa la/ slob dpon rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang bcas nas lha khang gi sgo drung na bzhugs nas/ dkon gnyer la lha khang mjal bar zhus pas/ des kyang gnas gzhi'i bdag po mu stegs kyi bla ma zhig la smras pas/ de na re/ sangs rgyas pa 'di kun 'o skol gyi lha la ma dad mod kya/ de khyim btsun zhig yin snang bas yul lha'i 'du shes kyis mjal ba yin yong*/ de thong zer/ der slob dpon lha khang du byon pa na/ slob dpon ri mo la blta bzhin du yun ring du 'dug go /dkon gnyer bas dbyug pa brdegs pas/

der slob dpon gyis rwa dung bus pa na/ dza gad nā tha la sogs pa lha khang de'i rdo sku thams cad yan lag dang dbang po thams cad brul te/ sngar gyi cho 'phrul rnams chung du song*/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas pa'i sde zhig pa rnams kyang slar gsor btub pa byung ste/ bar skabs su rgyal po gsum tsam gyi bar la/ lo brgya tsam du o ḍi shar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa shin tu dar bar byung*/ da lta yang tho re ba yod gsung*/ slob dpon 'di yang lta stangs bzhi thogs pa med par grub nas sems can gyi don mdzad cing*/ khyad par gnas lugs kyi don mngon sum du gzigs nas rgya cher bshad pas rtsod pa'i dus kyi tha mar gyur pa yin kyang*/ nam mkha' lta bu'i rtogs pa brnyes pa stong du longs ba byung skad/ thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa yang mang du byung*/ mchog gi dngos grub mngon gyur du thob pa ni slob dpon dharma ka ra zhes bya ba zangs gling du 'ja' lus thob pa zhig dang*/ rnal 'byor ma zla 'od ces bya ba dang*/ rnal 'byor ma bha dza ru ru zhes bya ba ste snga slob gsum mo/ phyi slob grub chen zhi ba sbas pa ste bzhi'o/ /rin po che'i 'byung khungs lta bu'i gtam las/ 'od gsal la sogs pa bka' babs bzhi gcig tu 'dres pa'i gtam gyi skabs te lnga pa'o/ /bka' babs lnga pa na/ bskyed pa'i rim pa 'phrin las dang bcas pa yin te/ de yul dbus kha bi zhes pa'i nang tshan/ grong khyer rdo 'jog ces par/ bram ze'i slob dpon shin tu mkhas pa zhig yod pa/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la lhag par dad de/ nā len+dar dge 'dun phal chen po'i sde la rab tu byung ste/ bud+dha shrī dzñā na zhes bya ba sangs rgyas dpal ye shes zhes mtshan btags so/ kha cig na/ slob dpon 'di rgyal rigs klog pa po cig yin zer ba'ang 'dugader slob dpon seng ge bzang po la theg pa che chung gi chos mtha' dag legs par bslabs/ gu ṇa mi trā zhes bya bas gsol ba btab ste/

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsdud pa'i 'grel pa sogs bstan bcos kyang mang du byas/ gu ṇa mi trā 'di bod pa'i phar phyin gyi chos brgyud la bzhugs/ dge slong ma yin par zhal lung 'grel pa las bshad do/ /de nas nub phyogs o rgyan du song*/ slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rje dang*/ rnal 'byor ma gu ne ru zhes bya ba la gsang sngags phyi nang gi chos mang du zhus/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po thob/ o rgyan gyi byang phyogs na gdol pa'i bu mo dzā ti dza la zhes bya ba/ lcam dpal mo dang rgyud gcig pa zhig la zla ba brgyad brten/ dzam bha la'i lung thob pa tsam gyis rig sngags grub/ yul dza lan+dha rar slob dpon byis pa'i zhabs te/ bā li pa da zhes bya ba la shes rab kyi rgyud zhus/ 'di grub thob dza lan+bha ri pa'i sku'i rnam 'gyur ka yin par grags/ der shes rab brgyud la chu bo rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin thob/ de nas lho phyogs kong ka na zhes bya ba shing nam mkha' na skye ba zhig na/ slob dpon pā li ta pa da ste/ slob dpon bsrung ba'i zhabs zhes bya ba/ rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa'i slob ma rnal 'byor pho mo bco brgyad tsam dang bcas pa la/ yo byad thams cad ni nor rgyun mas sbyor/ de la gsang ba 'dus pa zhu zhing lo dgu bsten/ rgyud tshar bco brgyad nyan/ 'on kyang de kho na nyid cung zad ma rtogs nas/ bla ma la zhus pas/ kho bos kyang ma rtogs gsung*/ der mā la mo di zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya zhig yod pa 'dus pa'i glegs bam du bsgyur te mgul du btags nas/ rdo rje gdan gyi rgyab/ ku pa'i tshal zhes bya bar sgrub pa lan gsum spyad pas zla ba bco brgyad dang*/ drag shul spyod pa zla ba drug tu bsgrubs pas/ lung bstan pa byung ste/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal la the tshom chod zer/ 'o na 'jam dpal rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga na bzhugs pas der 'gro dgongs te/ dpag tshad bcu tsam byang shar du song ba na/

nyi ma ma phyed tsam gyi dus shig tu khang pa dkar po zhig gi drung na/ khyim btsun rgan po sham thabs bye ba/ chos gos kyi thod byas pa zhig bud med ngan ma gcig dang lhan cig zhing rmod pa mthong ste cung zad ma dad/ de dang nye ba ni khyi mo dkar mo ngan ma gcig kyang nyal nas 'dug go /der nyin mo'i dus tshod bsod snyoms kyi dus la babs pas na/ kha zas bslangs pas/ yur ba nas nya zhig bzung khyi mo la byin/ der skyugs pa slob dpon la drangs pas rnam rtog gis ma gsol/ der khyim btsun na re/ 'dzam bu gling pa rnam rtog che/ zas bzang po drongs zer nas gzhan zhig tu song ngo*/ /der bud med des 'bras chan dang*/ zho bzang po drangs pa gsol nas 'byon par chas tsa na/ de ring grong du mi sleb nang bar song zer bas der bzhugs te/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud bton pas/ the tshom gyi gnas gang yin pa der/ bud med de mi dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur re byed kyin 'dug nas/ 'di gzhan sems shes pa'o dgongs nas/ bdag gi the tshom gcod pa zhu byas pas/ ngas mi shes/ da ci'i khyim btsun de 'dus pa la shin tu mkhas/ nyi ma phyi phraid na sleb 'ong de la the tshom chod zer ba ltar/ phyi phred na chang gis bzi nas 'khyor bzhin byung*/ der sngags kyi spyod pa can du shes te ma dad pa spangs te zhabs la phyag btsal nas the tshom rnams zhus pas/ dbang bskur dgos gsung*/ sngar gzhan la thob zhus pas nga'i chos ston pa la nga rang gis dbang bskur dgos gsung*/ dkyil 'khor khang pa zhig tu zhugs so/ /nam srod kyi dus su slob dpon nang du bos pa la/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i drung na/ sngar gyi sprul pa'i dge slong bud med dang khyi mor bcas pa yang snang ste/ su la dbang len gsung*/ de rnams ngo bo gcig par shes kyang*/ rnam pa dkyil 'khor la mos nas/ dkyil 'khor las 'tshal zhus pas/

'o na long gsung ste/ de gsum khang chung gzhan zhig tu song*/ dkyil 'khor yang mi snang bar gyur/ der slob dpon thugs skyo bas tho rangs kyi dus/ khyod ni sems can kun gyi yab ste zhes sogs gsol ba btab pas/ dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin du sprul te dbang bskur nas/ 'jam dpal zhal lung bshad/ der slob dpon dgongs pa ni nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ chos thams cad kyi gting sleb/ dang por zas nya sha khyis skyugs pa dang*/ khyim btsun gyi spyod pa gnyis dang*/ rjes su rnam pa khyim btsun rgan po la ma dad pas 'ja' lus ma grub/ bar dor dngos grub mchog brnyes par 'gyur ba'o/ de nas rang gi rtogs pa thabs rim gnyis khyad par can dang bcas pa rgya cher spel bar bzhed nas/ chos kyi myu gu zhes bya ba'i gnas/ skye bo mang po 'du bar rung la/ bsam gtan yang mthun pa/ sngon gyi byang chub sems dpas bsten pa zhig yod de/ der dzam bha las yon bdag byas/ snod dang ldan pa mang po la chos bshad pas/ phyogs bzhi'i mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta la sogs pa'i slob ma mang du 'dus pa la/ 'jam dpal gyi dgongs pa rgya cher bshad pas/ snyan pa'i grags pas sa steng thams cad khyab/ lung dang mthun pa'i chos bcu bzhi mdzad/ slob dpon pā li pa des kyang*/ 'jam dpal gyi lung gi gdams ngag rnams zhus pas mchog gi dngos grub thob bo/ /rdo rje gdan mchod pa'i lo rgyus na/ lan cig slob dpon rdo rje gdan dang nye ba na spyil po mdzad nas bzhugs pa'i tshe/ rgyal po dharma pā la rdo rje gdan la mchod pa la 'ongs pas/ sangs rgyas pa'i slob dpon gzhan thams cad mchod pa la byon/ slob dpon 'di mchod pa mi byed par mthong nas chad pas gcod dgos snyam ste/ slob dpon gyi spyil por zhugs pas/ de na slob dpon mi bzhugs par 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sku zhig mthong*/ phyir 'ongs te 'khor rnams la dris pas/ 'di nyid na yod zer/ yang nang du 'ongs pas slob dpon du snang*/

der khyod mchod pa mi byed pa ci yin dris pas/ nga 'di nyid nas mchod pa'i 'bul gsung*/ des ji ltar 'bul dris pas/ slob dpon gyi dgongs pa la mnyam par bzhag pas/ rdo rje gdan gyi lha sku thams cad mngon sum du slob dpon gyi drung du mgron du bos pa ltar byung ste/ slob dpon gyis de la rgya chen po'i mchod pa byed par mthong*/ der rgyal po yid ches nas/ dbang bskur ba zhus te yon gzhan med nas/ rang nyid btsun mo dang bcas pa 'bangs su phul/ nang par pho brang nas khong rang thams cad kyi lus tshad dang mnyam pa'i gser bslus mar phul lo/ /bi kra ma shī la'i rab gnas kyi lo rgyus na/ yang bi kra ma shī la dang*/ o tan+ta pu ri dang*/ shrī nā lan+da dang*/ so ma pu ri ste/ gtsug lag khang bzhi po de/ so so'i bar bar na nyin lam mang pos chod pa yin cing*/ bi kra ma gsar bzhengs yin/ so ma pu ri zhig gsos yin zer/ gzhan gnyis na'ang rgyal pos lha khang gsar du bzhengs pa mang du yod pa rnams la rab tu gnas par zhus pas/ slob dpon gyis sku'i bkod pa bzhi sprul te/ gtsug lag khang bzhi car la rab tu gnas pa dus gcig tu mdzad/ de skabs bi kra ma shā lar/ rab gnas kyi zhal bsro chen po yod pa'i skabs/ mu stegs kyi rnal 'byor ma dpon g.yog gnyis kyis skrur 'ongs pas/ dge tshul ma rungs pa rnams kyis brdungs so/ /g.yog mos 'di la nus pa ston dgos zhes yang yang gsol ba btab pas/ dpon mos sngags bzlas pas/ rab gnas kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'og nas chu brdol/ der slob dpon gyis rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la btegs pas/ des char drag po phab bo/ /de yang slob dpon gyis phyag bkab ste bsrungs pas/ dkyil 'khor la gnod pa ni ma byung zhing*/ rab gnas legs so/ /phyis kyang lo re'i dus la de'i nyin par mu stegs kyi gnod pa re yong*/ tshugs ni mi tshugs so/ /nā len+d+ra btul ba'i lo rgyus na/

der slob dpon chen po des/ nā len+d+ra dang*/ bi kra ma la shī la'i gnas kyi bdag po yang mdzad/ de skabs o tan+ta pu ri na gnas pa'i nyan thos sen+dha pa rnams dang*/ rnam par rtog pas g.yengs pa'i dge slong rnams kyis ngan du zer zhing*/ slob dpon nā len+d+rar bzhugs pa'i skabs shig na/ dge slong de rnams kyis/ sangs rgyas ye shes tshul khrims dang mi ldan pas dge 'dun gyi mkhan por rung pa ma yin zhes yang yang rgol ba dang*/ gsang sngags la gshe zhing*/ rdo rje gdan gyi sen+dha pa sing gha la pa mang pos/ he ru ka'i sku brnyan dngul las bsgrubs pa bshig ste rnyed par byas so/ /rgyal pos rdo rje gdan gyi sing gha la pa mang po bsad/ sen+dha pa gzhan rnams la'ang chad pa gcod par brtsams pa na/ slob dpon gyis thugs rje chen pos/ de rnams rgyal po'i gnod pa las legs par bskyabs so/ /ma dad pa bzlog pa'i phyir du/ sa 'og tu rdzu 'phrul gyis gshegs pa dang*/ yang skabs 'gar/ mi ma yin mang po slob dpon la mchod pa dang*/ ya ma zung gi cho 'phrul mang du bstan/ der sngags kyi spyod pa mchog gi bstan bcos kyang mang du mdzad pa las/ nyan thos kyi sde snod dang yang mi 'gal ba bsgrubs so/ /sngon 'jam dbyangs sprul pa a ba dhu ti'i spyod pa can de la/ ma dad pa gtan nas ma skyes na/ de nyid du 'ja' lus rdo rje'i skur gnas 'gyur ba yin pa las/ der ma gus pa'i rnam par rtog pa cung zad skyes pas/ dgung lo brgyad cu lhag cig bzhes pa na/ rnam par smin pa'i sku lus bor te/ zung 'jug gi sku brnyes pa yin no/ /de'i slob ma na/ mthong ba'i chos la mya ngan las 'das pa'i slob ma bzha/ rgyal tshab kyi sa la gnas pa zhes bya ba skye ba gcig gis thogs pa dang*/ bar dor sangs rgya ba'i rigs can bco brgyad/ mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta dang*/ rnal 'byor pa ku sa li grangs las 'das pa byung ngo*/ /slob dpon 'di'i rdo rje'i spun grogs slob mar gyur pa ni kong ka na'i chos kyi 'byung gnas dang*/

ri bo sa h+ya kyi gtsug tor rdo rje'o/ /zhes dpal 'bras rdo rjes bshad/ slob ma'i mchog bzhi po na/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ rab zhi bshes gnyen/ bde ba chen por pad+ma ka ra/ rgyal rigs sgra gcan 'dzin no/ /slob dpon chen po 'di'i dngos slob/ yang slob/ nyid slob kyi bar du dzam bha la grub pas yo byad sbyor ba dang*/ nor rgyun mas yo byad sbyor ba dang*/ rgyud las 'byung ba ltar khye'u dang bu mo la ye shes pheb nas dkyil 'khor 'bri ba dang*/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor yang dkyil 'khor dngos su ston nus pa dang*/ bden stobs brjod pas rdul tshon gang dgos su 'phel ba sogs yod do/ /de rjes rgyal po mahā pā la'i gzhug gcig la dge slong gi rten dang cha byad can la/ sngags spyod mngon gyur pa bkag pas de phyin chad de 'dra mang po ma byung ngo*/ /de la mar me mdzad bzang po ni rgya gar nub phyogs su sku 'khrungs/ rigs pa'i gnas thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i blo gros brnyes/ rten ni dge slong*/ sde pa ni 'di yang dge 'dun phal chen pa yin gsung*/ de yang dpal nā len+d+rar mkhas pa thams cad kyis bkur ba yin/ slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs dang mjal nas/ rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad du zhugs/ rgyud sde yang mtha' yas pa gsan/ 'on kyang man ngag thob dka' bar byung nas/ re zhig lho phyogs kyi yul du byon nas lo gnyis gsum du sngags rgyud sbyor bas sems can la phan btags/ der 'du ba dang longs spyod rgya chen po byung ba/ de thams cad slob dpon la mchod pa'i yo byad du dril nas/ slob dpon gyi drung du lha 'bangs kyi khyim drug cu dang*/ gser srang stong*/ mu tig gi do shal sum brgya la sogs pa yo byad dpag tu med pas mchod cing*/ khyad par bdag nyid slob dpon gyi bran du khas blangs te/ slob dpon gyi drung du lo gsum tsam du tha na grong khyer nas dam rdzas sha chang len pa tshun chad kyi bya ba'ang mdzad/

der slob dpon gyis man ngag thams cad kyang gnang*/ phyogs gzhan zhig tu song nas bsgoms pas/ rtogs pa khyad par can skyes te slob dpon gyi drung du 'ongs pa bla mas kyang dbang bskur bas/ de nyid du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kyi go 'phang thob ste/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs las kyang rtogs pa mtho ba yin no skad/ slob dpon 'dis drag po'i las kyi sgo nas mu stegs kyi rgyal po tshar bcad pa'i gtam rgyud snang ste/ rgya gar mtha' 'khob sin+dhu'i yul du bzhugs pa'i skabs shigayul de'i rgyal pos slob dpon gyi slob ma rnams la rtag tu 'tshe ba byed pa zhig yod/ gzhan yang rgyal po des sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la shin tu gnod pa byed pa zhig yod pa/ lan cig slob dpon dang lam gcig tu mjal bas/ rgyal pos slob dpon la mdung thung 'phangs pas sku la ma gnod/ slob dpon gyis sdigs 'dzub mdzad pas/ rgyal po yo byad dang bcas pa thul gyis tshig nas thal bar song*/ der rgyal po'i mi mu stegs la dga' ba thams cad 'jigs te/ dge slong mgo bregs 'di kun nus pa 'di tsam zhig ces phyin chad mi rabs mang por nang pa'i gtsug lag khang rnams la 'tshe ba mi byed do/ /lo rgyus 'ga' las rgyal po de tu ruṣ+ka'i rgyal po bhū ṣā na zhes pa yin te/ de dus yul dbus na tu ruṣ+ka med pas/ lta ba log pa rnams la mu stegs zhes zer ba'i stabs nas mu stegs kyi rgyal po zer ba byung ba yin gsung*/ yang nub phyogs ma la ba'i yul na/ mu stegs kyi rgyal po khyab 'jug chen po la lhar 'dzin pa zhig yod pa/ des sangs rgyas pa'i lha khang mang po bshig dge slong rnams yul dbus su bskrad/ dge bsnyen rnams la yang sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa ster bas/ lan cig slob dpon yang de'i yul du byon pa zhig la/ slob dpon ye shes zhabs kyis byin rlabs mdzad pa'i lha khang zhig yod pa der bzhugs/

der slob dpon la rgyal po des snyad mang po btags/ slob dpon gyis phyis nyin par dgongs pa zhig btang bas rgyal po chung mar bcas pa nad kyis btab/ yang blon po mu stegs la dga' ba zhig dang*/ slob dpon lam du mjal bas/ blon po na re/ rgyal po la ngan thabs byas pas khyod la chad pas gcod zer ba la/ slob dpon gyis mchan khung nas ras la bris pa'i ling ga zhig bton te/ ngan pa de da rung ma shi'am gsung nas ling ga de phyed mar bshags pas/ rgyal po lus tshal par gas nas sha/ blon po de la sngags btab pas rengs/ yang mu stegs kyi slob dpon sa ga ra nan+da zhes bya ba zhig yod pa las/ des phra men ma'i rig sngags mang po bsgrubs te/ sangs rgyas pa mang po la gnod pa byed pa zhig yin pa las/ lan cig lam srang dog po zhig tu slob dpon dang 'phrad pas/ lam bzur res ma byung*/ der mu stegs na re/ nang par khyed rnams ma shi na kho bo cag gi lugs mi bden zhes ngan sngags kyi dus btab nas song*/ nam srod kyi dus su song ba na/ slob dpon gyi gnas rnams su thug tshom chen po byung*/ slob dpon gyis dgongs pa la mnyam par bzhag pas/ mu stegs de rnams nyid kyi lha khang spyil po dang bcas pa thams cad zhig ste/ der sa ga ra 'khor dang bcas pa yang de nyid du dus gcig la sha/ dus de'i tshe sa ga ra ni mu stegs kyi sngags mkhan thams cad kyi gtso bo yin no/ /slob dpon des sman pa zhabs la gdams te/ slob dpon de ni mtha' 'khob zhig tu bram ze'i rigs su skyes nas/ mu stegs kyi chos lugs la mkhas shing nus pa yang grub pa yin pa la/ phyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dad nas/ yul dbus nā len+d+rar slob dpon mar me mdzad bzang po dang*/ mar me mdzad bzang po'i yang bla ma dpal sangs rgyas ye shes gnyis la pha rol tu phyin pa nas brtsams te/ gsang sngags phyi nang gi bar gyi thos pas rgyud sbyangs/ dbang bskur zhing gdams pa mtha' dag gnang*/

khyad par 'dus pa dang he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i tshe/ me tog khro bo hūṃ mdzad la phogayun ring du bsgoms pas rim gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skyes/ khyad par zla ba drug tu sgrub pa byas pas dngos grub thob par shes nas/ de'i sgrub pa'i rten du gdol ba'i bu mo ut+pal sngon po'i kha dog lta bu rdo rje'i rigs kyi phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig dgos pa/ phyogs zhig nas btsal bas rnyed nas/ pha ma la bslangs pas/ de rnams na re/ bram ze'i slob dpon khyod smyo ba yin nam/ nged gdol pa'i rigs yin pas/ khyod nyid dang nged rnams la yang chad pa mi 'ong ngam zer ba la/ nga la sgrub pa'i rten du dgos pas/ tha mal gyi rigs nyams pa sogs kyi chad pa mi 'ong byas pas/ 'o na bu mo'i lus dang mnyam pa'i gser dang dngul dgos zer/ der slob dpon gyis skad cig la sa 'og gi gter phyung ste/ de rnams la byin/ de nas slob dpon phyag rgyar bcas pa ri phug cig tu zla ba drug sgrub pa byas pas yar ngo'i tshes brgyad kyi tho rangs kyi dus su nam mkha' la hūṃ gi sgra chen po grags/ dpal he ru ka la sogs pa dkyil 'khor thams cad kyang mngon sum du mthong*/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kyi go 'phang yang thob/ 'dus pa gtso bor gyur pa'i lam gyis 'gro ba mang po la phan btags/ bstan bcos kyang mang du mdzad nas/ mthar sku lus de nyid kyis sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing du khyung gi rgyal po 'phur ba ltar bzhud do/ /'di rnying ma ba la grags pa'i slob dpon hūṃ ka ra dang gcig par grags/ de lta na 'khrungs yul bal po yin/ rgyal po sad na legs kyi dus bod du yang byon par rig go /de la slob dpon a ba dhu ti pa zhes bya ba zhig gis zhus/ de la rat+na ā ka ra shān+ti pas zhus/ de la rdo rje gdan pa chen pos zhus/ de la ku sa li pas zhus pa'i brgyud pa'ang yod gsung*/

'on kyang bka' babs gtso bor gyur pa na/ sman pa zhabs la o rgyan gyi slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal zhi bas zhus/ de la rdo rje gdan pa chen pos zhus/ de la rdo rje gdan pa sa sau ri pa yang zer/ rat+na ā ka ra gup+ta yang zer/ rdo rje gdan pa bar pas zhus/ yang slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas la bshad/ 'di la pad+ma badz+ra phyi ma'am chung bar grags/ rnam thar rgyas pa logs su yod pa las shes so/ /pad+ma pa che chung du grags pa ni dus snga phyi la btags pa yin no/ /slob dpon des kā ma ru'i yul gyi a ba dhū tī'i rnal 'byor pa rat+na shī la zhes bya ba la gdams/ de la ka yas+tha brid+dha ste/ yig mkhan rgan po zhes bya bas zhus te/ slob dpon ka yas+tha bgres po de na/ rgyal po dharma pā la'i yig mkhan yin pa la/ lo brgyad cu lon nas nā len+d+rar rab tu byung*/ gsung rab bslabs pas/ de dang nye ba na rgyal po ma hi pā las lam du 'gro ba mthong ste/ shing gi yal ga skam po zhig slob dpon la bstan te/ khyod kyi sde snod rnams shes pa'i tshe/ shing 'di la'ang me tog 'byung nges zhes dpyas so/ /slob dpon gyis bsams pa/ de ni sgrub pa bya'o snyam nas/ kā ma ru'i a ba dhū tī pa la gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur zhus nas bsgoms pas/ lo gsum nas bskyed rim gyi lam mtha' dag rdzogs/ chu gling zhig tu maṇ+ḍal byas nas sgrub pa mdzad pas/ zhag bdun song ba'i tho rangs 'jam pa'i rdo rje rma bya la chibs pa mngon sum du zhal bstan nas byin gyis brlabs pas/ chos thams cad kyang skad cig gis shes/ dngos grub kyang thob par gyur/ rgyal po'i drung du song ste/ ngas ni sde snod gsum shes na/ rgyal pos sngar gyi shing de la me tog ston dgos byas pas/ rgyal po yang ngo mtshar skyes nas bla mar bzung*/ slob dpon des gsang sngags kyi lha khang yang mang du bzhengs/

gtso bor bskyed rim dang sgrub thabs bshad/ kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa kha sbyor dri med mdzad mkhan de yin no/ /'grel pa 'di la snga 'gyur khyung po rnal 'byor gyis zhus nas/ glan dar ma blo gros kyis bsgyur ba la mdzad byang la yang ka yas+tha bgres pos mdzad ces 'byung la/ shong blo brtan gyi 'gyur la ni ḍaṃ ga da shas mdzad ces 'byung ste/ slob dpon gcig po de'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs yin par sem mo/ 'grel pa de ni slob dpon de'i gsung rgyun slob mas bkod pa yin nam sems/ 'di dang slob dpon bha ba skan+dha gcig par grags so/ /slob dpon des dur ha ri zhes bya ba la bshad/ des rdo rje gdan pa snga ma la bshad/ de la rdo rje gdan pa bar bas zhus so/ /slob dpon rdo rje gdan pa chen po na/ yul ma la bar sku 'khrungs/ rigs bram ze rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas/ phyis nā len+d+rar rab tu byung*/ gsang sngags phyi nang thams cad la mkhas shing*/ khyad par gdams ngag shin tu che/ byang chub kyi thugs 'byongs pas/ ma ga ta pa la shin tu bkra shis shing 'gro don che ba byung*/ a ti sha bzhugs pa'i dus tsam na rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan por mnga' gsol ba yin no/ /phyis bi kra ma shī la'i mkhan po yang mdzad/ de'i slob ma rdo rje gdan pa par pa rat+na ā ka ra gup+ta na/ shar phyogs gau ra'i yul du 'khrungs/ rigs ni bram ze/ chung ngu nas mdo sngags thams cad la mkhas shing*/ bsnyen pa yang grub pas/ rdo rje slob dpon du byed cing*/ rten dge bsnyen yin yang*/ dge slong mang pos mtha' bskor te chos ston cing yul dbus su 'ongs pas/ rgyal po'i blon po dad pa can zhig na re/ khyed dge slong gyis shig /gzhan du na dge slong sde snod gsum pas dge bsnyen la phyag 'tshal ba 'ad/ bstan pa la gnod pa yin zer/ nga la ma rgan mo zhig gso dgos pa yod pas/ dge slong mi byed byas pas/ des ma'i 'tsho ba la gser srang drug cu byin/

de nas slob dpon bi kra ma la shī lar dge slong mdzad/ der paṇ+ḍi ta dang rnal 'byor pa gdams ngag che tshad la gtugs/ slob dpon rdo rje gdan pa'i dbang rgyud gdams ngag thams cad kyang thugs su chud/ phyis rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan po rgyun ring du mdzad/ de nas lho phyogs kyi rgyud du 'byon par bzhed nas/ dpon slob sum cu tsam gyis sau rir byon/ sau ri'i rgyal po'i rmi lam du rdo rje gdan gyi mahā bo dhi'i zhal nas/ nga'i bstan pa lho phyogs su ma gtong zhes gsung ba rmis pa la/ nang bar slob dpon 'khor bcas lho phyogs su 'byon pa'i po ti dang*/ sku gzugs sogs gdan 'dren pa'i 'u lag dgos zhes byung bas/ rmi lam gyi don go nas/ der rgyal pos bzhugs par yang yang gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon shin tu thugs rje che bas sau ri nyid du bzhugs pas mtshan yang sau ri par grags/ slob dpon 'di yang bskyed rim mthar phyin/ yi dam gyi lha mang po'i zhal mthong*/ khyad par rgya gar gyi yul rang na gdams ngag che bar byed/ des slob dpon 'jigs med 'byung gnas la gdams pa yin/ des shu bhā ka ra gup+ta la/ des da shā pā la la/ des rnal 'byor pa badz+ra shrī la/ des rtsod pa'i dus kyi slob dpon thams cad mkhyen par grags pa chos 'byung dpal/ des sangs rgyas grags pa la/ des rin chen grags pa/ des rā ti gup+ta la gdams te/ de dag gi bar gyi lo rgyus rgyas par mi gsung*/ rin po che'i 'byung khungs lta bu'i gtam las/ bskyed rim brgyud pa'i gtam gyi skabs te drug pa'o// //bka' babs drug pa ni tshig gi brgyud pa yin te/ de yang tshig gi brgyud pa byas kyang*/ rgyud kyi bshad pa'i brgyud pa yin gsung*/ de la rgyud mang po zhig gi bshad bka'/ nā ro pa dang*/ mai tri pa gnyis la bzhugs/ yang 'ga' zhig ni klu sgrub kyis ār+ya de ba la bshad/ des sgra gcan 'dzin la bshad/

des zla ba grags pa la bshad/ des 'od zer 'byung gnas la bshad/ des ye shes grags pa la bshad/ des shān+ti pa la bshad/ yang rgyud kyi bshad pa mang po zhig ni 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis/ bram ze ye shes rdo rje la bshad nas de las brgyud pa dang*/ byang chub rdo rje las brgyud pa dang*/ yang dpal ye shes zhabs kyis rab zhi bshes gnyen la bshad/ des dpal sde dang*/ tsi lu ba dang*/ nag pa skyes dang*/ sman pa zhabs te bzhi la bshad/ de la bzhi la 'jam dpal ye shes kyis zhus/ de la don yod rdo rje chen pos zhus/ de la sid+dhi bi ras zhus/ de la a ti shas zhus/ de la bshes gnyen gsang bas zhus/ de la rdo rje gdan pa che bas zhus pa'i skor dang*/ yang mang po zhig na/ tsi lu pa/ tha ga na/ shan+ti pa/ dzñā na shrī mi tra/ jo bo rje/ rdo rje gdan pa snga phyi rnams nas brgyud pa'ang yod la/ yang slob dpon la li ta badz+ra ste rol ba'i rdo rjes o rgyan nas rgyud mang po spyan drangs/ slob dpon li la badz+ra la bshad/ des 'jam dpal ye shes la bshad/ slob dpon 'dis rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor gyis brdung stangs byas pas stag gzig gi rgyal po glang po che dang bcas pa phyed mar song ba'i gtam rgyud yod/ des ni don yod rdo rje chen po la gdams pa yin no/ /yang slob dpon spyod pa pa dang*/ slob dpon bram ze dpal 'dzin zhes bya ba phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa/ lho phyogs bai dar+bha na dge slong sde snod gsum pa chos smra ba chen po zhig /mu stegs kyi rgyal po gcig gis mgo gcod par rtsom pa la/ slob dpon rgyal po'i drung du byon te/ 'di mgo ma gcod byas pas/ 'o na khyod rang gi mgo slus mar thong zer bas/ slob dpon gyis dbu bcad nas byin/ der ma ha'i mgo cig bslan pas 'byar ba'i cho 'phrul bstan/ slob dpon ma he'i dbu can du grags so/ /des ha ri ke la la gdams/

'dis ni phyag rgya byi lar bsgyur bas/ bhi ra ḍi ba zhes grags/ des kyang 'jam dpal ye shes la gdams so/ /yang rgyud kha cig ni slob dpon ku ku ri pas spyan drangs pa yin te/ de yang shar phyogs bhang ga la'i yul du 'khrungs/ nā len+d+ra'i paṇ+ḍi ta dge slong zhig yin pa/ nags tshal dben pa zhig tu rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas/ der thun mong gi dngos grub mang po yang thob/ bskyed rim yang brtan par gyur/ nang gcig phug pa'i nang du khyi gu mo zhig byung*/ nyin zhag 'ga' re zas kyis gso zhing yod/ der lha rnams kyis slob dpon spyan drangs te sum cu rtsa gsum du 'dug pa la/ ji zhig na sngar gyi khyi gu de dran te/ lha rnams la nga 'dzam bu gling du 'gro byas pas/ ci yin zer/ khyi gu de ltogs te 'chi ba yod byas pas/ lha rnams na re/ khyed yun ring du ting nge 'dzin bsgom na/ da dung yang khyi gu'i rnam rtog kyang ma zhi'am zhes zer bas/ bden snyam/ slob dpon gyis lo bcu gnyis lha'i gnas su bzhugs/ de nas rang gi gnas su 'ongs pa na/ sngar gyi khyi gu de ni che ru ma song par 'dug skad/ brag gi phug la khyis grus pas chu mig kyang brdol snang ba/ khyi gu lag tu blangs pas bud med rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa cig tu gyur skad/ de ni rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ma yin te/ de dang lhan cig tu spyod pa spyod cing*/ skye bo'i mngon du khyi mor sprul pas/ slob dpon ku ku ri pa zhes grags/ des mkha' 'gro ma'i gnas las rgyud mang du spyan drangs/ pad+ma badz+ra zhes pa la bshad/ des til+li pa la/ des nā ro pa la/ des shan+ti pa la/ slob dpon de na/ ma ga dhu'i yul du bram ze'i rigs las 'khrungs te/ rig byed dang*/ rig byed kyi yan lag rnams dang*/ brtag pa brgyad la sogs pa la chung ngu nas mkhas par sbyangs so/ kha cig rje rigs su 'dod pa'ang yod gsung*/ o tan+ta pu rir thams cad yod smra'i sde la rab tu byung*/

nyan thos kyi sde snod gsum po thams cad thugs su chud/ bi kra ma shī lar byon te/ dze ta ri chen po la sogs pa mkhas pa mang po la theg pa chen po'i mdo dang bstan bcos phal cher gsan/ gnas brtan slob dpon chen por gyur te/ so ma pu ri'i mkhan por yang mnga' gsol/ lo 'ga' gtsug lag khang de nyid kyi gnas brtan mdzad do/ /de nas rin chen grags pa dang*/ nag po dam tshig rdo rje dang*/ tha ga na la sogs pa bla ma mang po bsten cing*/ rgyud brgya rtsa gsan cing thugs la bzhugs par grags so/ /de nas ma la bar phebs te/ lo bdun du thugs dam la bzhugs pas/ 'jam dbyangs dang*/ sgrol ma dang*/ mi pham mgon po rnams kyi zhal gzigs shing*/ dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi gsol ba las/ de kun yang thogs med kyi gzhung lugs dang mthun par gsung ba byung bas/ slob dpon 'di 'phags pa thogs med kyi lugs mthar thug tu mdzad do/ /de skabs slob dpon gyi mnal lam du 'phags ma sgrol mas/ sing ga'i gling du bzhud cig par lung bstan to/ /sing ga la'i rgyal po'i rmi lam du yang*/ 'dzam bu'i gling na slob dpon rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba yod pas/ de spyan drongs shig khyod kyi yul du theg pa chen po dar bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan pa byung bas/ slob dpon bhang ga lar phebs pa dang*/ sing ga la'i pho nyas bhang ga lar slebs pa dus mtshungs byung*/ theg pa chen po'i mdo sde nyis brgya tsam spyan drangs te/ sing ga lar lo bdun chos gsungs/ theg pa chen po'i dge 'dun lnga brgya tsam byung*/ mdo sde de dag shin tu dar bar gyur to/ /de sngon sing ga lar grub chen ni mang du byon mod kya/ dge 'dun thams cad nyan thos yin par mngon no/ /de nas 'dzam bu gling du phebs pa'i lam du rgya mtsho'i rlabs 'khrugs pa dang*/ gzings la skyod pa'i chom rkun byung ba rnams/ sngags bzlas pa'i bye ma gtor ba tsam gyis chom rkun rnams dbang du 'dus/

rgya mtsho'i rlabs zha/ de nas rgya gar lho phyogs kyi yul tha dad brgyud/ rim pas rdo rje gdan du phebs/ phyis rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar sgrub pa la bzhud par dgongs pa'i tshe/ rgyal po'i rmi lam du sangs rgyas dngos dang mjal ba zhig rmi ba/ nang par slob dpon byon pas/ rgyal pos bi kra mar bzhugs par gsol ba btab pas/ bi kra ma shī la'i shar sgo ba mdzad pa yin no/ /lo rgyus 'ga' zhig tu/ rgyal po 'di ma hi pā la yin zer ba dang*/ kha cig las de'i tsha bo rgyal po tsa na ka yin zer ba gnyis las/ phyi ma dag par mngon no/ /der mu stegs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta nyis brgya tsam dang snga phyir rtsod pa mdzad pas/ thams cad las rgyal te/ snyan pa'i grags pas phyogs thams cad du khyab/ sangs rgyas pa'i nang du yang mkhas pa la 'gran zla med de/ rgyal po'i bla mar bkur/ rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa zhes mtshan du gsol/ lha yul nas dgra bcom pa dngos su byon nas chos nyan par grags/ de ltar nyin mtshan du dam pa'i chos kyi bya bas dus 'da' bar mdzad cing*/ nam zhig na/ nā ro pa chen pos dngos grub brnyes pas/ de la gdams pa cung zad gsan/ dgung lo brgyar nye ba'i gnas skabs kyi tshe/ nyan bshad kyi bya ba ma lcogs nas/ gsol zas rags pa spangs te/ dben pa zhig tu bzhugs pa na/ sngon rang gi slob ma zhing pa zhigadus der grub pa thob nas rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la 'ongs nas phyag byas pa bla mas ma mkhyen/ de nas lus snang bar byas te/ slob dpon phyag 'tshal lo zhus pas/ khyod su yin gsung*/ dngos zhing pa tog rtse pa lags zhus pas/ ngas de yang brjed nas mi dran mod kya/ da khyod kyi gdams pa de nga la byin ces gsung pas/ tog rtse pa des gdams pa phul/ de'i don bsgoms pas rdo rje phag mos zhal bstan te grub pa thob bo/ /de nas sku lus kyang nyams stobs dang ldan par gyur te/ slob ma rnams la chos kyang ci rigs par gsung zhing bzhugs pa las/

lan cig srod kyi dus na/ bud med bzhis gdan gyi mtha' nas bteg ste yud tsam pa zhig la o rgyan gyi gnas su dngos su spyan drangs/ zhag mang du bzhugs te dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma'i dbus su tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po mdzad/ rdo rje'i glu mang du blangs/ tshogs kyi gtso bo rdo rje phag mos mdo rgyud kyi dgongs pa 'grel ba'i mchog tu dbugs dbyung ba mdzad/ de skabs ma ga dha'i slob ma dang skye bo'i tshogs kyis slob dpon gar byon cha med/ mi snang bar gyur pa yin nam snyam ste/ dus kyi mchod pa bya bar brtsams pa las/ slar yang khri'i steng du slob dpon nyid gang nas byon cha med par phebs/ slob ma rnams la rtogs pa brjod pa dang*/ lo rgyus gsung bar mdzad pas/ phal cher ngo mtshar du gyur cing*/ 'ga' zhig yid ma ches par yod pa las/ dus nam zhig na o rgyan gyi mi mang po zhigardo rje gdan du mchod pa dang tshong byed pa la byung ba la/ ma ga dha pa rnams kyi gtam dris pas/ o rgyan gyi dhu ma ṣ+ṭhi rar dngos su phebs/ yun ring du bzhugs/ chos kyang mang du bstan cing*/ nged rnams kyis kyang chos thos zhes zer bas rtsod med du gyur to/ /de nas kyang 'gro ba'i don ci rigs pa mdzad/ dgung lo brgya brgyad lhag tsam na sku 'das te/ slob ma rnams kyis bsil ba tshal du sku gdung zhugs la bzhen par brtsams pa na/ me cung zad 'bar ba na sku gdung mi snang bar gyur skad/ slob dpon 'dis rgyud sde mang po la rang stobs kyis 'grel pa mdzad cing*/ 'khor lo sdom pa la mdzad par rtsom pa na/ rdo rje phag mos bka' ma gnang ngo*/ /o rgyan gyi gnas su tshogs kyi 'khor lor gshegs pa na/ grub thob gzhan yang lnga bcu rtsa gsum tsam 'dus te/ de thams cad dang chos kyi 'gro ba mdzad par grags so/ /yang rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti bar pas/ slob dpon ku ku rā dza zhes pa nyin mo khyi stong la chos 'chad par byed cing*/

mtshan mo dam tshig gi kun tu spyod pa zhig yod de/ de la slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis zhus pa sogs rgyud mang po'i bshad rgyun byung mod kya/ da lta ni bklags lung tsam las cher med gsung*/ yang 'dir a ti sha'i lo rgyus kyang grags che bas ma bkod do/ /yang dus 'khor sogs rgyud sde mang po zhig na/ slob dpon pi to pa ste bsod snyoms pa bya ba zhig la phyag na rdo rjes lung bstan te/ rdzu 'phrul gyis sham bha lar byon/ rgyud mang po spyan drangs/ rat+na gi rir slob ma mang po la bshad/ pi ṭo pa nyid mthar mi snang ba'i dngos grub brnyes so/ /slob ma drug yod pa las/ gsum gyis rdo rje'i sku grub ste mi snang bar gyur/ dge slong a ba dhū tī pa dang*/ bo dhi shrī dang*/ nā ro pa gsum gyis dar bar mdzad do/ /yang a ba dhū tī pas sau ri pa la bshad do/ /de la pi ṭo pa ni rgyal po ma hi pā la'i dus su byon yang*/ a bhi yuk+ta ka nas kyang brgyud de/ de dag gi brgyud pa 'di'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /de ltar bla ma sna tshogs las brgyud nas bshad pa'i rgyun de dag thams cad slob dpon chen po snyigs dus kyi sangs rgyas 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pa la mnga'o/ /slob dpon de ni rgya gar lho phyogs o ḍi bi sha dang nye ba dza ri khaṇ+ḍa zhes bya bar pha rgyal rigs dang*/ ma bram ze'i rigs te/ gzhon nu nas rig byed yan lag dang bcas pa dang*/ sgra dang rtog ge la shin tu mkhas shing*/ chen por gyur pa na mu stegs kyi rgyud dang gzhung lugs thams cad mkhyen/ skyed mos tshal zhig tu sngags bzla bzhin yod pa na/ rang gi mdun du bu mo mdzes ma zhig byung*/ nga gdol pa'i bu mo yin/ khyod dang lhan cig spyod par 'dod zer ba la/ de ltar ga la rung zhes bzlog nas/ nga rigs mthon por gyur pa yin pas grags pa ma yin pa 'byung*/ 'dir ma 'dug byas pas/ de yang phyir song ste brtags pa na sgo rnams rang gis nang nas bsdams pa de kho na ma zhig par 'dug nas/

lha mo'am gnod sbyin mo'am su yin snyam pa las/ rang gi grogs mched sangs rgyas pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig yod pa la dris pas/ de ni rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin pa la/ dngos grub ma blangs pa ma legs kya/ khyod sangs rgyas pa'i rigs su 'dug pas/ shar phyogs su song la sangs rgyas pa gyis gsung nas/ de bzhin du byas/ bhang ga la'i yul du mdo sngags thams cad la mkhas par sbyangs/ slob dpon so so la dbang bskur ba yang mang du zhus/ dge slong sde snod 'dzin pa chen por song nas/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa thams cad kyi slob dpon du bskos/ lan cig lha khang gi 'khyams cig na 'dug pa la/ bu mo gzhon nu zhig gis/ ba glang gi sha khrag 'dzag pa cig khyer byung ste/ de slob dpon la gtad de/ nga gdol pa'i bu mo yin/ 'di khyod kyi don du bsad pa yin pas zo zer ba la/ nga gtsang ma'i rigs kyi dge slong*/ phyed du brdos pa'i ba glang gi sha ga la za gsungs pas/ de phyir ldog nas 'khyams smad du mi snang bar song*/ de yang rdo rje rnal 'byor mas dngos grub gnang pa ma blangs pa yin no/ /der slob dpon sde snod gsum gyi mnga' bdag yin yang*/ man ngag gis yid ma tshims par/ mthar thug pa'i man ngag gi bdag por grags pa thams cad la man ngag sna tshogs gsan cing yul thams cad du byon/ nā lan+dar yang mang du bzhugs/ sde pa bzhi'i 'dul ba thams cad dang*/ nyan thos kyi sde snod gzhan yang shas che ba rnams dang*/ theg chen sde gnyis kyi mdo dang*/ bstan bcos rigs mi gcig pa thams cad la shin tu mkhyen pa rgyas shing*/ nang pa'i rtog ge la sogs pa thun mong gi rig pa'i gnas rgya mtsho la mkhas/ khyad par du gsang sngags tsam la ches mkhas/ man ngag dang bcas pa yang thob/ de nas dpal sau ri pa'i drung du phebs/ khong la mnga' ba'i sngags kyi chos thams cad zhus/ rtsa ba'i bla ma yang 'di la mdzad/ slob dpon nyid kyis sngon rab tu byung ba'i mkhan po yang 'di yin zer/

sau ri'i dgon pa der bla ma'i man ngag bsgom bzhin bzhugs pa'i skabs shig tshes brgyad kyi dus nam srod cig la/ slob dpon sau ri pa'i chu len g.yog mo bu mo dge bsnyen ma zhig yod pa de kho na 'dra ba zhig /slob dpon gyi mun khang du byung ste/ snod chung ngu cig nas tshogs rdzas mang po bton nas/ nga slob dpon gyis btang ba yin/ khyed dang lhan cig tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya zer/ ngas tshogs 'khor sngar ma byas gsungs pas/ de ltar yang*/ da res gyis zer/ der slob dpon gyis rnam par rtog pas ma mdzad pas/ de na re/ khyed rgyud sum brgya shes shing*/ de rnams kyi mthar thug pa'i man ngag thob nas/ sngags kyi spyod pa la rtog pa byar ga la rung zer/ tshogs rdzas rnams khyer nas phyir song*/ der mun nag tu gyur pa na/ sgrub khang gi sgo rim pa gsum la gzigs su byon pa na/ sgo ni rang gis nang nas bsdams pa de kho nar 'dug nas/ the tshom skyes te/ nang par bla ma la mdang g.yog mo bdag la tshogs skyel du btang ngam zhus pas/ khyod rnam rtog shas che bas ma btang*/ khyod kyis ci mthong gsung*/ lo rgyus zhus pas/ bla ma na re/ 'o na rdo rje rnal 'byor mas dngos grub bstabs pa ma blangs par 'dug pa gsung*/ der yi mug nas zhag bdun du kha zas bcad de gsol ba btab pas/ bdun pa'i nub mo rmi lam du thog mar bud med rgan mo zhig byung*/ de rdo rje phag mor shes te bshags pa phul gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rje phag mo dngos su gyur nas khyod kyi skye ba mang por nga la bzlas pa dang mchod pa byas pas/ da res dngos grub lan gsum byin yang de ma blangs pa yin pas/ tshe 'dir mchog mi thob/ da ni bstan bcos mang du rtsoms/ gzhan la chos mang du shod/ bar dor mchog 'grub po gsung*/ de nas dur khrod sna tshogs su bsgom bzhin bzhugs/ der rgyal po rā ma pā la'i btsun mo zhig gis e ḍa pu ra zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang zhig bzhengs nas phul ba/

der yang ting nge 'dzin bsgom zhing bzhugs pas/ zla ba drug tu ting nge 'dzin thun gcig la gnas pa yang byung*/ dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du bzhugs dus/ bu gcig po gces po zhig gi ro skyel du byung ba/ nye du rnams sdug bsngal chen po 'dug nas/ bar do'i rnam shes bkug ste lus de la bcug nas slar gsos/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' nus pa can du grags nas/ rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan por spyan drangs/ der yang phyogs bzhi'i slob ma rnams la chos mang du gsungs/ rtsis kyis brtags pas mkhyen te/ bram ze dbul po zhig gi thab kyi 'og nas gter bton te byin/ chom rkun bsrung pa dang*/ dug zhi ba dang*/ dmag bzlog pa dang*/ gzhan yang rgyud nas gsungs pa bzhin gyi las tshogs 'grub/ sab+ta na ga ra zhes bya ba'i grong khyer chen po zhig la me shor ba bden stobs brjod pas zha/ de nas nā len+d+ra dang*/ bi kra ma la shī la'i mkhan por spyan drangs/ rgyal pos kyang bla mar bkur/ der rmi lam du rdo rje phag mos bstan bcos rtsom par slar yang bskul bas/ bdag lta bu'i bstan bcos kyis sems can la phan mi thogs zhus/ khyod bstan bcos rtsom pa'i tshe nga nyid lus la 'jug go gsung*/ de nas slob ma so sos gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ brgyad stong pa'i 'grel pa brtsams pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis shis pa brjod/ 'phreng ba skor gsum las/ dkyil chog rdo rje 'phreng ba brtsams pa'i tshe/ me tog gi char babs/ man ngag snye ma brtsams pa'i tshe/ thog mtha' bar gsum du bde dgyes dus 'khor gsum gyis shis pa brjod/ snyan pa'i grags pas phyogs thams cad du khyab/ gzhan yang phar phyin la thub pa dgongs rgyan dang*/ mngon pa la 'jig rten bsdus pa dang*/ 'dul ba la dge slong gi rig byed 'grel pa dang bcas pa dang*/ 'dul ba snang ba dang*/ dbu ma la dbu ma'i snye ma dang*/ gzhan yang yo ga'i rgyud 'grel pa med pa 'ga' re la 'grel pa dang*/

sgrub thabs grags pa can bzhi dang*/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i 'grel pa dang*/ ma rgyud mang po'i rgal lan dang*/ 'jigs med lam rim dang*/ mdor byas dang*/ rim lnga'i 'grel pa/ rtsis la 'jug pa/ dus 'khor gyi rgal lan/ dus 'khor gsal byed/ gzhan yang bstan bcos thor bu dang*/ sgrub thabs phra mo shin tu mang ba mdzad/ sgrub thabs sna tshogs bsdus pa yang bsgrigs/ nub phyogs kyi yul du gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i tshe/ lhung bzed nam mkhar bzed pas zas skom gyis khengs yong ba sogs mthun rkyen thams cad dzam bha las sbyar/ gzhan yang khri mon du bcug pa'i skye bo 'bum phrag du ma thar bar mdzad/ slob ma yang rgya bod kyi mkhas grub bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ste/ 'di phyin chad phyis byung ba'i rgya gar ba'i theg chen pa thams cad slob dpon 'di la tshad ldan du rtsi bar snang*/ des shu bhā ga ra gup+ta ste dge ba'i 'byung gnas sbas pa la bshad/ des da sha pā la bshad/ des rnam par grags pa'i lha la bshad/ 'di ni bhang ga la'i paṇ+ḍi ta shin tu mkhas pa zhig yin pa/ nā len+d+rar byon te/ chos dang gdams ngag thams cad la shin tu 'dris par byas/ yul nas 'byon dus rtsa ba'i bla mas rab tu byung gsungs yang*/ phyis sred pa shas che ba'i skyon gyis rab tu ma byung*/ chung ma blangs pas/ bu tsha ming sring gsum skyes/ lan cig rmi lam du spyan ras gzigs kyi gsung nas khyod kyi bla ma'i bka' bcag pas da ste lo gsum nas tshad rims kyis shi nas dmyal bar 'gro gsung*/ der shin tu skrag ste mtshams bcad nas thugs dam mdzad/ lung bstan ni thog tu babs te/ lo gsum nas tshad rims kyis btab sku 'das/ slob dpon rang gi snang ba la/ gshin rje'i skyes bus thag ring du khrid pa na/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs lha lnga nam mkhar byon nas/ rta mgrin gyis gshed ma rnams brdungs/ 'phags pas spyan chab nar gyis phyung nas 'di rang gi lus la skyol gsung*/

'phags pa'i 'khor rnams kyis tshur bskyal ba'i snang ba la/ slar yang rang gi lus la zhugs te/ de phyin chad rtag tu spyan ras gzigs kyis zhal gzigs shing*/ nus pa yang che/ rtogs pa yang bzang po brnyes/ grub pa thob pa yin/ grags pa yang che bar byung*/ des kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrībha dra dang*/ bud+dha shrī bha dra dang*/ rat+na rak+ṣi ta rnams la bshad/ de dag la mu ni shrī bha dras zhus/ des kā ru ṇa shrī bha dra la bshad/ des shākya rak+ṣi ta la bshad/ des su dza ta barma la bshad/ des kim+bi la'i paṇ+ḍi ta bi muk+ta de ba ste/ rnam grol lha la bshad/ des dza na gup+ta la bshad/ des ra ti gup+ta la bshad/ des da lta sa'i steng na 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba'i grub chen zhi ba sbas pa la bshad do/ /rin po che'i 'byung khungs lta bu'i gtam las/ rgyud bshad brgyud pa'i gtam gyi skabs te bdun pa'o/ /bdun pa man ngag thor bu sna tshogs kyi bka' babs na/ grub chen gau rak+ṣa'i man ngag rnams kyi bka' babs yin te/ de yang sde tshan bcu gnyis kyi dzo gi rnams na re/ mī na pas lha dbang phyug chen po la brten te/ thun mong gi dngos grub thob/ de la gau rak+ṣas rlung gi gdams ngag zhus te bsgoms pas/ phyag rgya chen po ye shes rang byung du skyes pa yin zhes zer ba sogs khungs med gtam sna tshogs yod kyang*/ re zhig bzhag go /'dir grub chen zhi ba sbas pa la sogs pa paṇ+ḍi ta khungs ma rnams kyi gsung dang*/ kho bo'i bla ma sangs rgyas sbas pa'i zhal snga nas kyis bla ma gau rak+ṣa'i gdams pa ma lus ba'i mdzod du gyur pa grub thob mang po dngos su zhal mjal/ nus mthu dang byin rlabs dpag tu med pa mnga' ba'i slob dpon 'bab stegs mgon po dang*/ nag po mgon po dang*/ bram ze mgon po ste/ gau rak+ṣa'i rjes 'brang rnam pa gsum po de'i bzhed pa mthun par byung bas kho bo'i bla ma yang 'di kho na 'thad gsung*/ de yang rgya gar shar phyogs su bram ze'i slob dpon byā li pa zhes bya ba zhig gis/

yo byad mang po bsags te lo bcu gnyis su dngul chu'i bcud len bsgrubs pas/ 'grub pa'i ltas cig kyang ma byung*/ yo byad kyang zad/ der dngul chu'i sgrub thabs kyi po ti chu bo gaṅgā la 'phangs te rang nyid ldum bu spyod cing song ba na/ ji zhig na/ o ḍi bi sha'i yul du sleb pa'i tshe/ chu gcig la khrus byas pas/ sngar po ti bskyur ba der ma god par rnyed/ de dngos grub thob pa'i ltas su shes nas/ slar rang yul du phyin pa na/ dngul chu ni g.yas su 'khor zhing sgra snyan po yang grags/ me tog gi char yang 'bab par mthong nas/ nang mi rnams la ci yin dris pas sus kyang ma shes/ rang gi bu mo glen ma zhig na re/ khang pa 'dir kho mo rdul dang ldan par gyur te/ khrus shig byas/ de phyin chad 'di ltar byung*/ ci yin ni ma shes zer/ de brtags pas/ sngon skyu ru ra dmar po ngo ma shes te/ de ni gzhon nu ma'i rang byung gi rdul yin pa las/ skyu ru ra mdog dmar po 'ba' zhig btab pas ma grub/ dus der khrus byas pa'i khrag gi zer ma zhig song bas dngul chu grub pa yin no/ /de nas dngul chu'i cho ga'i lhag ma rnams zla ba drug tu byas nas zos pas/ byā li pa rang dang chung ma dang*/ bu dang bu mo dang mna' ma ste lnga/ rta gcig dang drug gis rdzas kyi rig pa 'dzin pa thob skad/ der dngos grub la ser sna byas te/ lho phyogs kyi rgya mtsho'i gling gi gnas shig na/ phyogs bzhi car 'dam gyis bskor ba'i dbus na brag ri chen po zhig yod pa der 'dug skad/ dngul chu'i rdzas gser 'gyur rtsi de gzhan slong du byung dogs te/ mis mi thar pa'i sar bros pa yin/ dngos grub sgrubs pa ni nag po chen po'i rigs sngags la brten nas grub pa yin skad/ gtam de slob dpon klu sgrub kyis gsan te/ klu sgrub la mkha' 'gro ma'i rig sngags shig la brten nas mkha' la 'gro thub pa'i shing lo'i lham gnyis yod pa las/

gcig sbas shing*/ gcig gyon nas nam mkha' la 'phur te byā li pa'i drung du sleb/ der slob dpon gyis gser 'gyur gyi rtsi ster dgos byas pas/ des kyang khyed kyi lham de nga la byin zhigagaser 'gyur gyi rtsi sbyin du rung ngo zer/ der dngul chu'i gdams ngag mang po dang*/ bcud len gyi rigs bye ba brgya stong du ma dang*/ gser 'gyur gyi rtsi grub zin pa de nas kyang byin/ lham gcig po de yang de la phul/ lham sbas pa de gyon te nam mkha'i lam nas 'dzam bu'i gling du 'ongs/ bcud len gyi gdams ngag rgya cher spel ba yin no/ /de nas ljongs mu nin+d+ra zhes bya ba rgya gar byang phyogs yul sa 'dzin na/ ri dhi ko ṭa zhes bya ba yod/ ri de gser dang dngul du bsgyur bar bzhed pa la/ 'phags ma sgrol mas/ ma 'ongs pa'i sems can rnams 'thab rtsod du 'gyur bar mkhyen nas/ gser dngul du bsgyur ba bkag nas lan tshwar 'gyur bar byin gyis brlabs par grags/ deng sang yul sa 'dzin la ṭi la zer/ der byā li bas da ni ser sna byas kyang don med do snyam nas 'dzam bu'i gling du 'ongs so/ /de'i lus ni rig pa 'dzin pa thob kyang*/ sngar nang gi mngon par rtogs pa ni cung zad kyang med pas/ slob dpon tsar pa ṭi pa zhes bya ba phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa zhig la/ gdams ngag zhus te bsgoms pas/ ring por mi thogs par ye shes khyad par can rgyud la skyes te/ rtogs pa don gyi glu yang blangs/ sems can gyi don lnga ci rigs pa byas skad do/ khong gi bcud len gyi gdams pa thams cad slob dpon tsar pa ṭi pa la drin lan gyi tshul du phul/ bla ma des kyang dngul chu'i bcud len gyi cho ga de cung zad byas pas 'phral du grub/ des sems can mang po la phan gdags par bzhed de/ tsam+par+ṇa'i phyogs gcig na 'brog pa'i rigs shin tu mang ba yod cing*/ de na 'brog pa gcig shin tu nor che ba/

ma he dang*/ ba men/ ba glang*/ rta lugs sogs stong phrag du ma yod/ der bu la mna' ma zhig blangs pa de la'ang khye'u zhig btsas/ lan cig yul du ston mo chen po zhig byung ba'i skabs/ mna' ma dang bu chung der 'dug gzhan rnams song ba la/ grub thob tsar pa ṭi bas zas slong ba la byon/ der slob dpon la zas thams cad drangs/ slob dpon na re/ nang mi rnams mi khro na khyod sdod la nang par nas kyang nga la zas mang po byin zhigagal te khro na/ nga nags tshal ya gir me gtong gin sdod pas/ nga'i tsar bros la shog gsung*/ der nang mi rnams 'khor ba na/ snod thams cad 'phro can du mthong nas/ de thams cad kyis mna' ma la 'thabs pas/ des bu chung thogs te bros/ slob dpon gyi drung du byung ba la/ slob dpon gyis bcud len gtor bas/ ma smad gnyis rig pa 'dzin pa'i lus su gyur/ de'i rjes bsnyegs la skye bo mang po byung ba/ de rnams la yang slob dpon gyis bcud len gtor bas/ skye bo sum brgya tsam rig pa 'dzin pa'i lus su gyur te/ don chen po dang 'phrad skad/ der tsam pa'i rgyal pos gtam de thos pas/ skye bo mang po dang bcas te slob dpon gyi drung du song*/ rgyal pos phyag byas pas/ slob dpon khros pa ltar byas nas/ zas kyi snod sa la brdabs pas/ sa 'og nas klu'i rgyal po'i bu mo byung ste/ des yo byad mang po rgyal po la bstabs pas/ rgyal pos kyang*/ slob dpon grub pa thob par shes/ brag ri'i phug lha khang gi rnam pa can gnyis bcos te/ gcig tu ni slob dpon dang ma smad gnyis te gsum bzhugs par byas/ gcig tu ni sum brgya po gnas par byas so/ khye'u des kyang dngos grub mang du sbyin nus pa yin te/ mig nas mig sman/ rna ba nas ri lu/ kha nas ral gri sna nas rkang mgyogs/ rdo rje nas gser 'gyur rtsa/ 'og sgo nas bcud len rnams 'byung*/ de gsum po stan gcig la 'dug ste/
