ji srid byams pa ma byon gyi bar du 'gro ba'i don byed de gnas de la yang tsam+pa tsar+pa ṭi zer/ da lta yang gsol ba btab na dngos grub myur ba yin skad/ de'i slob ma ni grub thob kak+ku ṭi pa yin te/ de yang slob dpon chen po lū yi pa la phyi'i dbang bskur ba rnams thob kyang zer/ lū yi pa yin par gcig tu yang ma nges par snang*/ de nas grub thob tsar+pa ṭi pa la gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pa mtha' dag thob nas/ dur khrod rnams su spyod pa spyod cing bzhugs la/ rig ma bcu gnyis yod pa grong khyer du 'gro ba na khyim byar bsgyur te bzhud pas/ kak+ku ṭi pa zhes grags/ lar kak+ku ṭi pa yang mi gcig pa gnyis byung gsung*/ de'i slob ma ni mī na pa yin te/ de ni rgya gar shar phyogs kā ma ru'i nya pa yin/ nya pa'i rlung cung zad goms pas/ lan cig nya la lcags kyu btab ste drangs pa la/ nyas khong phar drangs te mid/ der las kyi mthu dang nya pas rlung bsgoms pas ma shi ba la/ chu bo ro hi ta zhes bya ba da lta'i bod kyi gtsang po 'ad/ kā ma rur sleb pa de yin pa/ de la u ma gi ri zhes bya ba'i ri de'u cig yod pa la/ lha dbang phyug gis u ma la rlung gi rnal 'byor gyi gdams ngag bshad pa/ chu de la nya song bas/ nya'i khog gi nya pas thos te bsgoms pas yon tan du ma thob/ lan cig nya pa rnams kyis nya de bzung nas bshas pas mi gcig byung*/ der sngar gyi rgyal po yang 'das/ sngon rang gi bu btsas ma thag pa yang der lo bcu gsum lon/ lar nya'i khog tu lo bcu gnyis bsdad/ de nas slob dpon tsar pa ṭi pa'i drung du song ste/ pha bu gnyis kas gdams ngag zhus te bsgoms pas/ gnyis kas kyang grub pa thob ste/ pha ni grub thob mī na pa zhes grags/ bu ni grub thob ma tshin dra ba zhes bya'o/ /grub thob mī na pa'i slob ma ni ha li ba ste zhing rmod mkhan/ mā li pa ste skyed mos tshal mkhan dang*/

taṃ po li ba ste/ so rtsi mkhan te grub thob gsum byung*/ mchin dra'i slob ma na/ tsau rang gi pa dang*/ gau rak+ṣa nā tha gnyis yin/ de yang dang po ni rgyal po'i bu zhig yin/ lan cig rgyal po yul gzhan du song ba'i dus shig na/ btsun mo chun ma zhig yod pa/ rgyal bu gzugs mdzes pa la chags te/ rgyal bu'i drung du yang yang 'ongs kyang*/ rgyal bus 'dod pa dang du ma blangs pas de khros te rgyal po byung ba'i tshe/ gos ni bral/ mgo ni thal bas g.yogs/ yan lag nas khrag byung ste 'dug pa la/ rgyal pos ci nyes dris pas/ 'di ni lha'i sras kyis byas te/ da kho mo'i drung du 'dod pa don du gnyer bar byung ba la/ kho mos 'dod pa dang du ma blangs pas 'di ltar bgyis so zer/ de nas rgyal pos ma brtags par rang gi bu nyes pa med pa rkang lag bcad de sa phyogs shin tu dma' ba skye bo mang po 'gro ba'i lam gyi 'og cig tu shing drung gcig gi rtsa bar bor/ der slob dpon ma tshin dra pa byung ste/ de la lo rgyus bshad pas/ 'tsho ba ni ngas sbyor nus na/ khyod kyis lo bcu gnyis sgom nus sam gsungs pas/ des kyang nus par khas blangs/ de nas slob dpon ma tshin dra pas/ rang gi slob ma ba glang rdzi phyug po zhig yod pa la pha gi'i shing drung cig na mi yan lag bcad pa zhig yod kya/ de la khyod kyis lo bcu gnyis su zas skyol gsung*/ des kyang de bzhin du byas/ mthar lo bcu gnyis song ba'i dus shig na/ lam de la tshong pa mang po mtshan mo 'gro ba la/ tsau rang gi pas khyed rnams su yin dris pas/ de rgyal po'i sho gam pa yin gyi dogs nas/ nged rnams sol ba 'tshong mkhan lags byas pas/ de na re/ 'o na khyed rnams kyi yo byad thams cad sol bar gyur cig gsung*/ tshong pa rnams tshong 'dus su sleb nas zong bkram pa na/ thams cad sol bar song 'dug ste/ phan tshun du ci nyes zhes brtags pa na/ tsau rang gi'i tshig gi nus pa yin par shes nas/

tshong pa de rnams kyis slar song nas tsau rang gi pa la bzod par gsol zhing*/ gsol ba btab pas/ tsau rang gi pa na re/ 'o na sngar bzhin gyur cig byas pas/ tshong pa rnams slar ldog nas bltas pa'i tshe/ yo byad thams cad snga ma bzhin du thams cad bzang por gyur nas 'dug /de slob dpon gyi drin yin par shes nas/ zong gi phud slob dpon la phul ba/ slob dpon ma 'dod de/ slar khong rnams nyid la gtad do/ /der rang gi yan lag sngar bzhin du gyur cig byas pas/ de bzhin du song ngo*/ /'gro ba'i don yang ci rigs pa mdzad de/ mkha' spyod du bzhud skad/ grub thob gau rak+ṣa ni zas sbyor ba'i ba glang rdzi de nyid yin te/ mtshin dra'i gdams ngag gis rnal 'byor thob nas/ phyi rol kyi bya ba gzhan spangs te bsgoms pas/ rdzu 'phrul dang dngos grub thams cad thob/ des bsams pa/ nga'i rtogs pa 'di gzhan la spo snyam ste/ yul thams cad du skye bo mang po la gdams pa bstan pas thams cad grol/ sems can bye ba phrag gcig ma grol gyi bar du mkha' spyod du mi 'gro bar dam bcas/ sems can dpag tu med pa grol bar mdzad bzhin pa'o/ /'di'i lo rgyus mtha' yas pa ni bri bar ma lang ngo*/ /de la slob ma'i gtso bo yang bcu gnyis yod mod kya/ 'dir bka' babs pa na/ grub thob kar+ṇa ri pa yin te/ de ni yul me ba ra'i rgyal po yin/ 'di'i btsun mo ping gā la zhes bya ba zhig yod sleb nas lo 'ga' song ba na/ rgyal po la shin tu snying nye ba yin yang*/ rgyal pos brtag pa'i phyir rang nyid skyed mos tshal du song*/ stag gis zos so zhes shi brdzun byas pas/ sdug bsngal gyis de ma thag btsun mo ping gā la shi nas lus dur khrod du bskyal/ rgyal po yang grong khyer du mi 'gro bar dur khrod de nyid du btsun mo shi ba'i ro'i drung du hā ha ba ping ga lā zhes zer zhing 'dug go /de ltar lo brgyad thal kyang skad/

bcu gnyis thal kyang zer te/ der grub thob gau rak+ṣa byon te/ rdza'i chu snod ḍe pi gcig lag nas lhungs ma thabs su byas nas bcag ste/ de'i mya ngan byed cing hā ha ba ḍe pi zhes zer zhing bsdad pas/ rgyal po na re/ rnal 'byor pa blun po chu snod chag pa la ci'i phyir mya ngan byed/ gzhan zhig bcos pas chog mod byas pas/ slob dpon na re/ 'o na khyed nyid blun gya/ nga'i chu snod chag pa da ltar shul yod la/ khyod kyi ping gā la na/ da ltar rdul tsam du song ste mi snang na/ da dung khyod nyid mya ngan byed pas so/ /der slob dpon grub thob grau rak+ṣar shes nas/ rjes su bzung bar zhus pas/ rgyal srid spongs gsung*/ des kyang rgyal srid spangs nas phyi bzhin du 'brangs/ lan cig gi tshe/ slob dpon sha chang la dga' ba ltar mdzad pas/ des grong khyer du sha chang nye bar song ba na/ bud med gcig gis phag gi sha drug dang*/ chang gi bum pa drug bsgrigs te/ rin du khyod kyi mig g.yas pa sbyin na 'tshong gi gzhan zong rnams mi dgos zer/ der slob dpon la mchod pa'i don du mig g.yas pa tsham tshom med par bton te byin no/ /de nas sha chang de rnams slob dpon gyi drung du phul bas/ khyod kyi mig g.yas pa gang du song gsung*/ slob dpon la mchod pa'i don du 'di rnams la btsongs pa yin byas pas/ khyod kyi de bden na mig g.yon pa yang nga la byin gsungs pa las/ g.yon pa yang phyung ste phul lo/ /der slob dpon mnyes te byin gyis brlabs pa lo gsum nas mig gnyis kyang sngon bzhin du gyur/ de rjes lo gsum nas grub thob chen por gyur to/ /'di la be ra gi nā tha zhes kyang zer/ de'i slob ma na/ nā gau pa ste/ bod skad gcer bu pa zhes bya ba yin no/ /da lta'i dzo gi mang po rgyal po ka ṇa ri pa dang*/ rgyal po bhar+tha ri gcig par 'dod pa shin tu 'khrul gsung ngo*/ /de la grub thob nā go pa na/

sku la snal ma gcig kyang ma gsol bas gcer bu pa zhes grags pa yin no/ /des lho phyogs kyi yul du bzhugs tsa na/ lan cig kong ku na'i rgyal po'i btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang du byon te gdams ngag gsungs pas/ rgyal po khros te/ slob dpon gyi yan lag lnga bcad nas phyogs bzhir bor ro/ /der 'grig pa la yang bcad/ de ltar lan bdun song ba'i tha mar/ slob dpon gyis dmod pa bor bas rgyal po yan lag lnga rang chad de shi /yang kun gyis gsol ba btab pas gsos so/ /de lta bu'i nus pa yang bstan/ de nas ri bo bhin da pa la bzhud de/ da lta yang lus ma spangs par yod skad/ de'i slob ma na/ bi ru pa chung ba'i slob brgyud go len nā tha te rdza mī mgon po zhes bya ba yin no/ /de yang dang po 'dul ba mang pos g.yengs pa la/ zhe bcad byas te/ rdza ma chen po gcig gi nang du zhugs nas/ dngos grub ma thob bar du 'di nas mi ldang ngo zhes dam bcas nas/ rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas lo bcu gnyis na grub pa thob ste/ skal ba dang ldan pa la gdams ngag ci rigs pa bstan nas/ bla ma gcer bu pa bzhugs pa'i drung du song ste mi snang bar gyur skad/ de'i slob ma ni o ko ra nā tha yin te/ yul dbus na rgyal rigs kyi bu chung zhigachung ngu nas pha 'das shing*/ phu bo'i khyim du gso ba las/ go len nā thas/ rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs shig byin no/ /de tsam ma gtogs lo bco brgyad lon gyi bar du rig pa gcig kyang ma bslabs pas/ phu bo dang khyim bdag mos blun po khyod kyis ci rung zhes spyos nas phyir phyung bas/ yid 'byung nas gzhan gyi yul du slong mos 'tsho zhing rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sgrub par byed/ mthar gyi lo bcu drug song ba na/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po yang skyes nas/ nub phyogs hiṃ ga lā tsi lha mo u ma'i gnas su song nas/ lha mo'i rdo sku'i steng du zla ba drug gnyid kyi 'od gsal thun gcig bsgoms pas/

lha mo skrag nas/ rnal 'byor pa rid dhi de hi ki ni dhi de zhes zer ba na/ rnal 'byor pas rdzu 'phrul dang gter gyis ci byed/ ye shes kyi dngos grub sbyin na blang mod/ lha mos bdag la grub thob sbyin du med/ gau rak+ṣa las long zer ba la/ des gau rak+ṣa 'tshol du song ba na/ yul go dā ba ri na rnal 'byor pa grangs med pa 'dug pa'i gral gyi tha ma zhig na/ bzhin shin tu mi sdug pa/ yan lag las rnag khrag lhung ba zhig 'dug pas de yin par shes nas/ phyag btsal zhing gsol ba btab pas/ des byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshod ma phul gang gnang ba 'thungs pas/ de nyid du shes bya'i yul kun la mnga' brnyes/ chos nyid mngon sum du mthong ba'i grub thob chen por gyur nas chos bshad do/ /des paṇ+ḍi ta chen po rā ti gup+ta la gdams pa yin no/ /de ni rgya gar lho phyogs su sku 'khrungs/ rigs ni tshong dpon gyi bu/ cher skyes pa na sangs rgyas pa'i sde la rab tu byung ste/ sde pa ni thams cad yod par smra ba yin gsung*/ blo shin tu rno bas 'dul ba 'bum sde dang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'bum sde yang thugs la gzung*/ phyi rol kyi rig pa'i gnas la shin tu mkhas/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos 'tshol bar bzhed nas/ shar phyogs dang*/ rgya mtsho'i gling phran dang*/ nub phyogs kyi gnas mang por byon/ slob dpon chen po rin chen grags pa las dkyil 'khor bcu gsum du dbang bskur ba zhus/ yang slob dpon chen po dzñā na gup+ta la/ ra khang gi yul du dkyil 'khor drug cur dbang bskur ba zhus/ bal po'i yul gyi paṇ+ḍi ta dā sha ba lā la ping ha zhes bya ba la dbang dang gdams ngag mang po zhus/ rgyud kyi bshad pa yang slob dpon de gsum la zhus pa shas che/ lan cig rgya gar shar phyogs su ston mo chen po zhig gi sa na/ mu stegs ral pa can 'dra ba'i rnal 'byor pa hrul po gcig 'dug pa la/

de dang gtam 'dra byas pas/ gzhan sems shes par 'dug nas su yin dris pas/ grub thob a si ta gha na yin gsung*/ der zla ba tsam bsten te gdams ngag kyang mang du gsan skad/ grub thob o ko ra nā tha la yang gdams pa dpag tu med pa gsan/ de nas yul ru lu ra ti la sogs pa lho phyogs kyi yul gyi gtsug lag khang sum cu tsam gyi gnas brtan mdzad/ bskyed pa'i rim pa la brtan pa thob/ rgyud sde lnga bcu tsam mkhyen pa yin no/ /rin po che'i 'byung khungs lta bu'i gtam las/ gdams ngag sna tshogs brgyud pa'i gtam gyi skabs te brgyad pa'o// //de ltar bka' babs de thams cad ni grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po zhi ba sbas pa la mnga' ba yin te/ de la slob dpon 'di ni lho phyogs kyi grong khyer dza la maṇ+ḍal te chu'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya bar 'khrungs/ rigs ni rgyal rigs/ gzhon nu nas rig pa'i gnas phra mo mang po/ sgra dang rtog ge yan lag dang bcas pa rnams la sbyangs/ yab kyang rje btsun ma sgrol ma nyams la zhal mthong ba'i sngags pa yin/ de la sgrol ma'i dbang bskur ba dang*/ sgrub thabs kyang gsan/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa la rgya mtsho'i 'gram kong ku na'i yul du gser gyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba'i gnas gzhi gcig dus de tsam na btsun tshugs bzang ba/ chos grwa dar ba/ dge slong lnga bcu tsam/ dge bsnyen yan chad la 'dus che dus stong phrag tsam 'ong ba cig yod pa der mkhan po rā ti gup+ta la bsnyen par rdzogs/ dang por nyan thos kyi sde snod rnams dang*/ de nas dbu sems kyi gzhung lugs thams cad la mkhas par sbyangs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa dang*/ sems tsam mdo bzhir grags pa la sogs pa gsung rab du ma thugs nas bshad/ mkhan po la yon dbul ba dang*/ rnyed bkur chen po bya bar bzhed nas/ sing ga la'i gling du yug cig byon/ der nag po chen po'i rig sngags cung zad grub pa dang*/

chos bshad pa'i mthus rnyed bkur dpag tu med pa byung*/ de rnams bla ma'i drung du bsnams te rin po che sna bdun gyi phung po chen po byas te phul/ dbang dang gdams ngag rnams zhus pas/ thun mong gi dbang thams cad bskur/ rgyud lnga bcu tsam gyi bshad pa phal cher yang gnang*/ 'on kyang thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang dang gdams ngag rnams ni ma thob bo/ /de nas lo mang por bla ma'i tha na thal ba 'phyag pa tshun chad kyi g.yog mdzad cing*/ rang gi longs spyod chos gos gsum ma gtogs bla ma la phul/ rang gi zas ni grong khyer gyi bsod snyoms kyis mdzad/ de ltar lo drug song ba'i rjes su/ bla mas kyang thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang gong ma rnams dang*/ byin rlabs sna tshogs pa dang*/ gdams ngag thams cad gnang*/ de dag bsgoms pas nyams bzang po yang skyes/ der mkhan po sku 'das te/ gtsug lag khang de thams cad kyi bdag po yang mdzad/ dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan lo dgu'i bar du mdzad/ de dag tu yang mtshan mo ting nge 'dzin 'ba' zhig bsgom bzhin bzhugs/ 'on kyang nyin mo dge 'dun gyi bya ba sna tshogs pa des ye shes mi 'phel bar mkhyen nas/ dge 'dun la yang yang gnang ba zhus kyang*/ dge 'dun rnams kyis ma gnang ba la der slob dpon gyis chang gsol/ grong khyer gyi srang kha rnams su skad rigs sna tshogs kyis glu blangs sgo dang sgo ru gar sna tshogs mdzad pa/ dge 'dun rnams na re/ mkhan po chos mang po la mkhas pa yin pas chad pa mi byed kya/ da khyed 'tsho ba gang bde bar song zhes zer bas/ da ni don thams cad 'grub snyam ste/ yul sna tshogs su brgyud/ yul tsi ba la'i grong khyer gcig gi 'dabs su spyil po zhig tu/ lo gsum sgrub pa mdzad/ de nas nub phyogs u rgyan gyi yul du bzhud/ der yang lo gsum tsam bzhugs/ lan cig chu 'gram zhig na smad 'tshong ma drug khrus byed cing 'dugaji zhig na de rnams rtsig pa zhig gi phag tu song*/

'di rnams ci zer dgongs te gsan pas/ gcig gis gcig la gtam gyi tshul gyis phyir bzlog man ngag drug bshad kyin 'dugade la sogs pa ngo mtshar du ma gzigs shing*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis grogs mdzad pas/ ye shes gong nas gong du 'phel yang*/ de kho na nyid kyi gnas ma rtogs nas/ de kho na nyid ston pa'i slob dpon sems bzhin yod pa la/ der chang 'tshong ma zhig gi sgor byon pas/ de rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par gyur nas/ shar phyogs kyi yul na slob dpon ye shes bshes gnyen zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ des khyod la 'dod pa'i dngos grub ster bar 'gyur gsung*/ de nas slob dpon rim gyis shar phyogs su byon/ grong khyer gyi mi thams cad dang*/ phyi nang gi gnas thams cad du song ste ye shes bshes gnyen dris pas kyang bshad rgyu mi 'dugatsar+ya pa'i sde rnams kyi nang du phyin te dris pas kyang gzhan su la'ang bshad rgyu med/ lan cig de na rnal 'byor pa rgan po zhig na re/ de ni nged tsar+ya pa'i slob dpon nus mthu chen po zhig yin pa la/ da gar gshegs cha med nas lo mang po lon zer/ de nas kyang yang yang btsal bas/ lan cig nags kyi grong dang nye ba'i mchod rten gcig gi grib ma la 'gron btsun khyim btsun gyi cha byad gcig nyal nas 'dugade la ye shes bshes gnyen khyed kyis mthong ngam dris pas/ de'i zhal nas/ shes te nga yang de'i drung du 'gro ba yin/ 'di nas shar phyogs na ti pu ra zhes bya ba'i grong khyer na yod gsung*/ bstan par zhu byas pas/ nga'i nor 'di rnams nags 'di la khyod kyis 'khyer thub na bstan gsung*/ der khur lci mo zhig bdug pa bsnams te byon/ 'gron btsun de ni sngon la song*/ zhi ba sbas pa ni lam du chom pos bzung*/ khur bshig pas rdo 'ba' zhig byung ste/ rkun po rnams tshig pa zos te/ slar yang cher brdungs/ sa la ro bzhin 'gyel ba na/

yang slob dpon de byung ste/ chus bkrus shing sngags btab pas 'phrul du gsos te 'gro thub par byung*/ ti pu rar byon pa'i tshe bla ma bstan par zhu byas pas/ mtshe'u gcig gi 'gram du khrid nas/ der bla ma rang gi gzugs brnyan shar ba la/ ye shes bshes gnyen ni 'di yin zhes gsungs/ des kyang ngo sprad pa bzhin du song nas/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po zhig kyang skyes/ 'o na bdag rjes su bzung bar zhu byas pas/ khyod ci brtol che/ rnyed bkur med par rjes su bzung bar zhu zer ba gsung nas/ khros shing mang du brdungs/ der khyim bdag nor chen po zhig la/ ngas khyod kyi las kyi g.yog byas na/ nga la gla ji tsam ster byas pas/ de na re nyi ma re la gser di nar re re sbyin zer/ de'i g.yog lo gcig mdzad/ rgya gar ba'i zhing las kyi khol bo ni shin tu sdug gsung*/ der gzhan yang yo byad mang dag ster mkhan byung ba/ de thams cad slob dpon la phul/ yang bla ma'i phyi bzhin song ba na/ lan cig nags gseb zhig na ma he mo sna thag btags pa zhig 'dug 'di khrid cig gsungs/ bla ma sngon la gshegs/ zhi bas de khrid nas phyin pas/ bdag pos phyi bzhin bsnyegs pas zin nas/ des shin tu btags te/ thang la ro bzhin song ba la/ bla ma byon nas thabs mdzad pas gsos/ yang lan cig bla ma'i rdzas 'dra rtswa khyim pa 'dra la bcol te bzhag dpon slob gnyis grong khyer la byon te ldog phebs pas/ rtswa khyim thams cad la me 'ur 'ur 'bar gyin 'dug der bla ma rang gi rdzas la thugs khral che che ltar mdzad kyin 'dug pas/ 'o na bdag gis blang ngam zhus pas/ long gsung*/ der me'i dbus su tsham tshom med par zhugs te bla ma'i rdzas rnams blangs pas/ rkang lag thams cad rus pa la thug gi bar du tshig lus thams cad kyang chu bur du gyur/ de la shi yang bla ma'i rdzas kyi phyir yin snyam ste/ 'gyod pa'i sems ni skad cig kyang ma byung*/

de yang rdzas 'gangs che ba ni med de chu snod gcig na ri ke le'i phor pa gcig shing gi maṇ+ḍal gcig ka pā la gcig rnams yin gsung*/ der nges par 'chi'am snyam pa la/ bla mas sngags dang sman mdzad pas ring por mi thogs par gsos/ der zhi ba sbas pa'i thugs la/ bdag gi lus ngan pa 'di gso ba'i phyir du slob dpon gyi sman zad par byas pa ni ma legs/ da yong slob dpon gyi phyir du bdag nyid dka' ba du ma byed pa ni rang gi don 'ba' zhig yin pas/ de la slob dpon las sngags dang sman blang ba shin tu mi rung bas/ slob dpon nga'i g.yog tu mi bkol zhes dam bcas/ yang lan cig slob dpon ra khang gi yul du 'byon par bzhed nas/ grur zhugs pa na/ ji zhig ltar na/ chu'i dkyil nas nya mche ba can zhig nyang gis byung*/ des slob dpon la gnod par gyur gyi dogs nas/ de la mdung thung zhig bsnun/ nya des zhi ba sbas pa'i zhabs la rmugs/ chu'i dkyil du nyas 'khyer la khad pa la/ bla ma dran par byas pas/ nya'i kha nas btang ste nya chu la song ngo*/ /der rmas sdug bsngal bar gyur kyang slob dpon gyi rim gro byed pa la ma g.yel bar byas pas/ zhag bdun song ba'i tho rangs shigaci byas med par zug rngu rnams zha/ yang shar phyogs ra khang gi yul der slob dpon brag phug cig tu bzhugs/ zhi ba sbas pas grong khyer sna tshogs nas yo byad 'tshol ba sogs don mang po la 'gro dgos/ yul de ni chu klung shin tu mang bas/ yang yang rkyal zhing brgal dgos pa las/ srog chags si sā ra te 'dzin khri'i rigs su gtogs pa/ bod la chu srin spar du grags pas kyang lan gsum bzung mod kya/ slob dpon rang gis kyang nus pa brnyes pa dang*/ bla ma dran par byas pas des kyang btang ba 'ba' zhig byung*/ gzhan yang srog chags kīṃ ka ra dang*/ nya dang chu'i sbrul la sogs pas zos shing phug pas/ rmas pa ni bgrang du med gsung*/ de thams cad la bla ma'i sngags dang sman gcig kyang ma blangs te/

sngags dang sman sogs phan pa'i thabs thams cad gzhan las bslangs/ yul der slob dpon lo gsum bzhugs pa/ 'khor mchog gi rnal 'byor pa lnga/ rig ma bcu gnyis dang bcas te/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo yang dang yang du spyad pas/ zhi ba sbas pa ni rgyu 'grul gzhan pas mang pa mdzad dgos shing*/ yul de'i chu'i srog chags gzhan pas gdug pa che bas/ lo gsum du lus shin tu sbyongs spyod che yang*/ thugs la skyo dub gcig kyang ma byung ngo*/ /de dus kyi 'khor de kun phyis dngos grub thob pa sha stag byung gsung*/ de nas dpon slob gnyis gru la brten te bhang ga lar byon/ dang po mjal nas de bar gdams ngag tshig gcig kyang ma gnang bas/ der gdams ngag gnang bar zhus pa na/ rnyed bkur med par rjes su bzung mdzod ces/ de nyid thob ma thag tu slob dpon la/ lhag pa'am mnyam zhes 'gran byed mi de la/ dpal chen rdo rje sems dpa'ang 'jigs zhes gsung*/ zhes bya ba yin gsung ste/ khros shing ma mnyes pa'i tshul bstan te bros nas bzhud do/ /der bang thag pa nas rgyugs kyang rjes ma zin/ zhag bdun du yul de'i phyogs thams cad du btsal yang ma rnyed/ de nas thag ring por song nas/ grong khyer sna tshogs su mi rnams la dris kyang cha med/ de ltar zla ba gnyis su btsal yang ma rnyed pas/ gho ra ṭaṃ ḍa zhes pa'i grong khyer zhig tu zhag bdun ngu bzhin gsol ba 'debs kyin bsdad/ der yang ma byon pas/ da ni tshe 'dir skal ba med pa yin/ 'di nyid du shi bar bya snyam ste/ brag de'u gcig gi rtse nas mchongs pas kyang yan lag bsnad pa sogs med cing*/ gnod pa cang ma byung*/ der yid skyo bas cung zad cig bsdad pa na/ rig ma ngo shes pa cig phyogs der byung ste/ slob ma bzang po ci byed kyin yod gsung*/ slob dpon gyi rig ma bla ma yin pas/ zhabs la spyi bos gtugs te/ kho bo ni skal ba med de/ bla mas bor bas 'chi bar sems byas pas/

de na re/ khyod slob dpon gyis nges par rjes su 'dzin par 'dug gsung*/ der yid cung zad spro ba skyes te/ slob dpon gang na bzhugs dris pas/ bla ma ni nga'i khyim du byon nas zhag 'ga' bzhugs te da lta bal por bzhud gsung*/ bud med de mi snang bar thal lo/ /der zhi ba sbas pas lam du zhugs byon pa na/ brag rtse nas mchongs pa mthong ba'i mi rnams kyis/ ci'i phyir mchongs zhes 'dri ba mang du byung ba la/ lan ni ma smras/ kho bo bla ma ma rnyed pas sdug bsngal ba la/ 'di kun sos re dal na snyam tshig pa za bar byung skad/ de nas bal po'i yul du byon te/ grong khyer dang gnas gzhi so sor dris pas/ gzhan rnams su shod mkhan ma byung*/ yaṃ bu'i nag po chen po'i lha khang gi dkon gnyer na re/ de 'dir byung ste zhag 'ga' tho co'i spyod pa 'dra byas nas kā ma rur song zer/ de ma thag kā ma ru la bstad nas byon pas/ nags kyi lam rnams su chom rkun dang*/ stag dang*/ ma he dang*/ bse ru la sogs pa 'jigs pa ji snyed byung yang*/ bla ma 'ba' zhig dran par byas pas gnod pa ma byung*/ kā ma ru'i grong khyer ga ru ḍa gha ṭa na slob dpon bzhugs pa dang mjal/ dga' ches te lus sa la brdabs pa'i phyag brgya stong du ma byas so/ /der bla ma na re/ gal te khyod gdams ngag 'dod na/ nga'i bla ma a si ta gha na mkha' spyod du gshegs pa'i sa/ he raṃ pa'i brag gi rtse de yin pas/ der so phag gi mchod rten mi 'greng lnga yod pa zhig bzhengs shig gsung*/ de nas yul der phyin nas gos zhig yod pa/ phag bre'i rin la sprad nas/ pha gu brdeg pa dang*/ so gtong ba thams cad kyang zhi ba sbas pa gcig pas mdzad/ de nas khyim bdag dad pa can gcig gis grogs cung zad byas nas/ he raṃ pa'i rtse mor mchod rten bzhengs zin nas/ bla ma'i drung du 'ongs pa na khyim bdag la grogs bcol ba des mi rung zhes gsungs te/ de nas kyang lo gcig gi bar gdams ngag ma gnang*/

de rjes o ḍi sha'i grong khyer ka ṭa ka bha na ra si na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ khyim zhig bstan te khyim 'di na gser mang du yod pa brkus nas nga la phul zhig gsungs/ de yang khyim de ni mgar ba nor che zhing ser sna dam pa/ phyi nang gi rab tu byung ba gang la yang sdang ba zhig yin te/ dang por de'i khyim du zhi ba sbas pas zhugs phyin pa na/ de'i sgo bsrung gis brdungs rdeg mang po byung*/ der slob dpon sku'i stobs che bas/ sgo bsrung de phyag gcig gis mnan te/ nang du tshangs kyis zhugs pas/ mgar ba de lcags kyi las byed pa dang thug ste/ de shin tu khros nas lcags gong dmar 'bar ba zhig zhi ba sbas pa'i sku la 'phangs pas na bza' yang ma tshigasku la yang gnod pa ma byung ste/ der khyi mche ba dug can mang po rbad byung ba de rnams kyis slob dpon la rmugs kyang sku la gnod pa ma byung zhing*/ thugs kyang g.yo ba med par 'dug pa des mthong nas cung zad dad par gyur te/ de na re/ khyod der 'dug zas drangs kyi zer/ zas ngan ngon zhig drangs/ der shin tu dgyes pa ltar gsol bas/ de yang cung zad ngo mtshar skyes shing*/ khyed zas 'di tsam gyis tshims na nang par nas kyang shog cig zer/ der yang dang yang du byon pas 'dris par gyur pa'i mtshams shigade'i khyim dang yo byad kyi gnas tshul thams cad kyang slob dpon gyis shes nas/ des sdig pas bsgrub pa'i gser srang stong phrag tsam yod pa su la yang sbyin par mi nus pa de/ lan cig khong rnams yengs pa zhig la/ slob dpon gyis brkus nas 'ongs ste bla ma la phul bas/ bla ma na re/ bu de legs/ ser sna can gyi nor 'di gzhan la sbyin dgos gsungs te/ ra khang gi yul gyi dge 'dun rnams la phul zhig gsung ba ltar 'bul bar byon/ phyis zhi ba dus gzhan lan cig grong khyer du song ba la/ sngar gyi mgar ba des zin te/ yul de'i rgyal po mu kun+da de ba la gtad nas/

sngar gyi lo rgyus rnams bsnyad/ der stes dbang gis skye bo mang po yang 'dus/ rgyal pos slob dpon nyid la dris pa la/ slob dpon gyis ser sna can gyi longs spyod ni brkus pa'am phrogs te gzhan la byin na/ de nyid bsod nams 'phel ba yin gsungs pas/ der mi thams cad kyis gad mos btab ste/ 'di ni rkun po chen po zhig ste/ 'di'i spyi brtol la ltos/ 'di ltar rkun mo byas pa yang yon tan du rtsi'o zer/ der rgyal pos re zhig btson khang du zhog cig phyis brtags la chad pas gcod do zhes rgyal po skye bo dang bcas pa so sor gyes so/ /bar der slob dpon ye shes bshes gnyen gyis dgongs pa mdzad pas/ btson khang gi steng du bya rnam pa sna tshogs pa 'dus/ mtha' kho ra khor yug tu khyi dang ce spyang sna tshogs pas nyin mtshan bye brag med par bskor zhing skad 'byin pa byung pas/ the tshom du gyur pa la/ de'i phyi de'i nyin bar de pho brang la yang de bzhin du byung bas der rtsis pas/ rnal 'byor pa btson khang du bcug pa zhig gi nus pa yin zhes byung*/ de nas zhag 'ga' zhig lon pa na/ btson khang gi sgor ye shes bshes gnyen byon nas btson bsrung rnams la bye ma gtor bas thams cad rengs/ sgo lcags kyang rang bye nas zhi ba sbas pa dang btson lnga stong lhag cig thar/ zhi ba sbas pas btson khang du zla ba phyed song*/ gser blangs pas bla ma mnyes pa re dga' snyam pa ma gtogs mi dga' ba dang yi mug sogs gtan nas ma byung ngo*/ /de nas slob dpon gyi phyi bzhin du 'brangs te yul tri ling ga zhes bya ba'i grong khyer zhig tu byon/ grong khyer der phebs tsam nyid nas bla mas kyang gdams ngag mang du gsungs/ de nas lo gnyis tsam song ba na bla ma na re/ da dbang bskur bar bya dgos pas/ chu bo'i pha rol kyi khyim pha gi na/ rigs dang ldan pa'i sngags can ma 'di lta bu zhig yod/ de 'dir khrid la shog gsung*/

nang bar 'gro'am zhus pas do nub nyid khrid la shog gsung*/ der chu bo chen po zhig yod pa la rkyal nas song ste/ nyi ma nub tu nye ba na khyim der sleb/ khyim de ni rgyal rigs rgyal po'i glang chen gnas pa zhig yin/ grong khyer gyi ming yang lañdza ka ra zhes bya ba yin gsung*/ khyim der kho bo 'grul ba zhig yin yud tsam gnas g.yar gsungs pas/ des kyang nang du byon zer te byon/ der slob dpon gyis steng 'og kun tu brtags pa na/ bla mas lung bstan pa de ni khyim bdag de'i bu mo yin te/ de ni shin tu srungs pa yin pas thabs ci zhig gis thob par 'gyur sem mo/ /de nas srod kyi dus su skye bo'i rgyu 'grul chad pa na/ slob dpon gyis rig sngags kyis ngag bcings te/ bud med de re zhig cang mi smra ba byas nas/ stobs chen pos phrag pa la bkal te/ sgo rnams kyang stobs kyis phyes nas bros so/ /grong khyer gyi phyi rol tu sleb pa na/ nang gi mi rnams kyis rjes bsnyegs kyang ma zin/ nub mo de nyid la chu bo la rkyal nas 'ongs/ bla ma'i drung du nam phyed kyi dus su sleb/ bla ma na re/ dus kyang la nye legs pa yin gsung*/ der tho rangs kyi dus su dbang bskur/ zhag bdun gyi bar du byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa mtha' dag stsal/ gnas de yang brag de'u gcig la yod de/ sngon slob dpon klu sgrub kyi phug pa yin gsung*/ glang chen gnas kyi rjes gcod kyi mi rnams kyang khong gnyis chus khyer bar bsam ste/ phyogs der phyis ma byung*/ de nas bla ma sbyin sreg gcig mdzad pa'i skabs/ slob dpon gyis las kyi rdo rje mdzad pa la/ bya ba cung zad cig 'khrul bas/ bla ma khros nas thab kyi me mang po gtor bas/ des rkyen byas te bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes nam mkha' lta bu mtha' dbus med pa mnyam nyid khyab brdal gyi ye shes mngon du gyur nas chos thams cad kyi gting sleb/

der rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen por gyur to/ /bud med des kyang rnal 'byor ma byas te/ spyod pa pa'i sde rnams su song bas/ rnal 'byor ma me na ka zhes bya bar grags/ rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam/ lta stengs bzhi grub/ chu la mi bying*/ phyis dngos grub kyang thob bo/ /der bla ma ye shes bshes gnyen na re/ zhi ba sbas pa/ ngas khyod la gdams ngag thams cad ni bstan zin/ don chen po yang grub/ da khyod sau raṣ+tar song la/ thog mar spros med kyi spyod pa gyis/ de nas gsangs te spyod pa gyis/ de nas spros bcas kyi spyod pa byed par zhig bskul bar 'ong bas/ de'i tshe spros bcas kyi spyod pa gyis shigatshe 'di nyid la rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phangs thob po gsung*/ der zhi ba sbas pas/ bdag 'di ltar chos thams cad kyi gting sleb pa ni bla ma'i sku drin lags pas tshe 'dir dngos grub mchog ma thob kyang sla'/ bla ma nyid kyi rjes su 'brang zhus pas/ bla ma na re/ ngas khyod gcig pu'i phyir lo de snyed cig mi'i yul du gnas pa yin/ de bas na nga'i rtogs pa 'di skal ba dang ldan pa thams cad la khyod kyis spos shig ces gsung ste/ de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /der bla ma'i thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes ni bdag nyid kyi mngon du gyur pas/ som nyi thams cad ni chod mod kyang*/ bla ma'i gzugs kyi sku de mi snang bar song bas/ thugs rab tu gdung bar gyur te glu blangs so/ /der slob dpon ye shes bshes gnyen de lo bcu tsam bsten pa yin gsung*/ de nas gdung ba'i glu len pa'i tshul gyis zab mo'i don ston bzhin du rim gyis rgya gar nub phyogs sau raṣ+tar byon/ dzo na gha ṭa zhes bya ba'i grong khyer zhig dang mi ring pa'i phyogs shig tu smra ba thams cad spangs/ yang nas yang du mnal zhing sad pa na yang mnyam par bzhag pa kho nas bzhugs/ lam du lan cig stag gzig mong gol zhig gis phyag zhabs me la bsregs pas kyang*/

rdo sku'am shing sku me la bsregs pa bzhin du tshor ba med pa ltar bzhugs/ yang hen du'i rta pa zhig slob dpon la dad de/ gser dang dngul gyi me tog bre gang sku la gtor bas kyang snga ma ltar tshor ba med pa ltar 'dug bdag gi bla ma'i zhal nas gtan ma tshor ba ni min/ stong pa nyid du gzigs pa yin gsung*/ de ltar lo gnyis 'das sam yang zer/ phyed dang gnyis song ngam yang zer/ phyi ma dag ste spyod pa zla ba drug tu spyod dgos pa/ da ltar gyi dus 'grub dka' ba yin pas/ lan gsum du bskyar ba yin gsung*/ de ni shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa'o/ /de las grol te grong khyer dang nags tshal rnams su rgyu zhing*/ gsang ste spyod pa cung zad mdzad pa la/ ji zhig nas a ba dhū tī 'jig rten pa'i mngon du spyod pa smyon pa'i brtul zhugs zla ba drug tu mdzad de/ bar bar du skye bo rnams la chos kyang bstan pas ye shes mchog skyes pa mang du byung*/ grong khyer gyi mi mang pos kyang*/ slob dpon ye shes can du shes nas ci rigs par mchod pa la/ yul de'i rgyal po stag gzig gi rigs/ sngon sangs rgyas pa rnams la snyad 'tshol ba zhig yod pa yul de dge slong mang bas/ phyis dge slong rnams kyi btsun tshugs la dad de/ sangs rgyas pa la mchod pa mang po byed pa zhig yin pas/ slob dpon gyi sngags kyi spyod pa byas pa la yid ma ches te/ slob dpon gyi drung du byung nas/ kwa ye khyod rdzun du smra ba'am/ bden par smra ba zhigarab tu byung ba rnams sun 'byin par byed dam zhes zer ba la/ slob dpon gyis kho bo cag ni 'dod pa la longs spyod bzhin du yid gzhan du gyur pa med do/ /rgyal po na re de brtag par bya'o zhes slob dpon pho brang gi nang du spyan drangs/ yang thog shin tu dben pa zhig tu bzhagasku lus la na bza' med pas/ rdzas sbed pa'i gnas med/ nye 'khor du rtog pa'i mi ni nyin dang mtshan du gnas/

zas skom gcig kyang ma drangs par nyin zhag bdun 'das kyang*/ sku lus snga ma bzhin du 'dug la/ der rgyal pos yul khams kyi bzhin bzang ma stong lhag gcig kyang zer/ lnga brgya yang zer/ de tsam bsdus/ khyed sngags kyi spyod pa can yin na/ 'di rnams nyin zhag gcig tu spyod nus sam zhes slob dpon la gtad pa na/ spros bcas kyi spyod pa spyod par bskul ba 'byung zhes bla mas lung bstan pa de yin par mkhyen nas de rnams dang lhan cig tu rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyod cing*/ bdag nyid kyi nus pa bstan pa'i phyir de rnams kyi lus ro bcud dang bral bar mdzad cing*/ bdag nyid nyin byed lta bu'i gzi brjid dang ldan pas nyi ma gnyis pa la pho brang gi yang thog nas rgyang grags tsam mkha' la gya gyur gshegs te thag ring po'i skyed mos tshal zhig tu bzhugs so/ /yul phyogs de yang zhing mchog tu gyur pa yin pas/ pho nya mo yang shin tu mang ba yin te tshogs kyi 'du ba khyad par can gyi spros bcas kyi spyod pa yang zla ba drug mdzad/ ghir na ri zhes bya ba'i ri la bzhugs pa'i dus shig tu phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kyi go 'phangs nyams 'og tu chud par gyur la/ de'i dus nam tho rangs kyi tshe/ sa g.yos sgra chen po byung*/ dri bzang pos khyab/ me tog gi char babs/ nam mkha' nas rol mo'i sgra bsgrags pa na/ skye bo thams cad kyi mngon sum du byung*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhal gcig car gzigs/ yi dam sna tshogs pa dang*/ grub pa thams cad mngon sum du byon nas shis pa brjod/ zhag bdun du gnas gsum kyi mi ma yin dang*/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gros mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgyun ma chad par byung*/ ri de la slar yang zla ba drug tu mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'ba' zhig la bzhugs/ de nas lho phyogs kha gen dra zhes bya ba'i ri la bzhugs pa'i skabs shigayul bhaṃ dwa gyi rgyal po dga' byed gtum po zhes bya ba ri dwags bshor du 'ongs pa na/

ri'i zur zhig na ri dwags ha ri ṇa gcig 'dug pa mthong*/ de'i rjes bsnyegs te phyin pa na/ ha ri ṇa de ni stag gcig tu gyur/ der yang cung zad brtags pas/ de yang me zhig tu dmar khyug ste song*/ lo ma'i spyil po zhig gi nang du zhugs so/ /rgyal pos de la blta ru song ba na/ dge slong gi gzugs gzi brjid che ba zhig 'dug nas/ khyed su yin dris pas/ lan gnyis su slob dpon cang mi gsung*/ lan gsum pa dris pas/ sdig spyod kyi rgyal po ci zhig smra/ kho bo rnal 'byor pa zhig yin gsung*/ der lta stangs kyis zil gyis mnan pas rgyal po lhag par dad nas zhabs la phyag byas te/ yang dag pa'i gtam ci rigs pa gleng zhing yod pa'i tshe/ 'khor rnams kyang der 'ongs te/ slob dpon gyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal/ chos kyi gtam gyis dga' bar mdzad/ bram ze'i khye'u zhig la snying po'i don bstan pas/ glu dang gar mang du byas shing mi snang bar gyur skad/ de'i ming ni dza na ma de ba zhes zer te/ slob dpon 'di'i slob ma grub pa thob pa sngon ma ni de yin skad/ der dge tshul paṇ+ḍi ta gaṃ bhi ra ma ti zhes bya ba zhigaslob dpon gyi drung du byung ste/ shin tu dad nas slob mar khas blangs te/ rim gro thams cad byed cing gnas so/ /de yang snod dang ldan par mkhyen nas/ dbang bskur zhing gdams pa gnang*/ des kyang bsgoms pas ring por mi thogs par rkang mgyogs kyi dngos grub thob/ slob dpon rdzu 'phrul gyis gang du gshegs pa der/ des kyang bla ma'i rim gro byed pa la 'byon nus pa yin no/ /de nas slob dpon ma ru'i yul du byon nas/ mu stegs dang*/ tu ruṣ+ka ste/ kla klo stag gzig rnams la rengs pa'i lta stangs kyis rengs par mdzad/ yul gyi mi dang gtso bo rnams dbang du byed pa'i lta stangs kyis dbang du mdzad/ skye bo rnams la chos kyang bstan pas ye shes khyad par du gyur pa'ang mang du byung zhing*/

yul 'di nang pa lhag par mang bas/ dge 'dun phal cher gyi zhabs la gtugs/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa gnang pa'i slob ma ni drug yod de/ paṇ+ḍi ta bi ma la sa h+ya dang*/ tsan+d+ra a ka ra dang*/ rat+na ka ra ste dge slong paṇ+ḍi ta gsum dang*/ dge bsnyen paṇ+ḍi ta su ga ta dang*/ rnal 'byor ma u ma pa ti dang*/ rnal 'byor ma tā raṃ ga rnams so/ /de la dang po gsum yang bskyed rdzogs kyi rtogs pa khyad par can brnyes/ ngag gi dmod pa dang bden tshig 'grub pa yin/ 'di gsum kas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal mngon sum du gzigs/ dge bsnyen su ga tas las bzhi dang*/ khyad par mngon spyod thogs med du 'grub/ slob dpon 'di bzhis lhan cig shar phyogs kyi ljongs blta zhing byon pa la/ shar phyogs kyi kla klo pa ṭhā na rnams kyis yul 'khor rnams la ches sdug bsngal ster zhing*/ phyi nang gi lha khang thams cad kyang bshig pa gzigs/ khyad par rgya mtsho'i 'gram gyi de ba gi re zhes bya ba'i ri la sangs rgyas kyi lha khang mang po yod pa de skabs me la bsregs/ kha sar+pa ṇi'i gtsug lag khang la'ang me btang mod/ mes ma tshig /slob dpon grogs mched rnams byon pa la yang*/ nga'i yul du mgo bregs gos dmar can 'di lta bu sngar med pa las da ltar 'ongs pa ma legs zhes slob dpon bzhi po btson dong du bcug /gshed ma bskos te bgrong par bsam pa las/ gshed ma dang btson srung rnams la nyungs kar gtor bas/ de rnams dran med du myos pa'i bar la bros nas byon te/ byang chub chen po la gsol ba btab pas/ drag po'i 'phrin las 'grub cing bya ba'i dus yin par lung bstan/ de nas dza ri khaṇ+ḍar slob dpon 'di bzhi zhal 'dzom ste/ gshin rje gshed kyi 'khor lo bskor bas/ zla ba drug tsam na pa ṭhā na dang*/ mo khol nang 'khrugs te shar phyogs kyi tu ruṣ+ka'i rigs thams cad g.yul ngor brlagahen+tu'i rgyal po ma na shing zhes bya bas 'dzin pa byung ngo*/

/u ma pa tis 'ja' lus grub/ rnal 'byor ma mātā raṃ gas lta stangs bzhi thogs med du grub/ der slob dpon nyid kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i slob ma rnal 'byor pho mo nyi shu tsam byung*/ de nas lho phyogs kar+ṇa ṭar bzhugs tsam na/ de'i yul gyi rgyal po ni mu stegs pa yin pas/ de 'dul ba'i phyir rgyal po'i pho brang du byon/ pho brang nang na sngon srid sgrub kyis bzhengs pa'i ling ga 'jigs su rung pa gcig yod pa'i steng du byon te gar mdzad pas/ zhabs rjes byung*/ rgyal pos glang po che khros pa drug rbad pas/ glang po che drug kar phyag gis mnan pas g.yo ba med/ tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i rdo sku cho 'phrul che ba zhig yod pa la sdigs 'dzub mdzad pas mar gyi gong bu la nyi ma phog pa bzhin du mer gyis zhu/ da lta sku de ya cha ba gcig tu song 'dug gsung*/ der rgyal pos kyang grub pa thob par shes nas phyag byas/ slob dpon grub pa brnyes pa'i grags pa phyogs thams cad du khyab pas/ ma ra ha ṭa dang*/ koṅku na'i dge 'dun rnams kyis spyan drangs te de'i gtsug lag khang thams cad du phebs/ dbang bskur pa dang*/ gdams ngag sbyin pa dang*/ rgyud bshad pa la sogs pas rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa cher gsal bar mdzad/ paṇ+ḍi ta sum cu tsam dang*/ gzhan yang 'khor rnam bzhir gtogs pa drug cu lhag gcig dang grong khyer gyi mi bcu gcig tsam gyis phra mo rnams grub/ gzhan yang ting nge 'dzin mchog thob pa mang du byung zhing*/ de nyid du dngos grub mchog thob nas mi snang bar gyur pa mang du byung*/ de nas bhaṃ dwa gyi rgyal pos spyan drangs te yun ring du mchod pa byas shing*/ der gser gling dang*/ dha na shrī gling dang*/ pai gu'i gling dang*/ ra khang dang*/ pu kang la sogs pa thag ring po'i gling rnams dang*/ gzhan yang 'dzam bu gling gi dge slong rnams dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta ji snyed 'dus te/ rgyal pos kyang de thams cad la lo gsum du mchod pa byas/

rab tu byung ba ni stong phrag gsum tsam/ dge bsnyen dang*/ dge bsnyen ma ji snyed cig dang*/ gzhan yang phyogs bzhi'i rnal 'byor pa brgya stong du ma rnams la la ni sgrub thabs zhu/ la la ni gdams ngag zhu/ la la ni dbang dang byin rlabs zhu bar byed/ kha cig ni zhabs la phyag 'tshal zhing skor ba la sogs pas las 'brel 'jog par byed de/ lho phyogs ka ling ka'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po bai da tik+ṣ+ṇa dang*/ sang ga shī la dang*/ ma l+yā ra'i yul gyi slob dpon chen po bī ra ban+dhu dang*/ a sang ga bo dhi dang*/ pañtsa dhar ba li'i yul gyi slob dpon a nan+ta mā ti dang*/ be dā nan+da dang*/ pu kang gi yul gyi mkhas pa chen po dharma k+ṣa gho ṣa dang*/ par he ta gho ṣa dang*/ rdo rje gdan pa su me gha la sogs pa rnams kyis slob dpon chen po nyid dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dī na ka ra dang*/ slob dpon chen po gaṃ bhi ra mā ti la sogs pa slob dpon gyi thugs kyi sras rnams la rgyud sde zab mo thams cad zhus/ de ltar slob dpon 'di'i bka' drin gyis 'phags pa'i yul gyi dge 'dun sogs nang pa thams cad la rdo rje theg pa'i bka' drin bstsal ba yin no/ /nas gling dang gser gling dang zangs gling la sogs pa'i dge 'dun rnams ni nyan thos sen+dha pa kho na yin pa'i phyir slob dpon 'di'i bka'i gnang bas ma khyab ste/ gu ru shar phyogs pa nir pa ṇa shrī slob dpon gyi drung du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ slob dpon chen po tri ling ga'i tshong 'dus chen po gcig na bzhugs/ skye bo brgya stong du ma phyag 'tshal zhing yod pa la/ mahā bo dhi mjal du 'gro ba'i nas gling pa'i dge slong mang po 'dug pa de kun gsang sngags la ngan du zer zhing*/ slob dpon la phyag mi 'tshal bar 'dug gsung*/ de nas tri ling ga'i yul der rgyal po bi ka ṭa zhes pa na ba'i lto bcos la mi mang po dang ma he lnga stong*/ bya dang ra lug 'bum phrag mang po bsad pa'i mchod sbyin byed dgos zer te/

der cho ga byed pa'i mu stegs dang bram ze brgya stong 'dus/ srog chags thams cad bcings nas yod pa'i skabs shigaslob dpon ni gang nas byung cha med par de rnams kyi mchod sbyin khang par byon/ bram ze dang mu stegs thams cad la lta stangs mdzad pas thams cad rengs/ der rgyal po ngo mtshar skyes nas 'ongs pas/ slob dpon na re/ srogs chags 'di snyed cig bsad na khyod myur du 'cha/ shi nas kyang dmyal bar skye/ 'di rnams thong zhig gsung*/ de rnams bkrol te btang ma thag tu slob dpon gyis rgyal po'i mgo bor phyag bzhag pas nad las grol/ der mchod sbyin gyi mi rnams kyang rnal 'byor pa 'ba' zhig byas/ ye shes khyad par can skyes pa mang du yod gsung*/ der yul tsañtsa'i tu ruṣ+ka'i rgyal po zhig slob dpon bzhugs pa dang nye ba'i lam la song bas/ der slob dpon la ngan du brjod pa mang du byas pa/ slob dpon gyi slob ma zhig gis thos pas/ khyed rnams lkugs par gyur cig ces dmod pa btab pas/ rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa de nyid du lkugs/ der shin tu skrag nas slob dpon la gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas pa rnams kyi nus pa bstan pa'i phyir/ gcig ma gtogs pa thams cad smra nus par gyur cig ces gsungs pas de bzhin du gyur/ yang yul dbus su byon wā ra ṇa sir/ mu stegs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta ye shes can du 'dod pa/ ma da su da na swar swasta/ 'khor mang po'i dbus su khri mthon por gnas pa la sdigs 'dzub mdzad pas khri de las lhung*/ ma thu ra'i yul du sngon nang pa'i rnal 'byor pa cung zad byas pas/ phyis mu stegs pa'i rnal 'byor pa byas pa'i mu kun+da warti zhes pa des a hu ṭha tsaṇ+ḍa lī bsgrubs nas skye bo mang po dbang du byed pa grub thob tu grags pa de/ lta stangs kyis tshar bcad de/ de yang mthar bcom brlag gi grong khyer du slob dpon dpon slob gsum tsam phebs pa zhig la/

mu kun+da warti 'khor dang bcas pa yang der 'ongs pa 'dzom/ grong khyer gyi skye bo dpag tu med pa yang der 'tshogs te/ 'di gnyis kyi grub rtags blta'o zhes zer ro/ /der mu kun+da de mig 'phrul gyi rig sngags grub pa yin pas/ sngar stag gzig gi rgyal po chen po ha me hu bā tsa pa dang*/ de'i bu a ka pa ra sogs kyang dad par byas pa zhig yin/ dus der slob dpon gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi nus pas/ mig 'phrul gcig kyang sprul ma nus shing*/ slob dpon gyis 'di la lta stangs mdzad ma thagasmyo nas ha ha zhes rgyug cing*/ zhag bdun du ma sangs/ de'i slob ma rnams kyis slob dpon la gsol pa btab pas slar gsos so/ /bhaṃ dwaṃ gyi rgyal po snga ma ni dus der 'das/ de'i bu stobs bzang po zhes bya bas/ sngar pha dang thog mar mjal ba'i gnas de dang nye ba na slob dpon nyid yang dang yang du bzhugs pa'i phug pa zhig yod pa de'i sgor lha khang chen po bzhengs te phul/ lha 'bangs kyi khyim lnga brgya yang phul/ rnal 'byor pho mo mchog tu gyur pa lnga stong tsam 'dus pa'i dus shig byung bas/ de rnams la zla ba gsum du tshogs kyi 'khor lo mdzad pa'i yo byad rgyal pos phul te tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bskor/ slob ma rnams sems rgyud grol ba yang 'di dus kho na mang ba byung*/ de'i byin rlabs kyis rgyal po de la mnga' zhabs sngon grong 'bum tsam yin pa la/ da ltar 'bum phrag bzhi bcu rtsa lnga'i bdag por song*/ gu ru lho phyogs pa'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ lan lnga mjal ba'i rting ma 'di dus yin gsung*/ de nas phal cher gnas 'di nyid du bzhugs/ 'gro ba dpag tu med pa smin cing grol bar mdzad nas/ de rjes slob ma rnying pa mchog rnams ma gtogs mi mjal bar lo bdun tsam song ba na rnam smin gyi sku 'ja' tshon ltar yal te/ ye shes kyi sku mkha' khyab tu bzhugs par gyur to/ spyir rgya bod gnyis mi 'dra ste/

bod na ni dpyod ldan rnams kyang bskyed rdzogs sam lta ba'i rtogs pa bzang tsam yod pa dang*/ nyams ban bun shar ba dang*/ yi dam chos skyong ci rigs zhal mthong ba dang*/ rdzu 'phrul dang mngon shes ci rigs shar ba dang*/ las tshogs dang nus mthu than thun thob pa tsam la grub thob tu ming 'dogs la/ blun po rnams kyis ni khrel dang tshul lugs btang ba'i zog po 'gal/ sbyin 'bras kyi dbang thang che ba tsam la'ang grub rtags su 'dzin cing*/ grub thob yin ces zer la/ rgya gar na ni rgyud nas gsungs pa'i 'phags lam gyi sa thob pa'i yon tan mngon du gyur pa'am/ lus 'ja' lus su gyur pa sogs thun mong gi rig 'dzin tshad ldan cig thob na grub thob tu 'dzin gya/ gzhan ni ji tsam bzang yang sgrub pa po zhes pa las grub thob ces mi zer ro/ / slob dpon chen po 'di ni lta stangs dang*/ ji tsam gsungs pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ba'i tshig kho nas 'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub par mdzad/ cung zad dag pa'i 'khor gyi dbus su ngo mtshar ba'i ltas rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung*/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo gong bu dang khu ba dang chang dang khrag dang nags tshal gyi shing tog la sogs pa dngos su dgug par mdzad/ sa steng gi 'dren pa gcig pu par gyur pas/ mtshan yang shrī sa twa nā tha ste/ dpal sems can gyi mgon po zhes che ba'i tshig tu skye bo rnams brjod par byed do/ /rje btsun de nyid la kho bo'i bla ma rgya gar ba gsum car gyis chos gsan cing*/ gu ru lho phyogs pa ni chos kyi sras mchog tu gyur pa'ang yin mod kya/ 'on kyang bla ma gsum kas zhal lung rgyas pa rnams bla ma chen po nyid la gsan/ slob dpon gaṃ bhi ra ma ti dang*/ rnal 'byor ma'i dbang phyug ma chen mo dī na ka ra gnyis la dbang dang byin rlabs dang bshad pa mang du gsan 'dugadogs pa gcod pa ni slob ma'i gtso bo bcu tsam la mdzad par snang mod kya/ slob ma'i gtso bo rnam pa gnyis po de'i rnam thar mdor bsdus brjod na/

dang po na/ yul gu dzi ra tha zhes bya ba na/ rgyal rigs kyi bu gha gha zhes bya ba zhig blo shin tu rno bar gyur nas/ sgra dang rtog ge yan lag dang bcas pa la mkhas par gyur/ a bhū'i gtsug lag khang du rab tu byung*/ ming gaṃ bhir ma tir btags/ sde snod gsum gyi tshul yang mang du shes/ 'on kyang lo tshigs ma rdzogs pas rten ni dge tshul yin/ dgung lo bcu dgu pa la slob dpon gyi drung du bsnyen/ lo gsum du dbang dang gdams ngag ni ma gnang*/ bla ma bsten tshul ni rgyud dang mthun par mdzad/ de nas bla mas dbang bskur zhing gdams pa gnang*/ lo gnyis nas bskyed pa'i rim pa la brtan pa thob/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i ye shes kyang ci rigs pa skyes/ slob dpon nyid kyi rnyed bkur bya ba'i phyir du rkang mgyogs kyi dngos grub bsgrubs pas 'phral du grub/ bla ma bsten tshul mkhas pas slob dpon gyi dbang rgyud gdams ngag thams cad thob/ thog mar spyan ras gzigs dang rta mgrin zhal gzigs/ de nas 'jam dpal dang gshin rje gshed/ de nas dges pa rdo rje dang ku ru kul+le zhal gzigs/ nag po chen po rtag tu bran bzhin du byed/ 'jig rten pa'i lha mo drug gis bka' thams cad sgrub pa yin/ mnal thams cad 'od gsal du tshud/ mngon par shes pa rgya chen po mnga' yang*/ bla ma'i rim gro sgrub pa'i bran mdzad pa yin no/ /rnal 'byor ma dī na ka ra na/ lho phyogs kyi grong khyer shaṃ bha da ta zhes bya ba zhig na/ pi si la'i rigs rgyal po gzhon nu 'phrog byed 'od ces bya ba zhig yod/ de la sring mo chung ngu nas blo rno zhing dge ba la dga' ba zhig yod pa/ lo dgu lon pa'i dus shig na/ sgo drung du dge slong mdzes pa gzi brjid che ba zhig byung*/ de la bsod snyoms skyel du phyin/ der khyed mi bzang bzang 'dra ba zhig bsod snyoms spyod pa 'di sdug bsngal byas pas/ de na re/ nga ni mi sdug na khyod nyid sdug bsngal te/

'khor ba ru 'khyams 'dug pa gsung nas/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs mang du gsungs/ de las thar ba'i thabs cig zhu byas pas/ sems kyi bzhag thabs dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i gnad khyad par can bslabs pas/ des kyang legs par shes/ lo bcu lon pa'i dus su yul tsai ba lar rgyal rigs rgyal phran zhig la bag mar btang*/ lo bcu gsum lon pa'i dus su/ 'khor ba la yid nges par 'byung ste/ khyim thab dang gyos sgyug sogs la/ kho mo nags tshal rnams su ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa zhig byung na ci ma rung*/ khyed rnams kyis gnang ba mdzod ces yang yang smras pas/ de bzlog pa'i phyir du khyim gyi bdag mor bskos/ slong ba po ci byung pa thams cad la sbyin pa rgya cher btang bas/ nang mi dang gnyen tshan rnams kyis smod/ slong mo ba dang skye bo rnams ni bstod pa zhig byung*/ de nas dus gzhan zhig na smyo rdzu btab/ spyod pa sna tshogs pa byas pas/ der g.yog mo zhig dang lhan cig dben pa zhig tu bzhag snga ma las kyang smyo ba che che ltar rdzus pas/ khyim thab dang bral/ de yang sngon btsas pa'i tshe/ 'di'i rkang lag la pad+ma dang 'khor lo phyed phyed kyis mtshan pa 'dug pas nags su gnas na ni bdag nyid chen mor 'gyur zhes lung bstan pa ltar thog tu babs pa yin gsung*/ tsai ba la dang nye ba ma ra ha ṭi'i grong khyer zhig na/ slob dpon chen po zhi ba sbas pa bzhugs pa thos nas/ mtshan thos pa tsam gyis ting nge 'dzin skye ba snyam byung*/ zhal mthong ma thag ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skyes/ dus de'i tshe na lo nyi shu tsam lon pa yin skad/ bud med yin yang blo ni shin tu rno ste/ de gong du tsan+d+ra byā ka ra ṇa yongs su rdzogs pa shes/ mngon brjod dang*/ sman dpyad dang*/ rtog ge yang ci rigs pa mkhyen/ sngon gyi bag chags kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bdun brgya pa dang*/ sum brgya pa dang*/ bsdud pa'i tshigs su bcad pa rnams bklags pa tsam gyis zin/

dge slong ma dang*/ dge bsnyen ma 'dra la dris pas don yang legs par shes/ de nas slob dpon chen po zhi ba'i zhal snga nas la thog mar byang chub tu sems bskyed pa la sogs pa zhus shing*/ skal ba dang ldan par mkhyen nas/ rim gyis dbang bskur ba dang gdams pa mtha' dag gnang*/ slob dpon gyi drung du lo bdun du rdo rje theg pa la thos sgom gcig car byas pas/ rgyud thams cad kyi don legs par mkhyen/ de nas lo lnga'i bar du bla ma'i rim gro dang sgom pa rtse gcig tu byas pas/ ye shes khyad par can skyes te/ rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ rlung gi rnal 'byor gyi nus pas/ glang po che brgyas kyang stobs 'gran du med pa dang*/ dpag tshad tsam du nam mkha' la 'gro bar byed/ lta stangs dang ngag gi bden pa yang grub/ der bla ma'i zhal nas/ da ni khyod rig brtul gyi spyod pa gyis shig de kho na nyid kyi rtogs pa yang sems can la ston cig deng nas lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis 'das pa na nga dang mnyam par 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan skad/ zla ba drug tu spyod pa spyad pas/ thun mong gi dngos grub brgyad la sogs pa thams cad nyams 'og tu chud/ drung du byung ba thams cad la gdams ngag bstan/ rtogs pa mchog tu gyur pa'i rnal 'byor ma lnga brgya'i 'khor dang bcas nas/ yul sna tshogs su 'gro ba'i don spyod cing*/ slob dpon gyi drung du mchod pa'i phyir dang*/ rtogs pa'i tshad 'bul bar yang dang yang du 'byon par gnang gsung*/ lan cig rdzu 'phrul gyis kha gen dra nas/ rang ga nā tha zhes bya ba'i gnas su byon/ de na phyin na nga gnyis ka'i gnas yod pa la/ de'i phyi rol pa'i gnas rnams su yang dang yang du 'khyams pa ltar mdzad/ de nas dzaṃ gha ma dbang phyug chen po dang*/ bhai ra ba grub par grags pa lta stangs dang khu tshur gyi rig pa grub pas/ sangs rgyas pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams la bar du gcod pa zhig yod/

ming ni bhiṃ ga de ba zer/ des rnal 'byor ma la lta stangs byas pas ma gnod/ rnal 'byor mas de la lta stangs byas pas/ sa la 'gyel te dbugs 'gyu ba chad/ der ring zhig bzhag pas/ gnas de'i mu stegs pa rnams kyis yang yang gsol ba 'debs par byung bas/ slar yang lta stangs kyis gsos/ de yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dad/ rjes su 'dzin pa zhus pas/ slob dpon gyi drung du brdzangs/ yang 'dis dam tshig nyams pa'i rnal 'byor pa gha ma la warma zhes bya ba/ sngon nus pa cung zad thob pas grub thob tu rdzu ba zhig dang*/ o ḍi shar 'phrad/ lta stangs mdzad pas gsus pa brdol te khrag zags/ des thod par bzed pas de yang brdol/ de ltar dam tshig nyams pa tshar bcad gsung*/ dpal he ru ka dang*/ khro bo bcu/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sum cu rtsa bdun la sogs pa thams cad nam blta 'dod pa'i tshe zhal gzigs/ 'on kyang de skabs mchog gi dngos grub ni ma thob par grags/ de ltar slob dpon zhi ba sbas pa/ slob ma'i mchog gnyis dang bcas pas kho bo'i bla ma gsum la legs par gdams/ de la kho bos rdo rje theg pa lam man ngag go babs dang bcas pa'i bka' drin thob pa yin no/ /spyir rgya gar du gsang sngags la rig pa 'dzin pa 'bum phrag thog mar byung*/ de nas dpal sa ra ha byon pa nas gzung*/ rgyal po dharma pā la 'das pa'i bar du/ grub thob rgyun ma chad par ma zad grub thob mang po dus gcig tu bzhugs pa byung ba yin/ de nas a bha yā ka ra sku 'das bar la'ang*/ grub thob rgyun ma chad par byung la/ de man chad du res 'ga' na lan re re las ma byung*/ khyad par dus phyis grub thob gzhan med par yun ring rab zhig na/ ye shes bshes gnyen dang*/ o ka ra nā tha byon kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la phan che ba tsam ma byung*/ o ka ra sku 'das nas/ lo brgyad cu lon tsa na grub chen zhi ba sbas pas grub pa brnyes te/ dus kyi dbang las sangs rgyas pa mang nyung gis gzhan phan che chung ma gtogs jo bo na ro pa chen po dang gzhan phan che chung 'dra ba/

go 'phangs slob dpon 'di mtho ba yin no/ /rin po che'i 'byung khungs lta bu'i gtam las/ bka' babs thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa'i gtam gyi skabs te dgu pa'o// //bka' babs bdun po de dag ni dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa'i brgyud pa 'ba' zhig yin cing*/ de'i nang gi yang drug po de dag ni don gyi brgyud pa kho na lags/ gdams ngag phra mo re re zhing gi bla ma brgyud pa mi 'dra ba rnams ni brgyud pa'i yi ge las shes par bya zhing*/ rnam par thar pa mtha' yas pa ni yi ger 'bri bar ga la lang*/ rgyud pa'i bla ma 'ga' zhig gi rnam par thar pa ni mi gsung bas re zhig de tsam yin no/ /'dir da lta rgya gar du grags pa'i lo rgyus gang thos pa rnams kyi steng du sngon gyi slob dpon gyi lo rgyus bod na yod pa'ang yid ches nges pa rnams kyis cung zad kha bskang nas bshad pa yin no/ /spyir rgya gar du byon pa'i shing rta chen po rnams dang*/ brgyud pa'i rnam thar ci rigs pa da dung gzhan du bshad par bya'o/ /bla ma'i rnam thar brjod pa las/ /bsod nams cung zad gang thob pa/ /des ni 'gro ba ma lus pa'ang*/ /de 'dra'i tshul gyis sangs rgyas gyur/ /bdag kyang skye ba thams cad du/ /brgyud ldan bla ma thams cad kya/ /bran dang bran du skye ba dang*/ /thugs kyi gsang ba 'dzin par shog /ngo mtshar bka' babs bdun ldan rdo rje 'chang gi lam/ / phyogs kun skye bo rnams kyi nyer spyod rgya chen dang*/ man ngag rin chen gyis gang bdag sems shing rta ya/ /bgrod byar gyur te srid gsum dbul ba sel bar shog /ces bka' babs bdun ldan gyi brgyud pa'i rnam thar ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba rin po che'i 'byung khungs lta bu'i gtam zhes bya ba/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka'i 'bangs kyi tha chung du gyur pa tā ra nā tha zhes bya bas rang lo nyer drug pa la nye ba na/ grub pa'i gnas mchog dpal stag lung thang dang nye ba rnam rgyal rab brtan zhes bya bar legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo ldan kun dga' rnam rgyal lo//
